text: Farishton ka tazkirah. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud (R.A) farmate hain in teenon qismon se murad farishte hain. Aur bhi aksar hazrat ka yahi qaul hai. Hazrat Qatadah (R.A) farmate hain farishton ki saifein aasmanon par hain. Muslim mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hamain sab logon par teen baton mein fazeelat di gayi hai. Hamari saifein farishton ki saifon jaisi ki gayi hain. Hamare liye sari zameen masjid bana di gayi hai. Aur pani ke na milne ke waqt zameen ki mitti hamare liye wuzu ke qaim-maqam ki gayi hai. Muslim waghera mein hai ke ek martaba Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hum se farmaya tum is tarah saifein nahin bandhte jis tarah farishte apne Rab ke samne saf-basta khade hote hain. Hum ne kaha woh kis tarah? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya agli saifon ko woh pura karte jate hain aur saifein bilkul mila liya karte hain. Daantne walon se murad Suddi (R.H) waghera ke nazdeek abr aur badal ko daant kar ahkaam de kar idhar se udhar le jane wale farishte hain. Rabi bin Anas waghera farmate hain Quran jis cheez se rokta hai woh usi se bandish karte hain. Zikr-e-Allah ki tilawat karne wale farishte woh hain jo Allah ka paigham bandon ke paas late hain jaise farman hai (FAL-MULQIYATI ZIKRA) (77. Al-Mursalat: 5) yani wahi utarne wale farishton ki qasam jo uzr ko talne ya aagah karne ke liye hoti hai. In qasmon ke baad jis cheez par yeh qasmein khai gayi hain us ka zikr ho raha hai ke tum sab ka mabood-e-barhaq ek Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Wohi aasman-o-zameen ka aur un ke darmiyan ki tamam cheezon ka malik-o-mutasarrif hai. Usi ne aasman mein sitare aur chand suraj ko musakhar kar rakha hai, jo mashriq se zahir hote hain maghrib mein ghuroob hote hain. Mashriqon ka zikr kar ke maghribon ka zikr us ki dalalat majood hone ki wajah se chhod diya. Dusri aayat mein zikr kar bhi diya hai farman hai (RABBUL MASHRIQAYNI WA RABBUL MAGHRIBAYN) (55. Ar-Rahman: 17) yani jade garmiyon ki tulu-o-ghuroob ki jagah ka Rab wohi hai.

Shayateen aur Kahin. Aasman-e-Dunya ko dekhne wale ki nigahon mein jo zeenat di gayi hai us ka bayan farmaya. Yeh izafat ke sath bhi parha gaya hai aur badliyat ke sath bhi, ma'ani dono suraton mein ek hi hain. Is ke sitaron ki, is ke suraj ki roshni zameen ko jagmaga deti hai, jaise aur aayat mein hai (WALAQAD ZAYYANNAS SAMA'AD DUNYA BIMASABIHA WA JA'ALNAHA RUJOOMAL LISHSHAYATEENI WA A'TADNA LAHUM 'AZABAS SA'EER) (Surah Al-Mulk: 5). Hum ne aasman-e-dunya ko zeenat di sitaron ke sath. Aur unhein shayateen ke liye shayateen ke rajam ka zariya banaya aur hum ne un ke liye aag se jala dene wale azab tayyar kar rakhe hain. Aur aayat mein hai hum ne aasman mein burj banaye aur unhein dekhne walon ki aankhon mein khub jane wali cheez banayi. Aur har shaitan-e-rajeem se ise mehfooz rakha, jo koi kisi baat ko le urna chahta hai wahin ek tez shola us ki taraf utarta hai. Aur hum ne aasmanon ki hifazat ki har sarkash shareer shaitan se, us ka bas nahin ke farishton ki baatein sune, woh jab yeh karta hai to ek shola lapakta hai aur use jala deta hai. Yeh aasmanon tak pahunch hi nahin sakte. Allah ki shariat-e-taqdeer ke umoor ki kisi guftagu ko woh sun hi nahin sakte. Is bare ki hadeesein hum ne aayat (HATTA IZA FUZZI'A 'AN QULOOBIHIM QALOO MAZA QALA RABBUKUM QALUL HAQQA WA HUWAL 'ALIYYUL KABEER) (Surah Saba: 23), ki tafseer mein bayan kar di hain, jidhar se bhi yeh aasman par charhna chahte hain wahin se un par aatish bazi ki jati hai. Unhein hankane, past-o-zaleel karne, rokne aur na aane dene ke liye yeh saza bayan ki hai aur aakhirat ke daimi azab abhi baqi hain, jo bare alamnak, dardnak aur hameshgi wale honge. Haan kabhi kisi jinn ne koi kalma kisi farishte ki zaban se sun liya aur use us ne apne neeche wale se keh diya aur us ne apne neeche wale se, wahin us ke peeche ek shola lapakta hai, kabhi to woh dusre ko pahunchaye is se pehle hi shola use jala dalta hai, kabhi woh dusre ke kanon tak pahuncha deta hai.

Yehi woh baatein hain jo kahinon ke kaanon tak shayateen ke zariye pahunch jaati hain, Saqib se murad sakht tez bahut zyada roshni wala hai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka bayan hai ke shayateen pehle jakar aasmanon mein baithte thay aur wahi sun lete thay us waqt un par taare nahin toot-te thay yeh wahan ki wahi sun kar zameen par aakar ek ki das das kar ke kahinon ke kaanon mein phoonkte thay, jab Huzoor ﷺ ko nabuwwat mili phir shaitanon ka aasman par jana mauqoof hua, ab yeh jaate hain to un par aag ke sholay phenke jaate hain aur unhein jala diya jata hai, unhon ne is nau-paida amr ki khabar jab Iblees maloon ko di to us ne kaha ke kisi ahem naye kaam ki wajah se is qadar ehtiyat-o-hifazat ki gayi hai chunancha khabar-rasanon ki jamatein us ne roo-e-zameen par phaila dein to jo jamaat Hijaz ki taraf gayi thi us ne dekha ke Rasool Allah ﷺ Nakhla ki dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan namaz ada kar rahe hain us ne jakar Iblees ko yeh khabar di us ne kaha bas yehi wajah hai jo tumhara aasmanon par jana mauqoof hua. Is ki poori tehqeeq Allah ne chaha to aayat (وَّاَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاۗءَ فَوَجَدْنٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيْدًا وَّشُهُبًا ۙ) (Surah Al-Jinn: 8), ki tafseer mein aayegi.

Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum deta hai ke in munkireen-e-Qayamat se pucho ke tumhara paida karna hum par mushkil hai? Ya aasman-o-zameen, farishtay, jinn waghera ka. Ibn Mas'ood (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki qira'at 'am min 'adadna' hai, matlab yeh hai ke is ka iqrar toh inhe bhi hai, ke phir mar kar jeenay ka inkar kyun kar rahe hain? Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke insano ki paidaish se toh bahut badi aur bahut bhari paidaish aasman-o-zameen ki hai lekin aksar log be-ilmi barat-tay hain. Phir insaan ki paidaishi kamzori bayan farmata hai ke yeh chakni mitti se paida kiya gaya hai jis mein lais tha jo hathon par chipakti thi. Toh chunke haqeeqat ko pahunch gaya hai in ke inkar par ta'ajjub kar raha hai kyunke Allah ki qudratein tere samne hain aur us ke farman bhi. Lekin yeh toh isay sun kar hansi uratay hain. Aur jab kabhi koi wazeh daleel samne aa jati hai toh maskhara-pan karne lagtay hain. Aur kehtay hain ke yeh toh jadu hai. Hum kisi tarah isay nahin mannay ke ke mar kar mitti ho kar phir jee uthein, balkay hamaray baap dada bhi dusri zindagi mein aa jayen, hum toh is ke qail nahin. Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum in se keh do ke haan tum yaqeenan dobara paida kiye jaoge. Tum ho kya cheez, Allah ki qudrat aur mashiyat ke matehat ho, us ki woh zaat hai ke kisi ki us ke samne koi hasti nahin. Farmata hai (Kullun atawhu dakhirin) har shakhs us ke samne aajizi aur lachari se hazir honay wala hai. Ek aayat mein hai (Wa qala rabbukumud'uni astajib lakum, innallazina yastakbiruna 'an 'ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhirin) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 60) meri ibadat se sarkashi karne walay zaleel-o-khwar ho kar jahannam mein jayenge. Phir Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke jisay tum mushkil samajhtay ho, woh mujh par toh bilkul hi aasaan hai, sirf ek aawaz lagtay hi har ek zameen se nikal kar dehshat-naki ke sath ahwal-o-ahwal-e-Qayamat ko dekhnay lagay ga. Wallahu A'lam.

Hum kisi tarah isay nahin mannay ke ke mar kar mitti ho kar phir jee uthein, balkay hamaray baap dada bhi dusri zindagi mein aa jayen, hum toh is ke qail nahin. Ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum in se keh do ke haan tum yaqeenan dobara paida kiye jaoge. Tum ho kya cheez, Allah ki qudrat aur mashiyat ke matehat ho, us ki woh zaat hai ke kisi ki us ke samne koi hasti nahin. Farmata hai (Kullun atawhu dakhirin) har shakhs us ke samne aajizi aur lachari se hazir honay wala hai. Qayamat wale din kuffar ka apne tayin malamat karna aur pachtana aur afsos-o-hasrat karna bayan ho raha hai ke woh nadim ho kar Qayamat ke dehshat-khez aur wehshat-angez umoor ko dekh kar kahenge haye haye yahi toh roz-e-jaza hai. Toh momin aur farishte bator daant-dupat aur nadamat barhane ke un se kahenge haan yahi toh woh faisle ka din hai jise tum saccha nahin maante thay. Is din Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se farishton ko hukum hoga ke zalimon ko, un ke joron ko, un ke bhai-bandon ko aur un jaison ko ek jaa jama karo. Maslan zani zaniyon ke sath, sood-khwar sood-khwaron ke sath, sharabi sharabiyon ke sath waghera. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke zalimon ko aur un ki aurton ko, lekin yeh gharib hai. Theek matlab yahi hai ke unhi jaison ko aur un ke sath hi jin buton ko aur jin jin ko sharik-e-Allah yeh muqarrar kiye hue thay sab ko jama karo. Phir un sab ko Jahannam ka rasta dikhao jaise farman hai: (Wa nahshuruhum yaumal qiyamati 'ala wujuhihim 'umyanaw wa bukman wa summan, ma'wahum jahannamu, kullama khabat zidnahum sa'ira) (17. Al-Isra: 97), yani unhein un ke munh ke bal andhe behre goonge kar ke hum jama karenge phir un ka thikana Jahannam hoga jis ki aag jab kabhi halki ho jaye hum use aur bharka denge. Unhein Jahannam ke paas kuch der thehra do taake hum un se pooch-guch kar lein. Un se hisab le lein. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs kisi ko kisi cheez ki taraf bulaye, woh Qayamat ke din us ke sath khara kiya jayega, na bewafai hogi na judai hogi go ek ko hi bulaya ho, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Hazrat Usman bin Zaida (R.A) farmate hain sab se pehle insan se us ke sathiyon ki babat sawal kiya jayega. Phir un se poocha jayega ke kyun aaj ek dusre ki madad nahin karte? Tum toh duniya mein kehte phirte thay ke hum sab ek sath hain aur ek dusre ke madadgar hain. Yeh toh kahan? Balkeh aaj toh yeh hathiyar daal chuke, Allah ke farman-bardar ban gaye. Na Allah ke kisi farman ka khilaf karein na kar sakein, na us se bach sakein, na wahan se bhaag sakein. Wallahu A'lam.

Qayamat wale din kuffar ka apne tayin malamat karna aur pachtana aur afsos-o-hasrat karna bayan ho raha hai ke woh nadim ho kar Qayamat ke dehshat-khez aur wehshat-angez umoor ko dekh kar kahenge haye haye yahi toh roz-e-jaza hai. Toh momin aur farishte bator daant-dupat aur nadamat barhane ke un se kahenge haan yahi toh woh faisle ka din hai jise tum saccha nahin maante thay. Is din Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se farishton ko hukum hoga ke zalimon ko, un ke joron ko, un ke bhai-bandon ko aur un jaison ko ek jaa jama karo. Maslan zani zaniyon ke sath, sood-khwar sood-khwaron ke sath, sharabi sharabiyon ke sath waghera. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke zalimon ko aur un ki aurton ko, lekin yeh gharib hai. Theek matlab yahi hai ke unhi jaison ko aur un ke sath hi jin buton ko aur jin jin ko sharik-e-Allah yeh muqarrar kiye hue thay sab ko jama karo. Phir un sab ko Jahannam ka rasta dikhao jaise farman hai: (Wa nahshuruhum yaumal qiyamati 'ala wujuhihim 'umyanaw wa bukman wa summan, ma'wahum jahannamu, kullama khabat zidnahum sa'ira) (17. Al-Isra: 97), yani unhein un ke munh ke bal andhe behre goonge kar ke hum jama karenge phir un ka thikana Jahannam hoga jis ki aag jab kabhi halki ho jaye hum use aur bharka denge. Unhein Jahannam ke paas kuch der thehra do taake hum un se pooch-guch kar lein. Un se hisab le lein. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo shakhs kisi ko kisi cheez ki taraf bulaye, woh Qayamat ke din us ke sath khara kiya jayega, na bewafai hogi na judai hogi go ek ko hi bulaya ho, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Hazrat Usman bin Zaida (R.A) farmate hain sab se pehle insan se us ke sathiyon ki babat sawal kiya jayega. Phir un se poocha jayega ke kyun aaj ek dusre ki madad nahin karte? Tum toh duniya mein kehte phirte thay ke hum sab ek sath hain aur ek dusre ke madadgar hain. Yeh toh kahan? Balkeh aaj toh yeh hathiyar daal chuke, Allah ke farman-bardar ban gaye. Na Allah ke kisi farman ka khilaf karein na kar sakein, na us se bach sakein, na wahan se bhaag sakein. Wallahu A'lam.

Dozakhiyon ka apne buzurgon se shikwa. Kafir log jis tarah jahannam ke tabqon mein jalte hue aapas mein jhagde karenge isi tarah Qayamat ke maidan mein woh ek dusre par ilzaam lagayenge. Kamzor log zor-awaron se kahenge ke hum toh tumhare tabe-e-farman the, kya aaj hamein tum thode bahut azaab se bacha loge? Woh kahenge ke hum toh khud tumhare saath hi isi jahannam mein jal rahe hain, Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke darmiyan faisle farma chuka. Aur jaise aur jagah unki yeh baat-cheet is tarah manqool hai ke zaeef log mutakabbiron se kahenge ke agar tum na hote toh hum zaroor imandar ban jaate. Woh jawab denge kya humne tumhein hidayat se rok diya? Nahin balkeh tum toh khud hi badkar the. Yeh kahenge balkeh din-o-raat ka makr jabkeh tum hamein hukm karte the ke hum Allah Ta'ala ke saath kufr karein aur uske shareek muqarrar karein. Azaab ko dekhte hi yeh sab ke sab betarah nadim-o-pasheman honge lekin apni nadamat ko chupayenge. In tamam kuffar ki gardanon mein tauq daal diye jayenge, haan yeh yaqeeni baat hai ke har ek ko sirf uski karni bharni padegi. Pas yahan bhi yahi bayan ho raha hai ke woh apne badon aur sardaron se kahenge tum hamari dayin janib se aate the, yani chunkeh hum kamzor kam-haisiyat the aur tumhein hum par tarjeeh thi is liye tum hamein daba-dabo kar haq se nahaq ki taraf pher dete the, yeh kafiron ka maqoola hoga jo woh shaitanon se kahenge. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke insaan yeh baat jinnaat se kahenge ke tum hamein bhalai se rok kar burai par aamada karte the, gunah ko muzayyan aur sheereen dikhate the aur neki ko buri aur mushkil jatate the, haq se rokte the, baatil par jama dete the, jab kabhi neki ka khayal hamare dilon mein aata tha tum kisi na kisi fareb se us se rok dete the, Islam, Iman, khair-o-khoobi, neki aur sa'adat-mandi se tumne hamein mehroom kar diya. Tauheed se door daal diya. Hum tumhein apna khair-khwah samajhte rahe, raaz-daar banaye rahe, tumhari baatein maante rahe, tumhein bhala aadmi samajhte rahe. Iske jawab mein jinnaat aur insaan jitne bhi sardar, zi-izzat aur bade log the, un kamzoron ko jawab denge ke is mein hamara toh koi qasoor nahin, tum toh khud hi aise hi the, tumhare dil iman se bhagte the aur kufr ki taraf daud kar jaate the. Humne tumhein jis cheez ki taraf bulaya woh koi haq baat na thi na uski bhalai par koi daleel thi lekin chunkeh tum tab'an burai ki taraf mail the, khud tumhare dilon mein sarkashi aur burai thi is liye tumne hamara kaha maan liya. Ab toh hum sab par Allah ka qaul saabit ho gaya ke hum yaqeenan azaabon ka maza chakhne wale hain. Yeh bade log choton se, yeh matboo' log apne tabe-daron se kahenge ke hum toh khud hi behke hue the, humne tumhein bhi apni zalalat ki taraf bulaya, tum daude hue aa gaye. Batao tumne hamari baat maan li? Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai pas aaj ke din sab log jahannam ke azaabon mein shareek hain, har ek apne apne a'maal ki saza bhugat raha hai. Mujrimon ke saath hum isi tarah kiya karte hain.

Yeh mominon ki tarah Allah ki tauheed ke qail na thay balkay tauheed ki aawaz se takabbur nafrat karte thay. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke logon se jihad karoon jab tak ke woh La ilaha illallah na keh lein jo isay keh le usne apna maal aur apni jaan bacha li magar Islami farman se. Aur iska batini hisab Allah ke zimme hai. Allah ki kitab mein bhi yahi mazmoon hai. Aur ek mutakabbir qoum ka zikr hai ke woh is kalma se rogardani karte thay. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Abu Al-Ala se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ko Qayamat ke din laya jaye ga aur un se sawal hoga ke tum duniya mein kis ki ibadat karte thay? Woh kahenge Allah ki aur Uzair ki. Un se kaha jaye ga achha bayin taraf aao. Phir Nasraniyon se yahi sawal hoga woh kahenge Allah ki aur Maseeh ki to un se bhi yahi kaha jaye ga phir mushrikeen ko laya jaye ga aur un se La ilaha illallah kaha jaye ga woh takabbur karenge teen martaba aisa hi hoga phir hukum hoga inhe bhi bayin taraf le chalo farishtay inhe parindon se bhi jaldi pohancha denge. Phir Musalmanon ko laya jaye ga aur un se poocha jaye ga ke tum kis ki ibadat karte rahe? Yeh kahenge sirf Allah Ta'ala ki. To un se kaha jaye ga kya tum isay dekh kar pehchan sakte ho? Yeh kahenge haan. Poocha jaye ga tum kaise pehchan lo ge? Halankeh tum ne kabhi isay dekha nahin yeh jawab denge haan yeh to theek hai hum jante hain ke is ke barabar ka koi nahin pas Allah Ta'ala apne tayin inhe pehchanwaye ga aur un ko nijat de ga. Yeh kalma-e-tauheed aur radd-e-shirk sun kar jawab dete thay ke kya is shair-o-majnoon ke kehne se hum apni maboodon se dast-bardar ho jayen ge? Manna to ek taraf ultay Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko shair aur deewana batate thay. Pas Allah Ta'ala in ki takzeeb karta hai aur un ke radd mein farmata hai ke yeh to bilkul sachay hain sach le kar aaye hain sari shariat sarasar haq hai khabrein hon to aur hukum hon to. Yeh rasoolon ko bhi sacha janta hai un rasoolon ne jo sifatain aur pakeezgiyan aap ki bayan ki thin. Unke sahih musaddiq aap hi hain. Yeh bhi wahi ahkaam bayan karte hain jo aglay ambiya ne kiye jaise aur aayat mein hai (مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيْلَ للرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ ۭ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوْ مَغْفِرَةٍ وَّذُوْ عِقَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ) (Surah Fussilat: 43), yani tujh se wahi kaha jata hai jo tujh se pehle ke nabiyon se kaha jata raha.

Dozakhiyon ka apne buzurgon se shikwa. Kafir log jis tarah jahannam ke tabqon mein jalte hue aapas mein jhagde karenge isi tarah Qayamat ke maidan mein woh ek dusre par ilzaam lagayenge. Kamzor log zor-awaron se kahenge ke hum toh tumhare tabe-e-farman the, kya aaj hamein tum thode bahut azaab se bacha loge? Woh kahenge ke hum toh khud tumhare saath hi isi jahannam mein jal rahe hain, Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke darmiyan faisle farma chuka. Aur jaise aur jagah unki yeh baat-cheet is tarah manqool hai ke zaeef log mutakabbiron se kahenge ke agar tum na hote toh hum zaroor imandar ban jaate. Woh jawab denge kya humne tumhein hidayat se rok diya? Nahin balkeh tum toh khud hi badkar the. Yeh kahenge balkeh din-o-raat ka makr jabkeh tum hamein hukm karte the ke hum Allah Ta'ala ke saath kufr karein aur uske shareek muqarrar karein. Azaab ko dekhte hi yeh sab ke sab betarah nadim-o-pasheman honge lekin apni nadamat ko chupayenge. In tamam kuffar ki gardanon mein tauq daal diye jayenge, haan yeh yaqeeni baat hai ke har ek ko sirf uski karni bharni padegi. Pas yahan bhi yahi bayan ho raha hai ke woh apne badon aur sardaron se kahenge tum hamari dayin janib se aate the, yani chunkeh hum kamzor kam-haisiyat the aur tumhein hum par tarjeeh thi is liye tum hamein daba-dabo kar haq se nahaq ki taraf pher dete the, yeh kafiron ka maqoola hoga jo woh shaitanon se kahenge. Humne tumhein jis cheez ki taraf bulaya woh koi haq baat na thi na uski bhalai par koi daleel thi lekin chunkeh tum tab'an burai ki taraf mail the, khud tumhare dilon mein sarkashi aur burai thi is liye tumne hamara kaha maan liya. Yeh bade log choton se, yeh matboo' log apne tabe-daron se kahenge ke hum toh khud hi behke hue the, humne tumhein bhi apni zalalat ki taraf bulaya, tum daude hue aa gaye. Mujrimon ke saath hum isi tarah kiya karte hain.

Ab toh hum sab par Allah ka qaul saabit ho gaya ke hum yaqeenan azaabon ka maza chakhne wale hain. Yeh bade log choton se, yeh matboo' log apne tabe-daron se kahenge ke hum toh khud hi behke hue the, humne tumhein bhi apni zalalat ki taraf bulaya, tum daude hue aa gaye. Batao tumne hamari baat maan li? Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai pas aaj ke din sab log jahannam ke azaabon mein shareek hain, har ek apne apne a'maal ki saza bhugat raha hai. Mujrimon ke saath hum isi tarah kiya karte hain.

Yeh mominon ki tarah Allah ki tauheed ke qail na thay balkay tauheed ki aawaz se takabbur nafrat karte thay. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke logon se jihad karoon jab tak ke woh La ilaha illallah na keh lein jo isay keh le usne apna maal aur apni jaan bacha li magar Islami farman se. Aur iska batini hisab Allah ke zimme hai. Allah ki kitab mein bhi yahi mazmoon hai. Aur ek mutakabbir qoum ka zikr hai ke woh is kalma se rogardani karte thay. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Abu Al-Ala se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ko Qayamat ke din laya jaye ga aur un se sawal hoga ke tum duniya mein kis ki ibadat karte thay? Woh kahenge Allah ki aur Uzair ki. Un se kaha jaye ga achha bayin taraf aao. Phir Nasraniyon se yahi sawal hoga woh kahenge Allah ki aur Maseeh ki to un se bhi yahi kaha jaye ga phir mushrikeen ko laya jaye ga aur un se La ilaha illallah kaha jaye ga woh takabbur karenge teen martaba aisa hi hoga phir hukum hoga inhe bhi bayin taraf le chalo farishtay inhe parindon se bhi jaldi pohancha denge. Phir Musalmanon ko laya jaye ga aur un se poocha jaye ga ke tum kis ki ibadat karte rahe? Yeh kahenge sirf Allah Ta'ala ki. To un se kaha jaye ga kya tum isay dekh kar pehchan sakte ho? Yeh kahenge haan. Poocha jaye ga tum kaise pehchan lo ge? Halankeh tum ne kabhi isay dekha nahin yeh jawab denge haan yeh to theek hai hum jante hain ke is ke barabar ka koi nahin pas Allah Ta'ala apne tayin inhe pehchanwaye ga aur un ko nijat de ga. Yeh kalma-e-tauheed aur radd-e-shirk sun kar jawab dete thay ke kya is shair-o-majnoon ke kehne se hum apni maboodon se dast-bardar ho jayen ge? Manna to ek taraf ultay Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko shair aur deewana batate thay. Pas Allah Ta'ala in ki takzeeb karta hai aur un ke radd mein farmata hai ke yeh to bilkul sachay hain sach le kar aaye hain sari shariat sarasar haq hai khabrein hon to aur hukum hon to. Yeh rasoolon ko bhi sacha janta hai un rasoolon ne jo sifatain aur pakeezgiyan aap ki bayan ki thin. Unke sahih musaddiq aap hi hain. Yeh bhi wahi ahkaam bayan karte hain jo aglay ambiya ne kiye jaise aur aayat mein hai (مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيْلَ للرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ ۭ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوْ مَغْفِرَةٍ وَّذُوْ عِقَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ) (Surah Fussilat: 43), yani tujh se wahi kaha jata hai jo tujh se pehle ke nabiyon se kaha jata raha.

Muttaqiyon ke liye najaat aur inamaat. Allah Ta'ala tamam logon se khitab kar ke farma raha hai ke tum almnak azab chakhne wale ho. Aur sirf isi ka badla diye jane wale ho jise tum ne kiya dhara hai. Phir apne mukhlis bandon ko is se alag kar leta hai jaise Wal-Asr mein farmaya ke tamam insan ghate mein hain. Magar imandar nek aamal. Aur Surah At-Teen mein farmaya hum ne insan ko bahut achi paidaish mein paida kiya phir use neeche se neecha kar diya magar jo iman laye aur jinhon ne nek aamal kiye. Aur Surah Maryam mein farmaya (Wa in-min-kum illa wariduha, kana ala rabbika hatman maqziya) (19. Maryam: 71), tum mein se har ek jahannam par warid hone wala hai yeh to tere Rab ne faisla kar diya hai aur yeh zaroori cheez hai lekin phir hum muttaqiyon ko najaat denge aur zalimon ko isi mein gire pade chhod denge. Surah Mudassir mein irshad hua hai. (Kullu nafsin za'iqatul maut, summa ilaina turja'oon) (29. Al-Ankabut: 57) har shakhs apne apne aamal mein mashghool hai magar woh jin ke dayen hath mein nama-e-aamal aa chuka hai isi tarah yahan par bhi apne khas bandon ka istisna kar liya ke woh almnak azabon se hisab ke phansaway se alag hain balkeh un ki buraiyon se darguzar farmaya gaya hai aur un ki nekiyan badha chadha kar ek ki das das guni balkeh saat saat sau guni kar ke balkeh is se bahut zyada badha chadha kar unhein di gayi hain. Un ke liye muqarrara rozi aur woh qisam qisam ke mewa jaat hain. Woh makhdoom hain, zi-izzat hain, zi-ikram hain, hathon hath liye jate hain, badi aao bhagat hoti hai, bada adab lihaz rakha jata hai. Yeh nematon se pur jannaton mein hain. Wahan ke takhton par is tarah baithe hain ke kisi ki peeth kisi ki taraf nahin. Ek marfoo ghareeb hadith mein bhi hai ke is ayat ki tilawat kar ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har ek ki nigahain dusre ke chehre par padengi, aamne samne baithe hue honge. Is sharab ke daur un mein chal rahe honge jo jaari hai jis ke khatam ho jane kam ho jane ka mutlaq andesha nahin. Jo zahir batin mein aarasta hai khubiyan hain buraiyan nahin. Rang ki safed maze ki bahut achi lazeez. Na is ke peene se sardard ho na bak jhak lage, duniya ki sharab mein yeh aafatein thin pet ka dard sar ka dard behoshi bad-hawasi waghera lekin jannat ki sharab mein in mein se ek burai bhi majood nahin rahi. Dekhne mein khush rang, peene mein lazeez, fawaid mein aala, suroor-o-kaif mein umda lekin sudh budh door kar dene wali bad-mast bana dene wali nahin, na badbu-dar na bad-nazar na qabil-e-nafrat. Balkeh khushbu-dar khush-rang khush-zaiq khush-faida, is ke peene se pet mein dard nahin hota aur is ki kasrat zarar-rasan nahin khilaf-e-taba nahin. Sar bhari nahin ho jata chakkar nahin aate girani mehsoos nahin hoti. Hosh-o-hawas jate nahin rehte. Koi eeza takleef qai matli nahin hoti. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain duniya ki sharab mein char buraiyan hain, nasha, sardard, qai aur peshab.

Jannat ki sharab un tamam buraiyon se pak hai dekh lo Surah As-Saffat. Un ke paas neechi nigahon wali sharmili nazron wali pak daman afifa hoorein hain jin ki nigah apne khawandon ke chehre ke siwa kabhi kisi ke chehre par nahin padti aur na padengi. Badi badi moti moti raseeli aankhein hain husn-e-surat husn-e-seerat dono cheezein un mein majood hain. Jis tarah Hazrat Zulekha ne Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) mein yeh dono khubiyan dekhein. Aurton ne jab unhein taane dene shuru kiye toh ek din sab ko bula kar bitha liya aur Hazrat Yusuf ka poora banao singhar karakar bulaya aurton ki nigahain un ke jamal ko dekh kar khira ho gayin aur besakhta un ke munh se nikal gaya ke yeh toh farishte hain. Isi waqt kaha yahi toh hain jin ke bare mein tum sab mujhe malamat kar rahi thin wallah main ne in ko harchand apni taraf mail karna chaha lekin yeh pak daman hi raha. Yeh bawajood jamal-e-zahiri ke husn-e-batini bhi rakhta hai. Bada pakbaz amin parsa muttaqi parhezgar hai isi tarah hoorein hain ke jamal-e-zahiri ke sath hi batini khubi bhi apne andar rakhti hain. Phir un ka mazeed husn bayan ho raha hai ke un ka gora gora jism aur bhabooka sa rang aisa chamkila dilkash aur jazib-e-nazar hai ke goya mehfooz moti. Jis tak kisi ka hath na pahuncha ho, jo seep se na nikla ho jise zamane ki hawa na lagi ho jo apni aabdari mein bemisal ho aise hi unke achootay jism hain. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke goya woh anday ki tarah hain. Anday ke oopar ke chhalkay ke neeche chhotay chhalkay jaise un ke badan hain. Ek hadith mein Umm-e-Salama (R.A) ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hoor-e-ain se murad bahut badi aankhon wali siyah palkon wali hoorein hain. Phir poocha baid-e-maknoon se kya murad hai? Farmaya anday ke andar ki safed jhilli. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab log qabron se uthaye jayenge toh sab se pehle main khada kiya jaunga aur jabke woh janab-e-bari mein pesh honge toh main un ka khatib banunga aur jab woh ghamgeen ho rahe honge toh main unhein khushkhabriyan sunane wala hunga aur un ka sifarishi banunga jab ke yeh ruke hue honge. Hamd ka jhanda us din mere hath mein hoga. Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki aulad mein se sab se zyada Allah ke han ikram-o-izzat wala main hoon yeh main bator-e-fakhr ke nahin keh raha. Mere aage peeche qayam ke din ek hazar khadim ghoom rahe honge jo misl chhupe hue andon ya achootay motiyon ke honge wallahu a'lam bis-sawab.

Al-Ankabut: 57) har shakhs apne apne aamal mein mashghool hai magar woh jin ke dayen hath mein nama-e-aamal aa chuka hai isi tarah yahan par bhi apne khas bandon ka istisna kar liya ke woh almnak azabon se hisab ke phansaway se alag hain balkeh un ki buraiyon se darguzar farmaya gaya hai aur un ki nekiyan badha chadha kar ek ki das das guni balkeh saat saat sau guni kar ke balkeh is se bahut zyada badha chadha kar unhein di gayi hain. Yeh nematon se pur jannaton mein hain. Wahan ke takhton par is tarah baithe hain ke kisi ki peeth kisi ki taraf nahin. Ek marfoo ghareeb hadith mein bhi hai ke is ayat ki tilawat kar ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya har ek ki nigahain dusre ke chehre par padengi, aamne samne baithe hue honge. Is sharab ke daur un mein chal rahe honge jo jaari hai jis ke khatam ho jane kam ho jane ka mutlaq andesha nahin. Jo zahir batin mein aarasta hai khubiyan hain buraiyan nahin. Rang ki safed maze ki bahut achi lazeez. Na is ke peene se sardard ho na bak jhak lage, duniya ki sharab mein yeh aafatein thin pet ka dard sar ka dard behoshi bad-hawasi waghera lekin jannat ki sharab mein in mein se ek burai bhi majood nahin rahi. Dekhne mein khush rang, peene mein lazeez, fawaid mein aala, suroor-o-kaif mein umda lekin sudh budh door kar dene wali bad-mast bana dene wali nahin, na badbu-dar na bad-nazar na qabil-e-nafrat. Balkeh khushbu-dar khush-rang khush-zaiq khush-faida, is ke peene se pet mein dard nahin hota aur is ki kasrat zarar-rasan nahin khilaf-e-taba nahin. Sar bhari nahin ho jata chakkar nahin aate girani mehsoos nahin hoti. Hosh-o-hawas jate nahin rehte. Koi eeza takleef qai matli nahin hoti. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain duniya ki sharab mein char buraiyan hain, nasha, sardard, qai aur peshab.

Badi badi moti moti raseeli aankhein hain husn-e-surat husn-e-seerat dono cheezein un mein majood hain. Jis tarah Hazrat Zulekha ne Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) mein yeh dono khubiyan dekhein. Aurton ne jab unhein taane dene shuru kiye toh ek din sab ko bula kar bitha liya aur Hazrat Yusuf ka poora banao singhar karakar bulaya aurton ki nigahain un ke jamal ko dekh kar khira ho gayin aur besakhta un ke munh se nikal gaya ke yeh toh farishte hain. Isi waqt kaha yahi toh hain jin ke bare mein tum sab mujhe malamat kar rahi thin wallah main ne in ko harchand apni taraf mail karna chaha lekin yeh pak daman hi raha. Yeh bawajood jamal-e-zahiri ke husn-e-batini bhi rakhta hai. Bada pakbaz amin parsa muttaqi parhezgar hai isi tarah hoorein hain ke jamal-e-zahiri ke sath hi batini khubi bhi apne andar rakhti hain. Phir un ka mazeed husn bayan ho raha hai ke un ka gora gora jism aur bhabooka sa rang aisa chamkila dilkash aur jazib-e-nazar hai ke goya mehfooz moti. Jis tak kisi ka hath na pahuncha ho, jo seep se na nikla ho jise zamane ki hawa na lagi ho jo apni aabdari mein bemisal ho aise hi unke achootay jism hain. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke goya woh anday ki tarah hain. Anday ke oopar ke chhalkay ke neeche chhotay chhalkay jaise un ke badan hain. Ek hadith mein Umm-e-Salama (R.A) ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hoor-e-ain se murad bahut badi aankhon wali siyah palkon wali hoorein hain. Phir poocha baid-e-maknoon se kya murad hai? Farmaya anday ke andar ki safed jhilli. Hamd ka jhanda us din mere hath mein hoga. Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki aulad mein se sab se zyada Allah ke han ikram-o-izzat wala main hoon yeh main bator-e-fakhr ke nahin keh raha. Mere aage peeche qayam ke din ek hazar khadim ghoom rahe honge jo misl chhupe hue andon ya achootay motiyon ke honge wallahu a'lam bis-sawab.

Is sharab ke daur un mein chal rahe honge jo jaari hai jis ke khatam ho jane kam ho jane ka mutlaq andesha nahin. Jo zahir batin mein aarasta hai khubiyan hain buraiyan nahin. Rang ki safed maze ki bahut achi lazeez. Na is ke peene se sardard ho na bak jhak lage, duniya ki sharab mein yeh aafatein thin pet ka dard sar ka dard behoshi bad-hawasi waghera lekin jannat ki sharab mein in mein se ek burai bhi majood nahin rahi. Dekhne mein khush rang, peene mein lazeez, fawaid mein aala, suroor-o-kaif mein umda lekin sudh budh door kar dene wali bad-mast bana dene wali nahin, na badbu-dar na bad-nazar na qabil-e-nafrat. Balkeh khushbu-dar khush-rang khush-zaiq khush-faida, is ke peene se pet mein dard nahin hota aur is ki kasrat zarar-rasan nahin khilaf-e-taba nahin. Sar bhari nahin ho jata chakkar nahin aate girani mehsoos nahin hoti. Hosh-o-hawas jate nahin rehte. Koi eeza takleef qai matli nahin hoti. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain duniya ki sharab mein char buraiyan hain, nasha, sardard, qai aur peshab.

Jannat ki sharab un tamam buraiyon se pak hai dekh lo Surah As-Saffat. Un ke paas neechi nigahon wali sharmili nazron wali pak daman afifa hoorein hain jin ki nigah apne khawandon ke chehre ke siwa kabhi kisi ke chehre par nahin padti aur na padengi. Badi badi moti moti raseeli aankhein hain husn-e-surat husn-e-seerat dono cheezein un mein majood hain. Jis tarah Hazrat Zulekha ne Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) mein yeh dono khubiyan dekhein. Aurton ne jab unhein taane dene shuru kiye toh ek din sab ko bula kar bitha liya aur Hazrat Yusuf ka poora banao singhar karakar bulaya aurton ki nigahain un ke jamal ko dekh kar khira ho gayin aur besakhta un ke munh se nikal gaya ke yeh toh farishte hain. Isi waqt kaha yahi toh hain jin ke bare mein tum sab mujhe malamat kar rahi thin wallah main ne in ko harchand apni taraf mail karna chaha lekin yeh pak daman hi raha. Yeh bawajood jamal-e-zahiri ke husn-e-batini bhi rakhta hai. Bada pakbaz amin parsa muttaqi parhezgar hai isi tarah hoorein hain ke jamal-e-zahiri ke sath hi batini khubi bhi apne andar rakhti hain. Phir un ka mazeed husn bayan ho raha hai ke un ka gora gora jism aur bhabooka sa rang aisa chamkila dilkash aur jazib-e-nazar hai ke goya mehfooz moti. Jis tak kisi ka hath na pahuncha ho, jo seep se na nikla ho jise zamane ki hawa na lagi ho jo apni aabdari mein bemisal ho aise hi unke achootay jism hain. Yeh bhi kaha gaya ke goya woh anday ki tarah hain. Anday ke oopar ke chhalkay ke neeche chhotay chhalkay jaise un ke badan hain. Ek hadith mein Umm-e-Salama (R.A) ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hoor-e-ain se murad bahut badi aankhon wali siyah palkon wali hoorein hain. Phir poocha baid-e-maknoon se kya murad hai? Farmaya anday ke andar ki safed jhilli. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab log qabron se uthaye jayenge toh sab se pehle main khada kiya jaunga aur jabke woh janab-e-bari mein pesh honge toh main un ka khatib banunga aur jab woh ghamgeen ho rahe honge toh main unhein khushkhabriyan sunane wala hunga aur un ka sifarishi banunga jab ke yeh ruke hue honge. Hamd ka jhanda us din mere hath mein hoga. Hazrat Adam (A.S) ki aulad mein se sab se zyada Allah ke han ikram-o-izzat wala main hoon yeh main bator-e-fakhr ke nahin keh raha. Mere aage peeche qayam ke din ek hazar khadim ghoom rahe honge jo misl chhupe hue andon ya achootay motiyon ke honge wallahu a'lam bis-sawab.

Muttaqiyon ke liye najaat aur inamaat. Allah Ta'ala tamam logon se khitab kar ke farma raha hai ke tum almnak azab chakhne wale ho. Aur sirf isi ka badla diye jane wale ho jise tum ne kiya dhara hai. Phir apne mukhlis bandon ko is se alag kar leta hai jaise Wal-Asr mein farmaya ke tamam insan ghate mein hain. Magar imandar nek aamal. Aur Surah At-Teen mein farmaya hum ne insan ko bahut achi paidaish mein paida kiya phir use neeche se neecha kar diya magar jo iman laye aur jinhon ne nek aamal kiye. Aur Surah Maryam mein farmaya (Wa in-min-kum illa wariduha, kana ala rabbika hatman maqziya) (19. Maryam: 71), tum mein se har ek jahannam par warid hone wala hai yeh to tere Rab ne faisla kar diya hai aur yeh zaroori cheez hai lekin phir hum muttaqiyon ko najaat denge aur zalimon ko isi mein gire pade chhod denge. Surah Mudassir mein irshad hua hai. (Kullu nafsin za'iqatul maut, summa ilaina turja'oon) (29. Al-Ankabut: 57) har shakhs apne apne aamal mein mashghool hai magar woh jin ke dayen hath mein nama-e-aamal aa chuka hai isi tarah yahan par bhi apne khas bandon ka istisna kar liya ke woh almnak azabon se hisab ke phansaway se alag hain balkeh un ki buraiyon se darguzar farmaya gaya hai aur un ki nekiyan badha chadha kar ek ki das das guni balkeh saat saat sau guni kar ke balkeh is se bahut zyada badha chadha kar unhein di gayi hain. Un ke liye muqarrara rozi aur woh qisam qisam ke mewa jaat hain. Woh makhdoom hain, zi-izzat hain, zi-ikram hain, hathon hath liye jate hain, badi aao bhagat hoti hai, bada adab lihaz rakha jata hai. Muhsin-e-Maqrooz. Jab Jannati mauj mazay uratay huay, be-fikri aur farigh-ul-bali ke sath Jannat ke buland-o-bala khanton mein aish-o-ishrat ke sath aapas mein mil jul kar takhton par takiye lagaye baithay honge, hazarha pari-jamal khuddam saleeqa-sha'ari se kamar-basta khidmat par mamoor honge, hukm-e-ahkam de rahe honge, qisam qisam ke khanay peenay pehnay orhnay aur tarah tarah ki lazzaton se faida-mandi hasil karne mein masroof honge. Daur-e-sharab-e-tahoor chal raha hoga, wahan baton hi baton mein yeh zikr nikal aayega ke duniya mein kya kya guzray, kaisay kaisay din katay. Is par ek shakhs kahega meri suno, mera shaitan mera ek mushrik sathi tha jo mujh se aksar kaha karta tha ke ta'ajjub sa ta'ajjub hai ke tu is baat ko manta hai ke jab hum mar kar mitti mein mil kar mitti ho jayen, hum khokhli boseeda sari gali haddi ban jayen, us ke baad bhi hum hisab-kitab jaza-saza ke liye uthaye jayenge? Mujhe woh shakhs Jannat mein to nazar aata nahin, kya ajab ke woh Jahannam mein gaya ho, to agar chaho to mere sath chal kar jhank kar dekh lo Jahannam mein us ki kya durgat ho rahi hai. Ab jo jhanktay hain to dekhtay hain ke woh shakhs sar-ta-pa jal raha hai, khud woh aag ban raha hai, Jahannam ke darmiyan mein khara hai aur be-basi ke sath jal bhun raha hai aur ek usay hi kya dekhay ga ke tamam baray baray logon se Jahannam bhara hai. Ka'ab Ahbar R.H farmatay hain Jannat mein usay dekhtay hi kahega ke Hazrat aap ne to woh phanda dala tha ke mujhe tabah hi kar daltay, lekin Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne tumharay panjay se chura diya. Agar Allah Ta'ala ka fazl-o-karam mere shamil-e-haal na hota to bari buri durgat hoti aur main bhi teri sath khincha khincha yahin Jahannam mein aa jata aur jalta rehta. Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne teri tez-kalami charb-zabani se mujhe aafiyat mein rakha aur tere asar se mujhe mehfooz rakha. Tu ne to fitnay bapa karne mein koi kami baqi nahin rakhi thi. Ab Momin aur ek baat kehta hai jis mein us ki apni taskeen aur kamyabi ki khabar hai ke woh pehli maut to mar chuka hai, ab hamesha ke ghar mein hai, na yahan us par maut hai, na khauf hai, na azab hai, na wabaal hai aur yahi behtareen kamyabi falah-e-abadi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke Jannatiyon se kaha jayega ke apne a'amal ke badlay apni pasand ka jitna chahay khao piyo, is mein ishara hai is amr ki taraf ke Jannati Jannat mein marenge nahin, to woh yeh sun kar sawal karenge ke kya ab hamain maut to nahin aani? Kisi waqt azab to nahin hoga? To jawab milega nahin hargiz nahin. Chunke unhain khatka tha ke maut aa kar yeh lazzatain faut na kar de, jab yeh dharka hi jata raha to woh sukoon ka saans le kar kahenge shukr hai yeh to khuli kamyabi hai aur bari hi maqsad-yawari hai. Is ke baad farmaya aisay hi badlay ke liye aamilon ko amal karna chahiye, Qatada R.H to farmatay hain yeh Ahl-e-Jannat ka maqoola hai.

Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain Allah ka farman hai, matlab yeh hai ke in jaisi nematon aur rehmaton ke hasil karne ke liye logon ko duniya mein bharpoor raghbat ke sath amal karna chahiye, taake anjam-e-kaar in nematon ko hasil kar sakein. Isi aayat ke mazmoon se milta julta ek qissa hai, ise bhi sun lijiye. Do shakhs aapas mein shareek thay, un ke paas aath hazar ashrafiyan jama ho gayin. Ek chunke peshay-e-hirfay se waqif tha aur doosra nawaqif tha, is liye us waqif-kaar ne nawaqif se kaha ke ab hamara nibah mushkil hai, aap apna haq le kar alag ho jaiye kyunke aap kaam-kaaj se nawaqif hain. Chunancha dono ne apne apne hissay alag alag kar liye aur juda juda ho gaye. Phir us hirfay walay ne badshah ke mar jaane ke baad us ka shahi mahal ek hazar dinar mein khareeda aur apne is saathi ko bula kar use dikhaya aur kaha batao main ne kaisi cheez li? Us ne bari tareef ki aur yahan se bahar chala, Allah Ta'ala se dua ki aur kaha Allah! Is mere saathi ne to ek hazar dinar ka qasr-e-dunyawi khareed kiya hai aur main tujh se jannat ka mahal chahta hoon, main tere naam par tere maskeen bandon par ek hazar ashrafi kharch karta hoon. Chunancha us ne ek hazar dinar Allah ki rah kharch kar diye. Phir is dunyadar shakhs ne ek zamana ke baad ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke apna nikah kiya, dawat mein apne is puranay shareek ko bhi bulaya aur us se zikr kiya ke main ne ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke is aurat se shadi ki hai. Us ne is ki bhi tareef ki, bahar aa kar Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein ek hazar dinar diye aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala! Mere saathi ne itni hi raqam kharch kar ke yahan ek aurat hasil ki hai aur is raqam se tujh se main hoor-e-ain ka talib hoon aur woh raqam Allah ki rah mein sadqa kar di. Phir kuch muddat ke baad us ne ise bula kar kaha ke do hazar ke do bagh main ne khareed kiye hain, dekh lo kaise hain? Us ne dekh kar bohat tareef ki aur bahar aa kar apni aadat ke mutabiq Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz ki ke Allah! Mere saathi ne do hazar ke do bagh yahan ke khareeday hain, main tujh se jannat ke do bagh chahta hoon aur yeh do hazar dinar tere naam par sadqa hain, chunancha us raqam ko mustahiqeen mein taqseem kar diya. Phir farishta in dono ko faut kar ke le gaya, is sadqa karne walay ko jannat ke ek mahal mein pohanchaya gaya jahan par ek behtareen haseen aurat bhi use mili aur use do bagh bhi diye gaye aur woh woh nematein milein jinhein bajuz Allah ke aur koi nahin jaanta. To use us waqt apna woh saathi yaad aa gaya, farishtay ne bataya ke woh to jahannam mein hai, tum agar chaho to jhank kar use dekh sakte ho. Us ne jab use beech-e-jahannam mein jalta dekha to us ne kaha ke qareeb tha ke tu mujhe bhi chakma de jata aur yeh to Rabb ki meherbani hui ke main bach gaya.

Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh tashdeed wali qira'at ki mazeed ta'eed karti hai aur riwayat mein hai ke teen teen hazar dinar thay. Ek kafir tha, ek momin tha. Jab yeh momin apni kul raqam rah-e-Allah kharch kar chuka toh tokri sar par rakh kar kadal phawra le kar mazdoori ke liye chala. Use ek shakhs mila aur kaha agar tu mere janwaron ki sa'isi kare aur gobar uthaye toh main tujhe khane peene ko de doonga. Usne manzoor kar liya aur kaam shuru kar diya lekin yeh shakhs bada berahm badguman tha. Jahan usne kisi janwar ko bimar ya dubla patla dekha, us maskeen ki gardan todta, khoob marta peetta aur kehta ke iska dana toh chura leta hoga. Is musalman se yeh sakhti bardasht na ki gayi toh ek din usne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke main apne kafir shareek ke haan chala jaaun, uski kheti hai, baghat hain, wahan kaam kaaj kar doonga aur woh mujhe roti tukda de diya karega aur mujhe kya lena dena hai? Wahan jo pahuncha toh shahi thaath dekh kar hairan ho gaya, ek buland bala mahal hai, darban, dyodhi aur pehredar ki chowki, dar ghulam, londiyan sab majood hain. Yeh thitka aur darbanon ne use roka. Usne harchand kaha ke tum apne malik se mera zikr toh karo, unhon ne kaha ab waqt nahin, tum ek kone mein pade raho, subah jab woh niklein toh khud salam kar lena, agar tum sache ho toh woh tumhein pehchan hi lenge warna hamare hathon tumhari poori murammat ho jayegi. Is maskeen ko yahi karna pada, jo kambal ka tukda yeh jism se lapete hue tha, isi ko usne apna odhna bichona banaya aur ek kone mein dabak kar pad gaya. Subah ke waqt uske raste par ja khada hua, jab woh nikla aur us par nigah padi toh ta'ajub ho kar poocha ke hain? Yeh kya halat hai? Maal ka kya hua? Usne kaha woh kuch na pooch, is waqt toh mera kaam jo hai use poora kar do, yani mujhe ijazat do ke main tumhari kheti baadi ka kaam misl aur naukron ke karoon aur aap mujhe sirf khana de diya kijiye aur jab yeh kambal phat toot jaye toh ek kambal aur khareed dena. Usne kaha nahin nahin, main is se behtar sulook tumhare sath karne ke liye tayyar hoon lekin pehle tum yeh batao ke is raqam ko tumne kya kiya? Kaha main ne ise ek shakhs ko qarz di hai. Kaha kise? Kaha aise ko jo na le kar mukre na dene se inkar kare. Kaha woh kaun hai? Usne jawab diya woh Allah Ta'ala hai jo mera aur tera Rabb hai. Yeh sunte hi us kafir ne is musalman ke hath se hath chudaliya aur us se kaha ahmaq hua hai? Yeh ho bhi sakta hai ke hum mar kar mitti ho kar phir jiyen aur Allah hamain badle de? Ja jab tu aisa hi bouda aur aise aqeedon wala hai toh mujhe tujh se koi sar-o-kar nahin. Pas woh kafir toh maze udata raha aur yeh momin sakhti se din guzarta raha yahan tak ke donon ko maut aa gayi. Musalman ko jannat mein jo jo ne'matein aur rahmatein milin woh andaza-o-shumar se zyada thin. Usne jo dekha ke had-e-nazar se balkay sari duniya se zyada toh zameen hai aur beshumar darakht aur baghat hain aur ja-ba-ja nahrein aur chashme hain toh poocha yeh sab kya hai?

Jawab mila yeh sab aap ka hai. Kaha SubhanAllah! Allah ki yeh toh badi hi meherbani hai. Ab jo aage badha toh is qadar laundi ghulam dekhe ke ginti nahin ho sakti, poocha yeh kis ke hain? Kaha gaya sab aap ke. Isay aur ta'ajjub aur khushi hui. Phir jo aage badha toh surkh yaqoot ke mahal nazar aaye, ek moti ka mahal, har har mahal mein kayi kayi Hoor-e-Ain, saath hi ittila hui ke yeh sab bhi aap ka hai, phir toh is ki baachhein khil gayin. Kehne laga Allah jaane mera woh kafir saathi kahan hoga? Allah usay dikhaye ga ke woh beech jahannam mein jal raha hai. Ab in mein woh baatein hongi jin ka zikr yahan hua hai, pas momin par duniya mein jo balayein aayi thin unhein woh yaad kare ga toh maut se zyada bhari bala usay koi nazar na aaye gi.

Ka'ab Ahbar R.H farmatay hain Jannat mein usay dekhtay hi kahega ke Hazrat aap ne to woh phanda dala tha ke mujhe tabah hi kar daltay, lekin Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne tumharay panjay se chura diya. Agar Allah Ta'ala ka fazl-o-karam mere shamil-e-haal na hota to bari buri durgat hoti aur main bhi teri sath khincha khincha yahin Jahannam mein aa jata aur jalta rehta. Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne teri tez-kalami charb-zabani se mujhe aafiyat mein rakha aur tere asar se mujhe mehfooz rakha. Tu ne to fitnay bapa karne mein koi kami baqi nahin rakhi thi. Ab Momin aur ek baat kehta hai jis mein us ki apni taskeen aur kamyabi ki khabar hai ke woh pehli maut to mar chuka hai, ab hamesha ke ghar mein hai, na yahan us par maut hai, na khauf hai, na azab hai, na wabaal hai aur yahi behtareen kamyabi falah-e-abadi hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke Jannatiyon se kaha jayega ke apne a'amal ke badlay apni pasand ka jitna chahay khao piyo, is mein ishara hai is amr ki taraf ke Jannati Jannat mein marenge nahin, to woh yeh sun kar sawal karenge ke kya ab hamain maut to nahin aani? Kisi waqt azab to nahin hoga? To jawab milega nahin hargiz nahin. Chunke unhain khatka tha ke maut aa kar yeh lazzatain faut na kar de, jab yeh dharka hi jata raha to woh sukoon ka saans le kar kahenge shukr hai yeh to khuli kamyabi hai aur bari hi maqsad-yawari hai. Is ke baad farmaya aisay hi badlay ke liye aamilon ko amal karna chahiye, Qatada R.H to farmatay hain yeh Ahl-e-Jannat ka maqoola hai.

Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain Allah ka farman hai, matlab yeh hai ke in jaisi nematon aur rehmaton ke hasil karne ke liye logon ko duniya mein bharpoor raghbat ke sath amal karna chahiye, taake anjam-e-kaar in nematon ko hasil kar sakein. Isi aayat ke mazmoon se milta julta ek qissa hai, ise bhi sun lijiye. Do shakhs aapas mein shareek thay, un ke paas aath hazar ashrafiyan jama ho gayin. Ek chunke peshay-e-hirfay se waqif tha aur doosra nawaqif tha, is liye us waqif-kaar ne nawaqif se kaha ke ab hamara nibah mushkil hai, aap apna haq le kar alag ho jaiye kyunke aap kaam-kaaj se nawaqif hain. Chunancha dono ne apne apne hissay alag alag kar liye aur juda juda ho gaye. Phir us hirfay walay ne badshah ke mar jaane ke baad us ka shahi mahal ek hazar dinar mein khareeda aur apne is saathi ko bula kar use dikhaya aur kaha batao main ne kaisi cheez li? Us ne bari tareef ki aur yahan se bahar chala, Allah Ta'ala se dua ki aur kaha Allah! Is mere saathi ne to ek hazar dinar ka qasr-e-dunyawi khareed kiya hai aur main tujh se jannat ka mahal chahta hoon, main tere naam par tere maskeen bandon par ek hazar ashrafi kharch karta hoon. Chunancha us ne ek hazar dinar Allah ki rah kharch kar diye. Phir is dunyadar shakhs ne ek zamana ke baad ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke apna nikah kiya, dawat mein apne is puranay shareek ko bhi bulaya aur us se zikr kiya ke main ne ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke is aurat se shadi ki hai. Us ne is ki bhi tareef ki, bahar aa kar Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein ek hazar dinar diye aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala! Mere saathi ne itni hi raqam kharch kar ke yahan ek aurat hasil ki hai aur is raqam se tujh se main hoor-e-ain ka talib hoon aur woh raqam Allah ki rah mein sadqa kar di. Phir kuch muddat ke baad us ne ise bula kar kaha ke do hazar ke do bagh main ne khareed kiye hain, dekh lo kaise hain? Us ne dekh kar bohat tareef ki aur bahar aa kar apni aadat ke mutabiq Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz ki ke Allah! Mere saathi ne do hazar ke do bagh yahan ke khareeday hain, main tujh se jannat ke do bagh chahta hoon aur yeh do hazar dinar tere naam par sadqa hain, chunancha us raqam ko mustahiqeen mein taqseem kar diya. Phir farishta in dono ko faut kar ke le gaya, is sadqa karne walay ko jannat ke ek mahal mein pohanchaya gaya jahan par ek behtareen haseen aurat bhi use mili aur use do bagh bhi diye gaye aur woh woh nematein milein jinhein bajuz Allah ke aur koi nahin jaanta. To use us waqt apna woh saathi yaad aa gaya, farishtay ne bataya ke woh to jahannam mein hai, tum agar chaho to jhank kar use dekh sakte ho. Us ne jab use beech-e-jahannam mein jalta dekha to us ne kaha ke qareeb tha ke tu mujhe bhi chakma de jata aur yeh to Rabb ki meherbani hui ke main bach gaya.

Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh tashdeed wali qira'at ki mazeed ta'eed karti hai aur riwayat mein hai ke teen teen hazar dinar thay. Ek kafir tha, ek momin tha. Jab yeh momin apni kul raqam rah-e-Allah kharch kar chuka toh tokri sar par rakh kar kadal phawra le kar mazdoori ke liye chala. Use ek shakhs mila aur kaha agar tu mere janwaron ki sa'isi kare aur gobar uthaye toh main tujhe khane peene ko de doonga. Usne manzoor kar liya aur kaam shuru kar diya lekin yeh shakhs bada berahm badguman tha. Jahan usne kisi janwar ko bimar ya dubla patla dekha, us maskeen ki gardan todta, khoob marta peetta aur kehta ke iska dana toh chura leta hoga. Is musalman se yeh sakhti bardasht na ki gayi toh ek din usne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke main apne kafir shareek ke haan chala jaaun, uski kheti hai, baghat hain, wahan kaam kaaj kar doonga aur woh mujhe roti tukda de diya karega aur mujhe kya lena dena hai? Wahan jo pahuncha toh shahi thaath dekh kar hairan ho gaya, ek buland bala mahal hai, darban, dyodhi aur pehredar ki chowki, dar ghulam, londiyan sab majood hain. Yeh thitka aur darbanon ne use roka. Usne harchand kaha ke tum apne malik se mera zikr toh karo, unhon ne kaha ab waqt nahin, tum ek kone mein pade raho, subah jab woh niklein toh khud salam kar lena, agar tum sache ho toh woh tumhein pehchan hi lenge warna hamare hathon tumhari poori murammat ho jayegi. Is maskeen ko yahi karna pada, jo kambal ka tukda yeh jism se lapete hue tha, isi ko usne apna odhna bichona banaya aur ek kone mein dabak kar pad gaya. Subah ke waqt uske raste par ja khada hua, jab woh nikla aur us par nigah padi toh ta'ajub ho kar poocha ke hain? Yeh kya halat hai? Maal ka kya hua? Usne kaha woh kuch na pooch, is waqt toh mera kaam jo hai use poora kar do, yani mujhe ijazat do ke main tumhari kheti baadi ka kaam misl aur naukron ke karoon aur aap mujhe sirf khana de diya kijiye aur jab yeh kambal phat toot jaye toh ek kambal aur khareed dena. Usne kaha nahin nahin, main is se behtar sulook tumhare sath karne ke liye tayyar hoon lekin pehle tum yeh batao ke is raqam ko tumne kya kiya? Kaha main ne ise ek shakhs ko qarz di hai. Kaha kise? Kaha aise ko jo na le kar mukre na dene se inkar kare. Kaha woh kaun hai? Usne jawab diya woh Allah Ta'ala hai jo mera aur tera Rabb hai. Yeh sunte hi us kafir ne is musalman ke hath se hath chudaliya aur us se kaha ahmaq hua hai? Yeh ho bhi sakta hai ke hum mar kar mitti ho kar phir jiyen aur Allah hamain badle de? Ja jab tu aisa hi bouda aur aise aqeedon wala hai toh mujhe tujh se koi sar-o-kar nahin. Pas woh kafir toh maze udata raha aur yeh momin sakhti se din guzarta raha yahan tak ke donon ko maut aa gayi. Usne jo dekha ke had-e-nazar se balkay sari duniya se zyada toh zameen hai aur beshumar darakht aur baghat hain aur ja-ba-ja nahrein aur chashme hain toh poocha yeh sab kya hai?

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka farman hai ke Jannatiyon se kaha jayega ke apne a'amal ke badlay apni pasand ka jitna chahay khao piyo, is mein ishara hai is amr ki taraf ke Jannati Jannat mein marenge nahin, to woh yeh sun kar sawal karenge ke kya ab hamain maut to nahin aani? Kisi waqt azab to nahin hoga? To jawab milega nahin hargiz nahin. Chunke unhain khatka tha ke maut aa kar yeh lazzatain faut na kar de, jab yeh dharka hi jata raha to woh sukoon ka saans le kar kahenge shukr hai yeh to khuli kamyabi hai aur bari hi maqsad-yawari hai. Is ke baad farmaya aisay hi badlay ke liye aamilon ko amal karna chahiye, Qatada R.H to farmatay hain yeh Ahl-e-Jannat ka maqoola hai.

Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) farmate hain Allah ka farman hai, matlab yeh hai ke in jaisi nematon aur rehmaton ke hasil karne ke liye logon ko duniya mein bharpoor raghbat ke sath amal karna chahiye, taake anjam-e-kaar in nematon ko hasil kar sakein. Isi aayat ke mazmoon se milta julta ek qissa hai, ise bhi sun lijiye. Do shakhs aapas mein shareek thay, un ke paas aath hazar ashrafiyan jama ho gayin. Ek chunke peshay-e-hirfay se waqif tha aur doosra nawaqif tha, is liye us waqif-kaar ne nawaqif se kaha ke ab hamara nibah mushkil hai, aap apna haq le kar alag ho jaiye kyunke aap kaam-kaaj se nawaqif hain. Chunancha dono ne apne apne hissay alag alag kar liye aur juda juda ho gaye. Phir us hirfay walay ne badshah ke mar jaane ke baad us ka shahi mahal ek hazar dinar mein khareeda aur apne is saathi ko bula kar use dikhaya aur kaha batao main ne kaisi cheez li? Us ne bari tareef ki aur yahan se bahar chala, Allah Ta'ala se dua ki aur kaha Allah! Is mere saathi ne to ek hazar dinar ka qasr-e-dunyawi khareed kiya hai aur main tujh se jannat ka mahal chahta hoon, main tere naam par tere maskeen bandon par ek hazar ashrafi kharch karta hoon. Chunancha us ne ek hazar dinar Allah ki rah kharch kar diye. Phir is dunyadar shakhs ne ek zamana ke baad ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke apna nikah kiya, dawat mein apne is puranay shareek ko bhi bulaya aur us se zikr kiya ke main ne ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke is aurat se shadi ki hai. Us ne is ki bhi tareef ki, bahar aa kar Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein ek hazar dinar diye aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala! Mere saathi ne itni hi raqam kharch kar ke yahan ek aurat hasil ki hai aur is raqam se tujh se main hoor-e-ain ka talib hoon aur woh raqam Allah ki rah mein sadqa kar di. Phir kuch muddat ke baad us ne ise bula kar kaha ke do hazar ke do bagh main ne khareed kiye hain, dekh lo kaise hain? Us ne dekh kar bohat tareef ki aur bahar aa kar apni aadat ke mutabiq Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz ki ke Allah! Mere saathi ne do hazar ke do bagh yahan ke khareeday hain, main tujh se jannat ke do bagh chahta hoon aur yeh do hazar dinar tere naam par sadqa hain, chunancha us raqam ko mustahiqeen mein taqseem kar diya. Phir farishta in dono ko faut kar ke le gaya, is sadqa karne walay ko jannat ke ek mahal mein pohanchaya gaya jahan par ek behtareen haseen aurat bhi use mili aur use do bagh bhi diye gaye aur woh woh nematein milein jinhein bajuz Allah ke aur koi nahin jaanta. To use us waqt apna woh saathi yaad aa gaya, farishtay ne bataya ke woh to jahannam mein hai, tum agar chaho to jhank kar use dekh sakte ho. Us ne jab use beech-e-jahannam mein jalta dekha to us ne kaha ke qareeb tha ke tu mujhe bhi chakma de jata aur yeh to Rabb ki meherbani hui ke main bach gaya.

Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh tashdeed wali qira'at ki mazeed ta'eed karti hai aur riwayat mein hai ke teen teen hazar dinar thay. Ek kafir tha, ek momin tha. Jab yeh momin apni kul raqam rah-e-Allah kharch kar chuka toh tokri sar par rakh kar kadal phawra le kar mazdoori ke liye chala. Use ek shakhs mila aur kaha agar tu mere janwaron ki sa'isi kare aur gobar uthaye toh main tujhe khane peene ko de doonga. Usne manzoor kar liya aur kaam shuru kar diya lekin yeh shakhs bada berahm badguman tha. Jahan usne kisi janwar ko bimar ya dubla patla dekha, us maskeen ki gardan todta, khoob marta peetta aur kehta ke iska dana toh chura leta hoga. Is musalman se yeh sakhti bardasht na ki gayi toh ek din usne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke main apne kafir shareek ke haan chala jaaun, uski kheti hai, baghat hain, wahan kaam kaaj kar doonga aur woh mujhe roti tukda de diya karega aur mujhe kya lena dena hai? Wahan jo pahuncha toh shahi thaath dekh kar hairan ho gaya, ek buland bala mahal hai, darban, dyodhi aur pehredar ki chowki, dar ghulam, londiyan sab majood hain. Yeh thitka aur darbanon ne use roka. Usne harchand kaha ke tum apne malik se mera zikr toh karo, unhon ne kaha ab waqt nahin, tum ek kone mein pade raho, subah jab woh niklein toh khud salam kar lena, agar tum sache ho toh woh tumhein pehchan hi lenge warna hamare hathon tumhari poori murammat ho jayegi. Is maskeen ko yahi karna pada, jo kambal ka tukda yeh jism se lapete hue tha, isi ko usne apna odhna bichona banaya aur ek kone mein dabak kar pad gaya. Subah ke waqt uske raste par ja khada hua, jab woh nikla aur us par nigah padi toh ta'ajub ho kar poocha ke hain? Yeh kya halat hai? Maal ka kya hua? Usne kaha woh kuch na pooch, is waqt toh mera kaam jo hai use poora kar do, yani mujhe ijazat do ke main tumhari kheti baadi ka kaam misl aur naukron ke karoon aur aap mujhe sirf khana de diya kijiye aur jab yeh kambal phat toot jaye toh ek kambal aur khareed dena. Usne kaha nahin nahin, main is se behtar sulook tumhare sath karne ke liye tayyar hoon lekin pehle tum yeh batao ke is raqam ko tumne kya kiya? Kaha main ne ise ek shakhs ko qarz di hai. Kaha kise? Kaha aise ko jo na le kar mukre na dene se inkar kare. Kaha woh kaun hai? Usne jawab diya woh Allah Ta'ala hai jo mera aur tera Rabb hai. Yeh sunte hi us kafir ne is musalman ke hath se hath chudaliya aur us se kaha ahmaq hua hai? Yeh ho bhi sakta hai ke hum mar kar mitti ho kar phir jiyen aur Allah hamain badle de? Ja jab tu aisa hi bouda aur aise aqeedon wala hai toh mujhe tujh se koi sar-o-kar nahin. Pas woh kafir toh maze udata raha aur yeh momin sakhti se din guzarta raha yahan tak ke donon ko maut aa gayi. Musalman ko jannat mein jo jo ne'matein aur rahmatein milin woh andaza-o-shumar se zyada thin. Usne jo dekha ke had-e-nazar se balkay sari duniya se zyada toh zameen hai aur beshumar darakht aur baghat hain aur ja-ba-ja nahrein aur chashme hain toh poocha yeh sab kya hai?

Isi aayat ke mazmoon se milta julta ek qissa hai, ise bhi sun lijiye. Do shakhs aapas mein shareek thay, un ke paas aath hazar ashrafiyan jama ho gayin. Ek chunke peshay-e-hirfay se waqif tha aur doosra nawaqif tha, is liye us waqif-kaar ne nawaqif se kaha ke ab hamara nibah mushkil hai, aap apna haq le kar alag ho jaiye kyunke aap kaam-kaaj se nawaqif hain. Chunancha dono ne apne apne hissay alag alag kar liye aur juda juda ho gaye. Phir us hirfay walay ne badshah ke mar jaane ke baad us ka shahi mahal ek hazar dinar mein khareeda aur apne is saathi ko bula kar use dikhaya aur kaha batao main ne kaisi cheez li? Us ne bari tareef ki aur yahan se bahar chala, Allah Ta'ala se dua ki aur kaha Allah! Is mere saathi ne to ek hazar dinar ka qasr-e-dunyawi khareed kiya hai aur main tujh se jannat ka mahal chahta hoon, main tere naam par tere maskeen bandon par ek hazar ashrafi kharch karta hoon. Chunancha us ne ek hazar dinar Allah ki rah kharch kar diye. Phir is dunyadar shakhs ne ek zamana ke baad ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke apna nikah kiya, dawat mein apne is puranay shareek ko bhi bulaya aur us se zikr kiya ke main ne ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke is aurat se shadi ki hai. Us ne is ki bhi tareef ki, bahar aa kar Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein ek hazar dinar diye aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala! Mere saathi ne itni hi raqam kharch kar ke yahan ek aurat hasil ki hai aur is raqam se tujh se main hoor-e-ain ka talib hoon aur woh raqam Allah ki rah mein sadqa kar di. Phir kuch muddat ke baad us ne ise bula kar kaha ke do hazar ke do bagh main ne khareed kiye hain, dekh lo kaise hain? Us ne dekh kar bohat tareef ki aur bahar aa kar apni aadat ke mutabiq Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz ki ke Allah! Mere saathi ne do hazar ke do bagh yahan ke khareeday hain, main tujh se jannat ke do bagh chahta hoon aur yeh do hazar dinar tere naam par sadqa hain, chunancha us raqam ko mustahiqeen mein taqseem kar diya. Phir farishta in dono ko faut kar ke le gaya, is sadqa karne walay ko jannat ke ek mahal mein pohanchaya gaya jahan par ek behtareen haseen aurat bhi use mili aur use do bagh bhi diye gaye aur woh woh nematein milein jinhein bajuz Allah ke aur koi nahin jaanta. To use us waqt apna woh saathi yaad aa gaya, farishtay ne bataya ke woh to jahannam mein hai, tum agar chaho to jhank kar use dekh sakte ho. Us ne jab use beech-e-jahannam mein jalta dekha to us ne kaha ke qareeb tha ke tu mujhe bhi chakma de jata aur yeh to Rabb ki meherbani hui ke main bach gaya.

Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh tashdeed wali qira'at ki mazeed ta'eed karti hai aur riwayat mein hai ke teen teen hazar dinar thay. Ek kafir tha, ek momin tha. Jab yeh momin apni kul raqam rah-e-Allah kharch kar chuka toh tokri sar par rakh kar kadal phawra le kar mazdoori ke liye chala. Use ek shakhs mila aur kaha agar tu mere janwaron ki sa'isi kare aur gobar uthaye toh main tujhe khane peene ko de doonga. Usne manzoor kar liya aur kaam shuru kar diya lekin yeh shakhs bada berahm badguman tha. Jahan usne kisi janwar ko bimar ya dubla patla dekha, us maskeen ki gardan todta, khoob marta peetta aur kehta ke iska dana toh chura leta hoga. Is musalman se yeh sakhti bardasht na ki gayi toh ek din usne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke main apne kafir shareek ke haan chala jaaun, uski kheti hai, baghat hain, wahan kaam kaaj kar doonga aur woh mujhe roti tukda de diya karega aur mujhe kya lena dena hai? Wahan jo pahuncha toh shahi thaath dekh kar hairan ho gaya, ek buland bala mahal hai, darban, dyodhi aur pehredar ki chowki, dar ghulam, londiyan sab majood hain. Yeh thitka aur darbanon ne use roka. Usne harchand kaha ke tum apne malik se mera zikr toh karo, unhon ne kaha ab waqt nahin, tum ek kone mein pade raho, subah jab woh niklein toh khud salam kar lena, agar tum sache ho toh woh tumhein pehchan hi lenge warna hamare hathon tumhari poori murammat ho jayegi. Is maskeen ko yahi karna pada, jo kambal ka tukda yeh jism se lapete hue tha, isi ko usne apna odhna bichona banaya aur ek kone mein dabak kar pad gaya. Subah ke waqt uske raste par ja khada hua, jab woh nikla aur us par nigah padi toh ta'ajub ho kar poocha ke hain? Yeh kya halat hai? Maal ka kya hua? Usne kaha woh kuch na pooch, is waqt toh mera kaam jo hai use poora kar do, yani mujhe ijazat do ke main tumhari kheti baadi ka kaam misl aur naukron ke karoon aur aap mujhe sirf khana de diya kijiye aur jab yeh kambal phat toot jaye toh ek kambal aur khareed dena. Usne kaha nahin nahin, main is se behtar sulook tumhare sath karne ke liye tayyar hoon lekin pehle tum yeh batao ke is raqam ko tumne kya kiya? Kaha main ne ise ek shakhs ko qarz di hai. Kaha kise? Kaha aise ko jo na le kar mukre na dene se inkar kare. Kaha woh kaun hai? Usne jawab diya woh Allah Ta'ala hai jo mera aur tera Rabb hai. Yeh sunte hi us kafir ne is musalman ke hath se hath chudaliya aur us se kaha ahmaq hua hai? Yeh ho bhi sakta hai ke hum mar kar mitti ho kar phir jiyen aur Allah hamain badle de? Ja jab tu aisa hi bouda aur aise aqeedon wala hai toh mujhe tujh se koi sar-o-kar nahin. Pas woh kafir toh maze udata raha aur yeh momin sakhti se din guzarta raha yahan tak ke donon ko maut aa gayi. Usne jo dekha ke had-e-nazar se balkay sari duniya se zyada toh zameen hai aur beshumar darakht aur baghat hain aur ja-ba-ja nahrein aur chashme hain toh poocha yeh sab kya hai?

Phir is dunyadar shakhs ne ek zamana ke baad ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke apna nikah kiya, dawat mein apne is puranay shareek ko bhi bulaya aur us se zikr kiya ke main ne ek hazar dinar kharch kar ke is aurat se shadi ki hai. Us ne is ki bhi tareef ki, bahar aa kar Allah Ta'ala ki rah mein ek hazar dinar diye aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke Bari Ta'ala! Mere saathi ne itni hi raqam kharch kar ke yahan ek aurat hasil ki hai aur is raqam se tujh se main hoor-e-ain ka talib hoon aur woh raqam Allah ki rah mein sadqa kar di. Phir kuch muddat ke baad us ne ise bula kar kaha ke do hazar ke do bagh main ne khareed kiye hain, dekh lo kaise hain? Us ne dekh kar bohat tareef ki aur bahar aa kar apni aadat ke mutabiq Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala mein arz ki ke Allah! Mere saathi ne do hazar ke do bagh yahan ke khareeday hain, main tujh se jannat ke do bagh chahta hoon aur yeh do hazar dinar tere naam par sadqa hain, chunancha us raqam ko mustahiqeen mein taqseem kar diya. Phir farishta in dono ko faut kar ke le gaya, is sadqa karne walay ko jannat ke ek mahal mein pohanchaya gaya jahan par ek behtareen haseen aurat bhi use mili aur use do bagh bhi diye gaye aur woh woh nematein milein jinhein bajuz Allah ke aur koi nahin jaanta. To use us waqt apna woh saathi yaad aa gaya, farishtay ne bataya ke woh to jahannam mein hai, tum agar chaho to jhank kar use dekh sakte ho. Us ne jab use beech-e-jahannam mein jalta dekha to us ne kaha ke qareeb tha ke tu mujhe bhi chakma de jata aur yeh to Rabb ki meherbani hui ke main bach gaya.

Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh tashdeed wali qira'at ki mazeed ta'eed karti hai aur riwayat mein hai ke teen teen hazar dinar thay. Ek kafir tha, ek momin tha. Jab yeh momin apni kul raqam rah-e-Allah kharch kar chuka toh tokri sar par rakh kar kadal phawra le kar mazdoori ke liye chala. Use ek shakhs mila aur kaha agar tu mere janwaron ki sa'isi kare aur gobar uthaye toh main tujhe khane peene ko de doonga. Usne manzoor kar liya aur kaam shuru kar diya lekin yeh shakhs bada berahm badguman tha. Jahan usne kisi janwar ko bimar ya dubla patla dekha, us maskeen ki gardan todta, khoob marta peetta aur kehta ke iska dana toh chura leta hoga. Is musalman se yeh sakhti bardasht na ki gayi toh ek din usne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke main apne kafir shareek ke haan chala jaaun, uski kheti hai, baghat hain, wahan kaam kaaj kar doonga aur woh mujhe roti tukda de diya karega aur mujhe kya lena dena hai? Wahan jo pahuncha toh shahi thaath dekh kar hairan ho gaya, ek buland bala mahal hai, darban, dyodhi aur pehredar ki chowki, dar ghulam, londiyan sab majood hain. Yeh thitka aur darbanon ne use roka. Usne harchand kaha ke tum apne malik se mera zikr toh karo, unhon ne kaha ab waqt nahin, tum ek kone mein pade raho, subah jab woh niklein toh khud salam kar lena, agar tum sache ho toh woh tumhein pehchan hi lenge warna hamare hathon tumhari poori murammat ho jayegi. Is maskeen ko yahi karna pada, jo kambal ka tukda yeh jism se lapete hue tha, isi ko usne apna odhna bichona banaya aur ek kone mein dabak kar pad gaya. Subah ke waqt uske raste par ja khada hua, jab woh nikla aur us par nigah padi toh ta'ajub ho kar poocha ke hain? Yeh kya halat hai? Maal ka kya hua? Usne kaha woh kuch na pooch, is waqt toh mera kaam jo hai use poora kar do, yani mujhe ijazat do ke main tumhari kheti baadi ka kaam misl aur naukron ke karoon aur aap mujhe sirf khana de diya kijiye aur jab yeh kambal phat toot jaye toh ek kambal aur khareed dena. Usne kaha nahin nahin, main is se behtar sulook tumhare sath karne ke liye tayyar hoon lekin pehle tum yeh batao ke is raqam ko tumne kya kiya? Kaha main ne ise ek shakhs ko qarz di hai. Kaha kise? Kaha aise ko jo na le kar mukre na dene se inkar kare. Kaha woh kaun hai? Usne jawab diya woh Allah Ta'ala hai jo mera aur tera Rabb hai. Yeh sunte hi us kafir ne is musalman ke hath se hath chudaliya aur us se kaha ahmaq hua hai? Yeh ho bhi sakta hai ke hum mar kar mitti ho kar phir jiyen aur Allah hamain badle de? Ja jab tu aisa hi bouda aur aise aqeedon wala hai toh mujhe tujh se koi sar-o-kar nahin. Pas woh kafir toh maze udata raha aur yeh momin sakhti se din guzarta raha yahan tak ke donon ko maut aa gayi. Usne jo dekha ke had-e-nazar se balkay sari duniya se zyada toh zameen hai aur beshumar darakht aur baghat hain aur ja-ba-ja nahrein aur chashme hain toh poocha yeh sab kya hai?

To use us waqt apna woh saathi yaad aa gaya, farishtay ne bataya ke woh to jahannam mein hai, tum agar chaho to jhank kar use dekh sakte ho. Us ne jab use beech-e-jahannam mein jalta dekha to us ne kaha ke qareeb tha ke tu mujhe bhi chakma de jata aur yeh to Rabb ki meherbani hui ke main bach gaya.

Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain yeh tashdeed wali qira'at ki mazeed ta'eed karti hai aur riwayat mein hai ke teen teen hazar dinar thay. Ek kafir tha, ek momin tha. Jab yeh momin apni kul raqam rah-e-Allah kharch kar chuka toh tokri sar par rakh kar kadal phawra le kar mazdoori ke liye chala. Use ek shakhs mila aur kaha agar tu mere janwaron ki sa'isi kare aur gobar uthaye toh main tujhe khane peene ko de doonga. Usne manzoor kar liya aur kaam shuru kar diya lekin yeh shakhs bada berahm badguman tha. Jahan usne kisi janwar ko bimar ya dubla patla dekha, us maskeen ki gardan todta, khoob marta peetta aur kehta ke iska dana toh chura leta hoga. Is musalman se yeh sakhti bardasht na ki gayi toh ek din usne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke main apne kafir shareek ke haan chala jaaun, uski kheti hai, baghat hain, wahan kaam kaaj kar doonga aur woh mujhe roti tukda de diya karega aur mujhe kya lena dena hai? Wahan jo pahuncha toh shahi thaath dekh kar hairan ho gaya, ek buland bala mahal hai, darban, dyodhi aur pehredar ki chowki, dar ghulam, londiyan sab majood hain. Yeh thitka aur darbanon ne use roka. Usne harchand kaha ke tum apne malik se mera zikr toh karo, unhon ne kaha ab waqt nahin, tum ek kone mein pade raho, subah jab woh niklein toh khud salam kar lena, agar tum sache ho toh woh tumhein pehchan hi lenge warna hamare hathon tumhari poori murammat ho jayegi. Is maskeen ko yahi karna pada, jo kambal ka tukda yeh jism se lapete hue tha, isi ko usne apna odhna bichona banaya aur ek kone mein dabak kar pad gaya. Subah ke waqt uske raste par ja khada hua, jab woh nikla aur us par nigah padi toh ta'ajub ho kar poocha ke hain? Yeh kya halat hai? Maal ka kya hua? Usne kaha woh kuch na pooch, is waqt toh mera kaam jo hai use poora kar do, yani mujhe ijazat do ke main tumhari kheti baadi ka kaam misl aur naukron ke karoon aur aap mujhe sirf khana de diya kijiye aur jab yeh kambal phat toot jaye toh ek kambal aur khareed dena. Usne kaha nahin nahin, main is se behtar sulook tumhare sath karne ke liye tayyar hoon lekin pehle tum yeh batao ke is raqam ko tumne kya kiya? Kaha main ne ise ek shakhs ko qarz di hai. Kaha kise? Kaha aise ko jo na le kar mukre na dene se inkar kare. Kaha woh kaun hai? Usne jawab diya woh Allah Ta'ala hai jo mera aur tera Rabb hai. Yeh sunte hi us kafir ne is musalman ke hath se hath chudaliya aur us se kaha ahmaq hua hai? Yeh ho bhi sakta hai ke hum mar kar mitti ho kar phir jiyen aur Allah hamain badle de? Ja jab tu aisa hi bouda aur aise aqeedon wala hai toh mujhe tujh se koi sar-o-kar nahin. Pas woh kafir toh maze udata raha aur yeh momin sakhti se din guzarta raha yahan tak ke donon ko maut aa gayi. Musalman ko jannat mein jo jo ne'matein aur rahmatein milin woh andaza-o-shumar se zyada thin. Usne jo dekha ke had-e-nazar se balkay sari duniya se zyada toh zameen hai aur beshumar darakht aur baghat hain aur ja-ba-ja nahrein aur chashme hain toh poocha yeh sab kya hai?

Jawab mila yeh sab aap ka hai. Kaha SubhanAllah! Allah ki yeh toh badi hi meherbani hai. Ab jo aage badha toh is qadar laundi ghulam dekhe ke ginti nahin ho sakti, poocha yeh kis ke hain? Kaha gaya sab aap ke. Isay aur ta'ajjub aur khushi hui. Phir jo aage badha toh surkh yaqoot ke mahal nazar aaye, ek moti ka mahal, har har mahal mein kayi kayi Hoor-e-Ain, saath hi ittila hui ke yeh sab bhi aap ka hai, phir toh is ki baachhein khil gayin. Kehne laga Allah jaane mera woh kafir saathi kahan hoga? Allah usay dikhaye ga ke woh beech jahannam mein jal raha hai. Ab in mein woh baatein hongi jin ka zikr yahan hua hai, pas momin par duniya mein jo balayein aayi thin unhein woh yaad kare ga toh maut se zyada bhari bala usay koi nazar na aaye gi.

Muhsin-e-Maqrooz. Jab Jannati mauj mazay uratay huay, be-fikri aur farigh-ul-bali ke sath Jannat ke buland-o-bala khanton mein aish-o-ishrat ke sath aapas mein mil jul kar takhton par takiye lagaye baithay honge, hazarha pari-jamal khuddam saleeqa-sha'ari se kamar-basta khidmat par mamoor honge, hukm-e-ahkam de rahe honge, qisam qisam ke khanay peenay pehnay orhnay aur tarah tarah ki lazzaton se faida-mandi hasil karne mein masroof honge. Daur-e-sharab-e-tahoor chal raha hoga, wahan baton hi baton mein yeh zikr nikal aayega ke duniya mein kya kya guzray, kaisay kaisay din katay. Ka'ab Ahbar R.H farmatay hain Jannat mein usay dekhtay hi kahega ke Hazrat aap ne to woh phanda dala tha ke mujhe tabah hi kar daltay, lekin Allah ka shukr hai ke us ne tumharay panjay se chura diya.
