Is musalman se yeh sakhti bardasht na ki gayi toh ek din usne apne dil mein khayal kiya ke main apne kafir shareek ke haan chala jaaun, uski kheti hai, baghat hain, wahan kaam kaaj kar doonga aur woh mujhe roti tukda de diya karega aur mujhe kya lena dena hai? Wahan jo pahuncha toh shahi thaath dekh kar hairan ho gaya, ek buland bala mahal hai, darban, dyodhi aur pehredar ki chowki, dar ghulam, londiyan sab majood hain. Yeh thitka aur darbanon ne use roka. Usne harchand kaha ke tum apne malik se mera zikr toh karo, unhon ne kaha ab waqt nahin, tum ek kone mein pade raho, subah jab woh niklein toh khud salam kar lena, agar tum sache ho toh woh tumhein pehchan hi lenge warna hamare hathon tumhari poori murammat ho jayegi. Is maskeen ko yahi karna pada, jo kambal ka tukda yeh jism se lapete hue tha, isi ko usne apna odhna bichona banaya aur ek kone mein dabak kar pad gaya. Subah ke waqt uske raste par ja khada hua, jab woh nikla aur us par nigah padi toh ta'ajub ho kar poocha ke hain? Yeh kya halat hai? Maal ka kya hua? Usne kaha woh kuch na pooch, is waqt toh mera kaam jo hai use poora kar do, yani mujhe ijazat do ke main tumhari kheti baadi ka kaam misl aur naukron ke karoon aur aap mujhe sirf khana de diya kijiye aur jab yeh kambal phat toot jaye toh ek kambal aur khareed dena. Usne kaha nahin nahin, main is se behtar sulook tumhare sath karne ke liye tayyar hoon lekin pehle tum yeh batao ke is raqam ko tumne kya kiya? Kaha main ne ise ek shakhs ko qarz di hai. Kaha kise? Kaha aise ko jo na le kar mukre na dene se inkar kare. Kaha woh kaun hai? Usne jawab diya woh Allah Ta'ala hai jo mera aur tera Rabb hai. Yeh sunte hi us kafir ne is musalman ke hath se hath chudaliya aur us se kaha ahmaq hua hai? Yeh ho bhi sakta hai ke hum mar kar mitti ho kar phir jiyen aur Allah hamain badle de? Ja jab tu aisa hi bouda aur aise aqeedon wala hai toh mujhe tujh se koi sar-o-kar nahin. Pas woh kafir toh maze udata raha aur yeh momin sakhti se din guzarta raha yahan tak ke donon ko maut aa gayi. Musalman ko jannat mein jo jo ne'matein aur rahmatein milin woh andaza-o-shumar se zyada thin. Usne jo dekha ke had-e-nazar se balkay sari duniya se zyada toh zameen hai aur beshumar darakht aur baghat hain aur ja-ba-ja nahrein aur chashme hain toh poocha yeh sab kya hai?

Jawab mila yeh sab aap ka hai. Kaha SubhanAllah! Allah ki yeh toh badi hi meherbani hai. Ab jo aage badha toh is qadar laundi ghulam dekhe ke ginti nahin ho sakti, poocha yeh kis ke hain? Kaha gaya sab aap ke. Isay aur ta'ajjub aur khushi hui. Phir jo aage badha toh surkh yaqoot ke mahal nazar aaye, ek moti ka mahal, har har mahal mein kayi kayi Hoor-e-Ain, saath hi ittila hui ke yeh sab bhi aap ka hai, phir toh is ki baachhein khil gayin. Kehne laga Allah jaane mera woh kafir saathi kahan hoga? Allah usay dikhaye ga ke woh beech jahannam mein jal raha hai. Ab in mein woh baatein hongi jin ka zikr yahan hua hai, pas momin par duniya mein jo balayein aayi thin unhein woh yaad kare ga toh maut se zyada bhari bala usay koi nazar na aaye gi.

Zaqqum aur Tuba. Jannat ki nematon ka bayan farma kar farmata hai ke ab log khud faisla kar lein ke woh jagah aur woh nematein behtar hain? Ya Zaqqum ka darakht jo dozakhiyon ka khana hai. Mumkin hai is se murad khaas ek hi darakht ho aur woh tamam jahannam mein phaila hua ho, jaise Tuba ka ek darakht hai jo jannat ke ek ek mahal mein pohancha hua hai. Aur mumkin hai ke murad Zaqqum ke darakht ki jins ho is ki ta'eed aayat (لَاٰكِلُوْنَ مِنْ شَجَرٍ مِّنْ زَقُّوْمٍ 52 ۙ) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 52) se bhi hoti hai. Hum ne ise zalimon ke liye fitna banaya hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain shajar-e-Zaqqum ka zikr gumrahon ke liye fitna ho gaya woh kehne lage lo aur suno aag mein aur darakht? Aag toh darakht jala dene wali hai. Yeh Nabi (ﷺ) kehte hain jahannam mein darakht uge ga. Toh Allah ne farmaya haan yeh darakht aag hi se paida hoga aur is ki ghiza bhi aag hi hogi. Abu Jahl mal'oon isi par hansi urata tha aur kehta tha main toh khoob maze se khajoor makkhan khaunga isi ka naam Zaqqum hai. Al-gharaz yeh bhi ek imtehan hai bhale log toh is se dar gaye aur buron ne is ka mazaq uraya. Jaise farman hai (وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّءْيَا الَّتِيْٓ اَرَيْنٰكَ اِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَالشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُوْنَةَ فِي الْقُرْاٰنِ ۭ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ ۙ فَمَا يَزِيْدُهُمْ اِلَّا طُغْيَانًا كَبِيْرًا 60ۧ) (Surah Al-Isra: 60), jo manzar hum ne tujhe dikhaya tha woh sirf is liye hai ke logon ki aazmaish ho jaye aur isi tarah is nambarrak darakht ka zikr bhi. Hum toh unhein dhamka rahe hain magar yeh nafarmani mein barhte hi ja rahe hain. Is darakht ki asal jar jahannam mein hai. Is ke khushey aur shakhein bhayanak darauni lambi chauri door door shaitanon ke saron ki tarah phaili hui hain. Go shaitan ko bhi kisi ne dekha nahin lekin is ka naam sunte hi is ki bad-surati aur khabasat ka manzar samne aa jata hai, yahi haal is darakht ka hai ke dekhne aur chakhne mein zahir aur batin mein buri cheez hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke saanpon ki ek qism hai jo badtareen bhayanak aur khaufnak shakal ke hote hain. Aur ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke nabat ki ek qism hai jo bahut buri tarah phail jati hai. Lekin yeh dono ehtemal durust nahin theek baat wahi hai jise hum ne pehle zikr kiya. Isi bad-manzar bad-bo bad-zaiqa bad-maza bad-khisal thor ko unhein jabran khana pare ga. Aur thons thons kar unhein khilaya jaye ga ke yeh bajaye khud ek zabardast azaab hai. Aur aayat mein hai (لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنْ ضَرِيْعٍ ۙ) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 6), un ki khorak wahan sirf kanton dar thor hoga jo na unhein farba kar sake na bhook mita sake. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek aayat (اتقوا اللہ حق تقاتہ) ki tilawat kar ke farmaya agar Zaqqum ka ek qatra duniya ke samundaron mein par jaye toh roo-e-zameen ke tamam logon ki khorakein kharab ho jayen. Is ka kya haal hoga jis ki khorak hi yahi hoga (Tirmidhi waghera). Phir is Zaqqum ke khane ke sath hi unhein upar se jahannam ka kholta garam pani pilaya jaye ga.

Ya yeh matlab ke is jahannami darakht ko jahannami pani ke sath mila kar unhein khilaya pilaya jaye ga. Aur yeh garam pani woh hoga jo jahannamiyon ke zakhmon se lahu peep waghera ki shakal mein nikla hoga aur jo un ki aankhon se aur posheeda raston se nikla hua hoga. Hadith mein hai ke jab yeh pani un ke samne laya jaye ga, unhein sakht eeza hogi, bari karahiyat aayegi, phir jab woh un ke munh ke pas laya jaye ga to us ki bhaap se us ke chehre ki khaal jhulas kar jhar jaye gi aur jab us ka ghont pet mein jaye ga to un ki aantein kat kar pakhane ke raste se bahar aa jayengi (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.A farmate hain jab jahannami bhook ki shikayat karenge to Zaqqoom khilaya jaye ga jis se un ke chehre ki khalein bilkul alag ho kar par jayengi. Is tarah unhein pehchanne wala us mein un ke munh ki poori khaal dekh kar pehchan sakta hai ke yeh falan hai. Phir pyas ki shiddat se betab ho kar woh haye-waye pukarenge to unhein pighle hue tanbe jaisa garam pani diya jaye ga jo chehre ke samne aate hi chehre ke gosht ko jhulas de ga aur tamam gosht gir pare ga aur pet mein ja kar aanton ko kaat de ga. Upar se lohe ke hathore mare jayenge aur ek ek uzw-e-badan alag alag jhar jaye ga, buri tarah cheekhte peette honge. Faisla hote hi un ka thikana jahannam ho jaye ga jahan tarah tarah ke azab hote rahenge jaise aur aayat mein hai (Yatoofuna bainaha wa baina hameemin aan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 44). Jahannam aur aag jaise garam pani ke darmiyan chakkar khate rahenge. Hazrat Abdullah R.A ki qirat (Summa inna maqilahum la ilal jahim) hai. Hazrat Abdullah R.A ka farman hai ke wallah aadhe din se pehle hi pehle dono giroh apni apni jagah pahunch jayenge aur wahin qailula yani dopahar ka aaram karenge, Quran farmata hai (Ashabul jannati yauma'izin khairum mustaqarran wa ahsanu maqila) (Surah Al-Furqan: 24). Jannati ba-aitbar-e-jaye qayam ke bahut achhe honge aur ba-aitbar-e-aram gah ke bhi bahut achhe honge. Al-gharaz qailule ka waqt dono ka apni apni jagah hoga, aadhe din se pehle pehle apni apni jagah pahunch jayenge. Is bina par yahan 'summa' ka lafz khabar par khabar ke atf ke liye hoga. Yeh us ka badla hai ke in logon ne apne baap dadon ko gumrah paya, lekin phir bhi unhi ke naqsh-e-qadam par chalte rahe, majbooron aur bewaqoofon ki tarah un ke peeche ho liye.

Jaise farman hai (وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّءْيَا الَّتِيْٓ اَرَيْنٰكَ اِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَالشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُوْنَةَ فِي الْقُرْاٰنِ ۭ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ ۙ فَمَا يَزِيْدُهُمْ اِلَّا طُغْيَانًا كَبِيْرًا 60ۧ) (Surah Al-Isra: 60), jo manzar hum ne tujhe dikhaya tha woh sirf is liye hai ke logon ki aazmaish ho jaye aur isi tarah is nambarrak darakht ka zikr bhi. Hum toh unhein dhamka rahe hain magar yeh nafarmani mein barhte hi ja rahe hain. Is darakht ki asal jar jahannam mein hai. Is ke khushey aur shakhein bhayanak darauni lambi chauri door door shaitanon ke saron ki tarah phaili hui hain. Go shaitan ko bhi kisi ne dekha nahin lekin is ka naam sunte hi is ki bad-surati aur khabasat ka manzar samne aa jata hai, yahi haal is darakht ka hai ke dekhne aur chakhne mein zahir aur batin mein buri cheez hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke saanpon ki ek qism hai jo badtareen bhayanak aur khaufnak shakal ke hote hain. Aur ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke nabat ki ek qism hai jo bahut buri tarah phail jati hai. Lekin yeh dono ehtemal durust nahin theek baat wahi hai jise hum ne pehle zikr kiya. Isi bad-manzar bad-bo bad-zaiqa bad-maza bad-khisal thor ko unhein jabran khana pare ga. Aur thons thons kar unhein khilaya jaye ga ke yeh bajaye khud ek zabardast azaab hai. Aur aayat mein hai (لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِنْ ضَرِيْعٍ ۙ) (Surah Al-Ghashiyah: 6), un ki khorak wahan sirf kanton dar thor hoga jo na unhein farba kar sake na bhook mita sake. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne ek aayat (اتقوا اللہ حق تقاتہ) ki tilawat kar ke farmaya agar Zaqqum ka ek qatra duniya ke samundaron mein par jaye toh roo-e-zameen ke tamam logon ki khorakein kharab ho jayen. Is ka kya haal hoga jis ki khorak hi yahi hoga (Tirmidhi waghera). Phir is Zaqqum ke khane ke sath hi unhein upar se jahannam ka kholta garam pani pilaya jaye ga.

Ya yeh matlab ke is jahannami darakht ko jahannami pani ke sath mila kar unhein khilaya pilaya jaye ga. Aur yeh garam pani woh hoga jo jahannamiyon ke zakhmon se lahu peep waghera ki shakal mein nikla hoga aur jo un ki aankhon se aur posheeda raston se nikla hua hoga. Hadith mein hai ke jab yeh pani un ke samne laya jaye ga, unhein sakht eeza hogi, bari karahiyat aayegi, phir jab woh un ke munh ke pas laya jaye ga to us ki bhaap se us ke chehre ki khaal jhulas kar jhar jaye gi aur jab us ka ghont pet mein jaye ga to un ki aantein kat kar pakhane ke raste se bahar aa jayengi (Ibn Abi Hatim). Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.A farmate hain jab jahannami bhook ki shikayat karenge to Zaqqoom khilaya jaye ga jis se un ke chehre ki khalein bilkul alag ho kar par jayengi. Is tarah unhein pehchanne wala us mein un ke munh ki poori khaal dekh kar pehchan sakta hai ke yeh falan hai. Phir pyas ki shiddat se betab ho kar woh haye-waye pukarenge to unhein pighle hue tanbe jaisa garam pani diya jaye ga jo chehre ke samne aate hi chehre ke gosht ko jhulas de ga aur tamam gosht gir pare ga aur pet mein ja kar aanton ko kaat de ga. Upar se lohe ke hathore mare jayenge aur ek ek uzw-e-badan alag alag jhar jaye ga, buri tarah cheekhte peette honge. Faisla hote hi un ka thikana jahannam ho jaye ga jahan tarah tarah ke azab hote rahenge jaise aur aayat mein hai (Yatoofuna bainaha wa baina hameemin aan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 44). Jahannam aur aag jaise garam pani ke darmiyan chakkar khate rahenge. Hazrat Abdullah R.A ki qirat (Summa inna maqilahum la ilal jahim) hai. Hazrat Abdullah R.A ka farman hai ke wallah aadhe din se pehle hi pehle dono giroh apni apni jagah pahunch jayenge aur wahin qailula yani dopahar ka aaram karenge, Quran farmata hai (Ashabul jannati yauma'izin khairum mustaqarran wa ahsanu maqila) (Surah Al-Furqan: 24). Jannati ba-aitbar-e-jaye qayam ke bahut achhe honge aur ba-aitbar-e-aram gah ke bhi bahut achhe honge. Al-gharaz qailule ka waqt dono ka apni apni jagah hoga, aadhe din se pehle pehle apni apni jagah pahunch jayenge. Is bina par yahan 'summa' ka lafz khabar par khabar ke atf ke liye hoga. Yeh us ka badla hai ke in logon ne apne baap dadon ko gumrah paya, lekin phir bhi unhi ke naqsh-e-qadam par chalte rahe, majbooron aur bewaqoofon ki tarah un ke peeche ho liye.

Nek logon ke naam zinda rehte hain. Upar ki aayaton mein pehle logon ki gumrahi ka ijmalan zikr tha. In aayaton mein tafseeli bayan hai. Hazrat Nuh Nabi (A.S) apni qoum mein saarhe nau sau saal tak rahe aur har waqt unhein samjhate bujhate rahe lekin taham qoum gumrahi par jami rahi siwaye chand paak baaz logon ke koi imaan na laya. Balkeh satate aur takleefein dete rahe, aakhir kaar Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne tang aakar Rabb se dua ki ke Allah main aajiz aa gaya tu meri madad kar. Allah ka ghazab un par nazil hua aur tamam kuffar ko teh-e-aab aur gharq kar diya. To farmata hai ke Nuh ne tang aakar hamare janab mein dua ki. But-kada-e-Azar aur Hazrat Ibrahim A.S. Hazrat Ibrahim A.S. ne apni qoum se yeh is liye farmaya ke woh jab apne mele mein chale jayen to yeh un ke ibadat-khane mein tanha reh jayen aur un ke buton ko torne ka tanhai mein mauqa mil jaye. Isi liye ek aisi baat kahi jo darhaqiqat sachi baat thi lekin un ki samajh mein jo matlab is ka aaya us se aap ne apna deeni kaam nikal liya. Woh to apne etiqad ke mujib Hazrat Ibrahim A.S. ko sach-much bimar samajh baithe aur unhein chhor kar chalte bane. Hazrat Qatada R.A. farmate hain, jo shakhs kisi amr mein ghour-o-fikr kare to Arab kehte hain us ne sitaron par nazrein dalein. Matlab yeh hai ke ghour-o-fikr ke sath taron ki taraf nigah uthai aur sochne lage ke main inhein kis tarah talon. Soch samajh kar farmaya ke main saqim hoon yani zaeef hoon. Ek hadith mein aaya ke Ibrahim A.S. ne sirf teen hi jhoot bole hain jin mein se do to Allah ke deen ke liye, un ka farman (فَقَالَ اِنِّىْ سَقِيْمٌ 89؀) (37. As-Saffat: 89) aur un ka farman (قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَه ٗٗ ڰ كَبِيْرُهُمْ ھٰذَا فَسْـَٔــلُوْهُمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا يَنْطِقُوْنَ 63؀) (21. Al-Anbiya: 63) aur ek un ka Hazrat Sarah ko apni behan kehna. To yaad rahe ke darasal in mein haqiqi jhoot ek bhi nahin. Inhein to sirf majazan jhoot kaha gaya hai, kalam mein aisi tareefein kisi shar'i maqsad ke liye karna jhoot mein dakhil nahin, jaisa ke hadith mein bhi hai ke ta'reez jhoot se alag hai aur is se beniaz kar deti hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain, Hazrat Khalilullah A.S. ke in teenon kalmaat mein se ek bhi aisa nahin jis se hikmat-e-amli ke sath deen-e-Allah ki bhalai maqsood na ho. Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain "main bimar hoon" se matlab mujhe ta'oon ho gaya hai aur woh log aise mareez se bhagte the. Hazrat Saeed ka bayan hai ke Allah ke deen ki tabligh aur un ke jhoote maboodon ki tardeed ke liye Khalilullah ki yeh ek hikmat-e-amli thi ke ek sitare ko tulu hote dekh kar farma diya ke main saqim hoon. Auron ne yeh bhi likha hai ke main bimar hone wala hoon yani yaqeenan ek martaba marz-ul-maut aane wala hai. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke mareez hoon yani mera dil tumhare in buton ki ibadat se bimar hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain jab aap ki qoum mele mein jane lagi to aap ko bhi majboor karne lagi, aap hat gaye aur farma diya ke main saqim hoon aur aasman ki taraf dekhne lage. Jab woh unhein tanha chhor kar chal diye to aap ne ba-faraghat un ke maboodon ke tukre-tukre kar diye. Woh to sab apni eid mein gaye, aap chupke-chupke aur jaldi-jaldi un ke buton ke paas aaye. Pehle to farmaya kyun ji tum khate kyun nahin?

Yahan aakar Khalilullah (A.S) ne dekha ke jo charhawe un logon ne un buton par charha rakhe thay woh sab rakhe hue thay. Un logon ne tabarruk ki niyat se jo qurbaniyan yahan ki thin woh sab yunhi pari hui thin. Yeh but-khana bara wasee aur muzayyan tha. Darwaze ke mutasil ek bahut bara but tha aur us ke gird-o-pesh us se chhotay, phir un se chhotay, yunhi tamam but-khana bhara hua tha. Un ke paas mukhtalif qisam ke khane rakhe hue thay jo is etiqad se rakhe gaye thay ke yahan rehne se mutabarrik ho jayenge phir hum kha lenge. Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni baat ka jawab na pakar phir farmaya yeh tumhein kya ho gaya hai? Bolte kyun nahin. Ab to poori quwwat se dayen hath se maar kar un ke tukray tukray kar diye. Haan baray but ko chhor diya taake us par badgumani ki ja sake, jaisa ke Surah Al-Anbiya mein guzar chuka hai aur wahin us ki poori tafsir bhi bayan ho chuki hai. But-parast jab apne melay se wapas hue, but-khane mein ghusay to dekha ke un ke sab khuda urang-barang paray hue hain, kisi ka hath nahin, kisi ka paon nahin, kisi ka sar nahin, kisi ka dhar nahin. Hairan ho gaye ke yeh kya hua? Aakhir soch samajh kar behas-mubahisay ke baad maloom kar liya ke ho na ho yeh kaam Ibrahim (Alaihis-Salatu-Wassalam) ka hai. Ab saray ke saray mil jul kar Khalil (A.S) ke paas doray, bhagay, daant peestay, talmalaye, kos-tay gaye. Khalilullah (A.S) ko tableegh ka aur unhein qail-e-maqool karne ka aur samjhane ka achha mauqa mila. Farmane lage kyun in cheezon ki parastish karte ho jinhein khud tum banate ho? Apne hathon gharte aur tarashte ho? Halankeh tumhara aur tumhare aamal ka khaliq Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Mumkin hai ke is aayat mein 'ma' masdariya ho aur mumkin hai ke 'allazi' ke ma'ani mein ho, lekin dono ma'ani mein talazum hai. Go awwal zyada zahir hai. Chunancha Imam Bukhari (R.H) ki kitab 'Af'al-ul-Ibad' mein ek marfoo hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala har sani' (banane wale) aur us ki sanat (kaam) ko paida karta hai. Phir ba'az ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Chunkeh is pak saaf baat ka koi jawab un ke paas na tha to tang aakar dushmani par aur safla-pan par utar aaye aur kehne lage ek bunyan banao us mein aag jalao aur usay is mein daal do. Chunancha yahi unhon ne kiya lekin Allah Ta'ala ne apne Khalil (A.S) ko us se nijat di. Inhi ko ghalba diya aur inhi ki madad farmayi. Go unhon ne unhein burai pahunchani chahi lekin Allah ne khud unhein zaleel kar diya. Is ka poora bayan aur kamil tafsir Surah Al-Anbiya mein guzar chuki hai wahin dekh li jaye.

Hazrat Qatada R.A. farmate hain, jo shakhs kisi amr mein ghour-o-fikr kare to Arab kehte hain us ne sitaron par nazrein dalein. Ek hadith mein aaya ke Ibrahim A.S. ne sirf teen hi jhoot bole hain jin mein se do to Allah ke deen ke liye, un ka farman (فَقَالَ اِنِّىْ سَقِيْمٌ 89؀) (37. As-Saffat: 89) aur un ka farman (قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَه ٗٗ ڰ كَبِيْرُهُمْ ھٰذَا فَسْـَٔــلُوْهُمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا يَنْطِقُوْنَ 63؀) (21. Al-Anbiya: 63) aur ek un ka Hazrat Sarah ko apni behan kehna. To yaad rahe ke darasal in mein haqiqi jhoot ek bhi nahin. Inhein to sirf majazan jhoot kaha gaya hai, kalam mein aisi tareefein kisi shar'i maqsad ke liye karna jhoot mein dakhil nahin, jaisa ke hadith mein bhi hai ke ta'reez jhoot se alag hai aur is se beniaz kar deti hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain, Hazrat Khalilullah A.S. ke in teenon kalmaat mein se ek bhi aisa nahin jis se hikmat-e-amli ke sath deen-e-Allah ki bhalai maqsood na ho. Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain "main bimar hoon" se matlab mujhe ta'oon ho gaya hai aur woh log aise mareez se bhagte the. Hazrat Saeed ka bayan hai ke Allah ke deen ki tabligh aur un ke jhoote maboodon ki tardeed ke liye Khalilullah ki yeh ek hikmat-e-amli thi ke ek sitare ko tulu hote dekh kar farma diya ke main saqim hoon. Auron ne yeh bhi likha hai ke main bimar hone wala hoon yani yaqeenan ek martaba marz-ul-maut aane wala hai. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke mareez hoon yani mera dil tumhare in buton ki ibadat se bimar hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain jab aap ki qoum mele mein jane lagi to aap ko bhi majboor karne lagi, aap hat gaye aur farma diya ke main saqim hoon aur aasman ki taraf dekhne lage. Jab woh unhein tanha chhor kar chal diye to aap ne ba-faraghat un ke maboodon ke tukre-tukre kar diye. Woh to sab apni eid mein gaye, aap chupke-chupke aur jaldi-jaldi un ke buton ke paas aaye. Pehle to farmaya kyun ji tum khate kyun nahin?

Yahan aakar Khalilullah (A.S) ne dekha ke jo charhawe un logon ne un buton par charha rakhe thay woh sab rakhe hue thay. Un logon ne tabarruk ki niyat se jo qurbaniyan yahan ki thin woh sab yunhi pari hui thin. Yeh but-khana bara wasee aur muzayyan tha. Darwaze ke mutasil ek bahut bara but tha aur us ke gird-o-pesh us se chhotay, phir un se chhotay, yunhi tamam but-khana bhara hua tha. Un ke paas mukhtalif qisam ke khane rakhe hue thay jo is etiqad se rakhe gaye thay ke yahan rehne se mutabarrik ho jayenge phir hum kha lenge. Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni baat ka jawab na pakar phir farmaya yeh tumhein kya ho gaya hai? Bolte kyun nahin. Ab to poori quwwat se dayen hath se maar kar un ke tukray tukray kar diye. Haan baray but ko chhor diya taake us par badgumani ki ja sake, jaisa ke Surah Al-Anbiya mein guzar chuka hai aur wahin us ki poori tafsir bhi bayan ho chuki hai. But-parast jab apne melay se wapas hue, but-khane mein ghusay to dekha ke un ke sab khuda urang-barang paray hue hain, kisi ka hath nahin, kisi ka paon nahin, kisi ka sar nahin, kisi ka dhar nahin. Hairan ho gaye ke yeh kya hua? Aakhir soch samajh kar behas-mubahisay ke baad maloom kar liya ke ho na ho yeh kaam Ibrahim (Alaihis-Salatu-Wassalam) ka hai. Ab saray ke saray mil jul kar Khalil (A.S) ke paas doray, bhagay, daant peestay, talmalaye, kos-tay gaye. Khalilullah (A.S) ko tableegh ka aur unhein qail-e-maqool karne ka aur samjhane ka achha mauqa mila. Farmane lage kyun in cheezon ki parastish karte ho jinhein khud tum banate ho? Apne hathon gharte aur tarashte ho? Halankeh tumhara aur tumhare aamal ka khaliq Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Mumkin hai ke is aayat mein 'ma' masdariya ho aur mumkin hai ke 'allazi' ke ma'ani mein ho, lekin dono ma'ani mein talazum hai. Go awwal zyada zahir hai. Chunancha Imam Bukhari (R.H) ki kitab 'Af'al-ul-Ibad' mein ek marfoo hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala har sani' (banane wale) aur us ki sanat (kaam) ko paida karta hai. Phir ba'az ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Chunkeh is pak saaf baat ka koi jawab un ke paas na tha to tang aakar dushmani par aur safla-pan par utar aaye aur kehne lage ek bunyan banao us mein aag jalao aur usay is mein daal do. Chunancha yahi unhon ne kiya lekin Allah Ta'ala ne apne Khalil (A.S) ko us se nijat di. Inhi ko ghalba diya aur inhi ki madad farmayi. Go unhon ne unhein burai pahunchani chahi lekin Allah ne khud unhein zaleel kar diya. Is ka poora bayan aur kamil tafsir Surah Al-Anbiya mein guzar chuki hai wahin dekh li jaye.

Ab saray ke saray mil jul kar Khalil (A.S) ke paas doray, bhagay, daant peestay, talmalaye, kos-tay gaye. Khalilullah (A.S) ko tableegh ka aur unhein qail-e-maqool karne ka aur samjhane ka achha mauqa mila. Farmane lage kyun in cheezon ki parastish karte ho jinhein khud tum banate ho? Apne hathon gharte aur tarashte ho? Halankeh tumhara aur tumhare aamal ka khaliq Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Chunancha Imam Bukhari (R.H) ki kitab 'Af'al-ul-Ibad' mein ek marfoo hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala har sani' (banane wale) aur us ki sanat (kaam) ko paida karta hai. Phir ba'az ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Chunkeh is pak saaf baat ka koi jawab un ke paas na tha to tang aakar dushmani par aur safla-pan par utar aaye aur kehne lage ek bunyan banao us mein aag jalao aur usay is mein daal do. But-kada-e-Azar aur Hazrat Ibrahim A.S. Hazrat Ibrahim A.S. ne apni qoum se yeh is liye farmaya ke woh jab apne mele mein chale jayen to yeh un ke ibadat-khane mein tanha reh jayen aur un ke buton ko torne ka tanhai mein mauqa mil jaye. Isi liye ek aisi baat kahi jo darhaqiqat sachi baat thi lekin un ki samajh mein jo matlab is ka aaya us se aap ne apna deeni kaam nikal liya. Woh to apne etiqad ke mujib Hazrat Ibrahim A.S. ko sach-much bimar samajh baithe aur unhein chhor kar chalte bane. Hazrat Qatada R.A. farmate hain, jo shakhs kisi amr mein ghour-o-fikr kare to Arab kehte hain us ne sitaron par nazrein dalein. Matlab yeh hai ke ghour-o-fikr ke sath taron ki taraf nigah uthai aur sochne lage ke main inhein kis tarah talon. Soch samajh kar farmaya ke main saqim hoon yani zaeef hoon. Ek hadith mein aaya ke Ibrahim A.S. ne sirf teen hi jhoot bole hain jin mein se do to Allah ke deen ke liye, un ka farman (فَقَالَ اِنِّىْ سَقِيْمٌ 89؀) (37. As-Saffat: 89) aur un ka farman (قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَه ٗٗ ڰ كَبِيْرُهُمْ ھٰذَا فَسْـَٔــلُوْهُمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا يَنْطِقُوْنَ 63؀) (21. Al-Anbiya: 63) aur ek un ka Hazrat Sarah ko apni behan kehna. To yaad rahe ke darasal in mein haqiqi jhoot ek bhi nahin. Inhein to sirf majazan jhoot kaha gaya hai, kalam mein aisi tareefein kisi shar'i maqsad ke liye karna jhoot mein dakhil nahin, jaisa ke hadith mein bhi hai ke ta'reez jhoot se alag hai aur is se beniaz kar deti hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain, Hazrat Khalilullah A.S. ke in teenon kalmaat mein se ek bhi aisa nahin jis se hikmat-e-amli ke sath deen-e-Allah ki bhalai maqsood na ho. Hazrat Sufyan farmate hain "main bimar hoon" se matlab mujhe ta'oon ho gaya hai aur woh log aise mareez se bhagte the. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke mareez hoon yani mera dil tumhare in buton ki ibadat se bimar hai. Jab woh unhein tanha chhor kar chal diye to aap ne ba-faraghat un ke maboodon ke tukre-tukre kar diye. Woh to sab apni eid mein gaye, aap chupke-chupke aur jaldi-jaldi un ke buton ke paas aaye. Pehle to farmaya kyun ji tum khate kyun nahin?

Hazrat Saeed ka bayan hai ke Allah ke deen ki tabligh aur un ke jhoote maboodon ki tardeed ke liye Khalilullah ki yeh ek hikmat-e-amli thi ke ek sitare ko tulu hote dekh kar farma diya ke main saqim hoon. Auron ne yeh bhi likha hai ke main bimar hone wala hoon yani yaqeenan ek martaba marz-ul-maut aane wala hai. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke mareez hoon yani mera dil tumhare in buton ki ibadat se bimar hai. Hazrat Hasan Basri farmate hain jab aap ki qoum mele mein jane lagi to aap ko bhi majboor karne lagi, aap hat gaye aur farma diya ke main saqim hoon aur aasman ki taraf dekhne lage. Jab woh unhein tanha chhor kar chal diye to aap ne ba-faraghat un ke maboodon ke tukre-tukre kar diye. Woh to sab apni eid mein gaye, aap chupke-chupke aur jaldi-jaldi un ke buton ke paas aaye. Pehle to farmaya kyun ji tum khate kyun nahin?

Yahan aakar Khalilullah (A.S) ne dekha ke jo charhawe un logon ne un buton par charha rakhe thay woh sab rakhe hue thay. Un logon ne tabarruk ki niyat se jo qurbaniyan yahan ki thin woh sab yunhi pari hui thin. Yeh but-khana bara wasee aur muzayyan tha. Darwaze ke mutasil ek bahut bara but tha aur us ke gird-o-pesh us se chhotay, phir un se chhotay, yunhi tamam but-khana bhara hua tha. Un ke paas mukhtalif qisam ke khane rakhe hue thay jo is etiqad se rakhe gaye thay ke yahan rehne se mutabarrik ho jayenge phir hum kha lenge. Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni baat ka jawab na pakar phir farmaya yeh tumhein kya ho gaya hai? Bolte kyun nahin. Ab to poori quwwat se dayen hath se maar kar un ke tukray tukray kar diye. Haan baray but ko chhor diya taake us par badgumani ki ja sake, jaisa ke Surah Al-Anbiya mein guzar chuka hai aur wahin us ki poori tafsir bhi bayan ho chuki hai. But-parast jab apne melay se wapas hue, but-khane mein ghusay to dekha ke un ke sab khuda urang-barang paray hue hain, kisi ka hath nahin, kisi ka paon nahin, kisi ka sar nahin, kisi ka dhar nahin. Hairan ho gaye ke yeh kya hua? Aakhir soch samajh kar behas-mubahisay ke baad maloom kar liya ke ho na ho yeh kaam Ibrahim (Alaihis-Salatu-Wassalam) ka hai. Ab saray ke saray mil jul kar Khalil (A.S) ke paas doray, bhagay, daant peestay, talmalaye, kos-tay gaye. Khalilullah (A.S) ko tableegh ka aur unhein qail-e-maqool karne ka aur samjhane ka achha mauqa mila. Farmane lage kyun in cheezon ki parastish karte ho jinhein khud tum banate ho? Apne hathon gharte aur tarashte ho? Halankeh tumhara aur tumhare aamal ka khaliq Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Mumkin hai ke is aayat mein 'ma' masdariya ho aur mumkin hai ke 'allazi' ke ma'ani mein ho, lekin dono ma'ani mein talazum hai. Go awwal zyada zahir hai. Chunancha Imam Bukhari (R.H) ki kitab 'Af'al-ul-Ibad' mein ek marfoo hadith hai ke Allah Ta'ala har sani' (banane wale) aur us ki sanat (kaam) ko paida karta hai. Phir ba'az ne isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Chunkeh is pak saaf baat ka koi jawab un ke paas na tha to tang aakar dushmani par aur safla-pan par utar aaye aur kehne lage ek bunyan banao us mein aag jalao aur usay is mein daal do. Chunancha yahi unhon ne kiya lekin Allah Ta'ala ne apne Khalil (A.S) ko us se nijat di. Inhi ko ghalba diya aur inhi ki madad farmayi. Go unhon ne unhein burai pahunchani chahi lekin Allah ne khud unhein zaleel kar diya. Is ka poora bayan aur kamil tafsir Surah Al-Anbiya mein guzar chuki hai wahin dekh li jaye.

Zabihullah ki behas aur Yahudi riwayat. Khalilullah jab apni qoum ki hidayat se mayus hogaye. Bari bari qudrati nishaniyan dekh kar bhi jab unhein iman naseeb na hua toh aap ne un se hat jana pasand farmaya aur elan kardiya ke main ab tum mein se hijrat karjaunga mera rehnuma mera Rab hai. Saath hi apne Rab se apne yahan aulad hone ki dua mangi taake wahi tauheed mein aap ka saath de. Isi waqt dua qabool hoti hai aur ek burdbar bache ki basharat di jati hai. Yeh Hazrat Ismail A.S thay yahi aap ke liye sahibzade thay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S se baray thay. Isay toh Ahl-e-Kitab bhi mantay hain balkay un ki kutub mein majood hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki paidaish ke waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki umar chiyasi saal ki thi aur jis waqt Hazrat Ishaq A.S tawalud hotay hain us waqt aap ki umar ninnanway baras ki thi. Balkay un ki apni kitab mein toh yeh bhi hai ke Janab Ibrahim A.S ko apne iklotay farzand ko zibah karne ka hukum hua tha. Lekin sirf is liye ke yeh log khud toh Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Ishaq A.S ki aulad mein se hain aur Nabi-e-Allah wa Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Arab hain. Inhon ne waqia ki asliyat badal di aur is fazeelat ko Hazrat Ismail A.S se hatakar Hazrat Ishaq A.S ko de diya aur beja taweelein karte Allah ke kalam ko badal dala. Aur kaha hamari kitab mein lafz 'Waheedak' hai is se murad iklota nahin balkay jo tere paas is waqt akela hai woh hai. Yeh is liye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S toh apni walida ke saath Makkah mein thay yahan Khalilullah ke saath sirf Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay. Lekin yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Waheed usi ko kaha jata hai jo iklota ho us ka aur koi bhai na ho. Phir yahan ek baat aur bhi hai ke iklotay aur pehlothi ke bache ke saath jo mohabbat hoti aur us ke jo laad pyar hotay hain umooman dusri aulad ke hone par phir woh baqi nahin rehte. Is liye is ke zabiha ka hukum imtehan aur aazmaish ki zabardast kari hai. Hum isay mantay hain ke baaz salaf bhi is ke qail huay hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay yahan tak ke baaz sahaba se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin yeh cheez Kitab-o-Sunnat se sabit nahin hoti. Balkay khayal yeh hai ke Bani Israel ki ek shohrat di hui baat ko in hazrat ne bhi bedaleel apne yahan le liya door kyun jayen Kitab-e-Allah ke alfaaz mein hi ghaur kar lijiye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ka 'Ghulamin Haleem' keh kar zikr hua aur phir Allah ki raah mein zibah ke liye tayar hone ka zikr hua. Is tamam bayan ko khatam karke phir Nabi-e-Saleh Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke tawalud ki basharat ka bayan hua. Aur farishton ne basharat-e-Ishaq ke mauqay par 'Ghulamin Aleem' farmaya tha. Isi tarah Quran mein hai basharat-e-Ishaq ke saath hi hai (وَمِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ اِسْحٰقَ يَعْقُوْبَ) (Surah Hud: 71) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein hi Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke yahan Hazrat Yaqub A.S paida honge yani un ki toh nasl jaari rehne ka pehle hi ilm karaya ja chuka tha ab unhein zibah karne ka hukum kaise diya jata? Isay hum pehle bhi bayan kar chuke.

Albatta Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ka wasf yahan par bardbari ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Jo Zabih ke liye nihayat munasib hai. Ab Hazrat Ismail bade ho gaye, apne walid ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye. Aap us waqt ma'a apni walida mohtarma ke Faran mein thay, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) umooman wahan jate aate rehte thay, yeh mazkoor hai ke Buraq par jate thay aur is jumle ke yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke jawani ke lag bhag ho gaye, ladakpan ka zamana nikal gaya aur baap ki tarah chalne phirne, kaam kaaj karne ke qabil ban gaye. Toh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne khwab dekha ke goya aap apne pyare bache ko zibah kar rahe hain. Anbiya ke khwab wahi hote hain aur is ki daleel yahi aayat hai. Ek marfoo' riwayat mein bhi yeh hai. Pas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apne lakht-e-jigar ki aazmaish ke liye ke achanak woh ghabra na uthein, apna irada un ke samne zahir kiya. Wahan kya tha? Woh bhi usi darakht ke phal thay, Nabi ibn-e-Nabi thay, jawab dete hain ab phir der kyun laga rahe ho? Yeh baatein bhi poochne ki hoti hain? Jo hukm hua hai use foran kar daliye aur agar meri nisbat khatka ho toh zabani itminani kya karoon, chhuri rakhiye khud maloom ho jayega ke main kaisa kuch sabir hoon. Insha'Allah mera sabr aap ka jee khush kar dega. SubhanAllah jo kaha tha wahi kar ke dikhaya aur Sadiq-ul-Wa'ad hone ka certificate Allah ki taraf se hasil kar hi liya. Aakhir baap beta dono hukm-e-Allah ki ita'at ke liye jaan ba-kaf tayyar ho jate hain, baap bache ko zibah karne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai. Aur baap apne noor-e-chashm lakht-e-jigar ko munh ke bal zameen par girate hain taake zibah ke waqt munh dekh kar mohabbat na aa jaye aur hath sust na pad jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apne noor-e-nazar ko zibah karne ke liye ba-hukm-e-Allah le chale toh sa'ee ke waqt Shaitan samne aaya lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) us se aage badh gaye, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath aap Jamra-e-Aqaba par pahunche toh phir Shaitan samne aaya, aap ne use saat kankariyan maarein. Phir Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas aaya phir wahan saat kankariyan maarein. Phir aage badh kar apne pyare bache ko Allah ke naam par zibah karne ke liye neeche pachhada, Zabihullah ke paak jism par us waqt safed chadar thi, kehne lage abba ji ise utaar lijiye taake is mein aap mujhe kafna sakein. Us waqt bete ko nanga karte waqt baap ka ajab haal tha ke aawaz aayi bas Ibrahim (A.S) khwab ko sacha kar chuke. Mud kar dekha toh ek menda safed rang ka bade bade seengon aur saaf aankhon wala nazar pada. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain isi liye hum is qisam ke mende (chhatre) chun chun kar qurbani ke liye lete thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) hi se dusri riwayat mein Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ka naam marwi hai. Toh go dono naam aap se marwi hain lekin awwal hi awla hai aur is ki daleelein aa rahi hain, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ke badle bada zabiha Allah ne ata farmaya, is ki babat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh Jannati chhatra tha jo wahan chalees saal se kha pee raha tha. Ise dekh kar aap apne bache ko chhod kar is ke peeche ho liye.

Jamra-e-Ula par aakar saat kankariyan phenkin, phir woh bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta par aa gaya. Saat kankariyan maarein aur wahan se Malkhar mein lakar zibah kiya, us ke seeng sar samet ibtida-e-Islam ke zamane tak Ka'be ke parnale ke paas latakte rahe thay phir sookh gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) baithe hue baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) toh hadeesein bayan kar rahe thay aur Hazrat Ka'b kitab ke qisse bayan kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke har Nabi ke liye ek dua qabool shuda hai aur main ne apni is maqbool dua ko posheeda karke rakh chora hai apni ummat ki shafa'at ke liye. Aur farmane lage tum par mere maa baap fida hon ya farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere maa baap sadqe jayein. Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanadan ghareeb aur munkar hai aur is ke ek rawi Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam za'eef hain aur mujhe toh yeh bhi dar hai ke yeh alfaaz ke (jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se) aakhir tak rawi apne na hon jinhein unhon ne hadith mein dakhil kardiye hain. Zabihullah toh Hazrat Ismail A.S hain, mahal-e-zibah Mina hai aur woh Makkah mein hai aur Hazrat Ismail yahin thay na ke Hazrat Ishaq woh toh shehar-e-Kanaan mein thay jo Shaam hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S apne pyare bache ko zibah karne ke liye lita dete hain janab-e-Bari se nida aati hai ke bas Ibrahim tum apne khwab ko poora kar chuke. Suddi se riwayat hai ke jab Khalilullah ne Zabihullah ke halq par chhuri pheri toh gardan taanbe ki ho gayi aur na kati aur yeh aawaz aayi. Hum isi tarah nek karon ko badla dete hain. Ya'ni sakhtiyon se bacha lete hain aur chhutkara kar dete hain. Jaise farmaya Allah se darte rehne walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala chhutkare ki soorat nikal hi deta hai aur use aisi tarah rozi pahunchata hai ke us ke gumaan-o-wahm mein bhi na ho. Allah par bharosa karne walon ko Allah hi kaafi hai Allah apne kaamon ko mukammal karke chhodta hai har cheez ka us ne ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Is aayat se is par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke fe'l par qudrat paane se pehle hi hukm mansookh ho sakta hai haan Mu'tazila ise nahin maante. Wajah-e-istidlal bahut zahir hai is liye ke Khalilullah ko apne bete ke zibah karne ka hukm hota hai aur phir zibah se pehle hi fidiye ke sath mansookh kardiya jata hai. Maqsood is se yeh tha ke sabr ka aur baja aawari-e-hukm par musta'idi ka sawab marhamat farma diya jaye. Isi liye irshad hua yeh toh sirf ek aazmaish thi khula imtehan tha ke idhar hukm hua idhar tayyari hui. Isi liye janab-e-Khalilullah A.S ki tareef mein Quran mein hai Ibrahim bada hi wafadar tha. Bade zabih ke sath un ka fidiya hum ne diya. Safed rang badi aankhon aur bade seengon wala umda khorak se pala hua mendha fidiye mein diya gaya jo zair-e-babool ke darakht se bandha hua mila. Jo jannat mein chalees saal charta raha. Mina mein zair ke paas jo chattan hai us par yeh janwar zibah kiya gaya yeh cheekhta hua oopar se utra tha. Yehi woh mendha hai jise Habil ne Allah ki raah mein qurban kiya tha. Is ki oon qadre surkhi mail thi is ka naam Jareer tha. Ba'az kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ise zibah kiya. Koi kehta hai Mina mein nahr par.

Ek shakhs ne apne tain rah-e-Allah mein zibah karne ki mannat mani thi toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne use ek sau oont zibah karne ka fatwa diya tha lekin phir farmate the ke agar main use ek bhed zibah karne ko kehta tab bhi kafi tha kyunke Kitabullah mein hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah ka fidiya usi se diya gaya tha. Aksar logon ka yahi qaul hai, baaz kehte hain yeh pahadi bakra tha, koi kehta hai nar hiran tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne bhed ke seeng Baitullah Sharif mein dakhle ke waqt andar dekhe the aur mujhe yaad na raha ke main tujhe unke dhank dene ka hukum doon, jao use dhak do, Baitullah mein koi aisi cheez na honi chahiye jo namazi ko apni taraf mutawajja kar le. Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain us bhed ke seeng Baitullah mein hi rahe yahan tak ke ek martaba Baitullah mein aag lagi us mein woh jal gaye, yeh waqia bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the, isi wajah se unki aulad Quraish tak yeh seeng barabar aur musalsal chale aaye yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne mab'oos farmaya. Wallahu A'lam. "Un aasar ka bayan jin mein Zabihullah ka naam hai" Abu Maisara farmate hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne badshah se farmaya kya tu mere sath khana chahta hai? Main Yusuf bin Yaqub Nabiullah bin Ishaq Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah hoon. (Ubaid bin Umair) Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-Bari mein arz ki ke aye Allah kya wajah hai jo logon ki zabanon par yeh chadha hua hai ke Ibrahim, Ismail aur Yaqub ke Allah ki qasam, toh jawab mila is liye ke Ibrahim ne toh har har cheez par mujhi ko tarjeeh di aur Ishaq (A.S) ne apne tain meri rah mein zibah hone ke liye supurd kar diya phir bhala aur cheezein use pesh kar dena kya mushkil thin aur Yaqub ko main joon joon balaon mein dalta gaya uske husn-e-zanni mere sath badhti hi rahi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke samne ek martaba kisi ne fakhran apne baap dadon ka naam liya toh aap ne farmaya qabil-e-fakhr baap dada toh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke the jo Yaqub bin Ishaq aur Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah the. Ikrama, Ibn-e-Abbas, khud Abbas, Ali, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Ubaid bin Umair, Abu Maisara, Zaid bin Aslam, Abdullah bin Shafiq, Zuhri, Qasim bin Abu Barza, Makhool, Usman bin Abi Aas, Suddi, Hasan, Qatada, Abu Al-Huzail, Ibn-e-Sabit, Ka'ab Ahbar (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een), in sab ka yahi qaul hai aur Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the. Sahih ilm toh Allah ko hi hai magar bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ke in sab buzurgon ke ustad Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar hain. Yeh khilafat-e-Farooqi mein musalman hue the aur kabhi kabhi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko qadeemi kitabon ki baatein sunate the, logon ne ise rukhsat samajh kar phir un se har ek baat bayan karni shuru kar di aur sahih ghalat ki tameez uth gayi, haq toh yeh hai ke is ummat ko agli kitabon ki ek baat ki bhi haajat nahin. Baghawi ne kuch aur naam bhi Sahaba-o-Tabieen ke batlaye hain jinhon ne kaha hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain.

Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai agar woh hadith sahi hoti toh jhagray ka faisla tha magar woh hadith sahi nahin is mein do rawi za'eef hain. Hasan bin Dinar matrook hain aur Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an munkar-ul-hadith hain aur zyada sahi yeh hai ke hai yeh bhi mauqif, chunancha ek sanad se yeh maqoola Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ab un aasar ko suniye jin se maloom hota hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi thay aur yahi theek aur bilkul durust bhi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmatay hain aur farmatay hain ke Yahudi Hazrat Ishaq ka naam jhoot moot letay hain. Ibn-e-Umar, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Hasan Basri, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi, Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ke samnay jab Muhammad bin Qurzi ne yeh farmaya aur saath hi is ki daleel bhi di ke zibh ke zikr ke baad Quran mein Khalilullah ko Hazrat Ishaq ke paida honay ki basharat ka zikr hai aur saath hi bayan hai ke un ke haan bhi larka hoga Yaqub nami jab un ke haan larka honay ki basharat di gayi thi phir bawajood un ke haan larka na honay ke us se pehlay hi un ke zibh karnay ka hukum kaisay diya jata hai? Toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya yeh bohat saaf daleel hai mera zehan yahan nahin pohancha tha go yeh main bhi jaanta tha ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi hain phir Shah-e-Islam ne Shaam ke ek Yahudi aalim se poocha jo Musalman ho gaye thay ke tum is baray mein kya ilm rakhtay ho unhon ne farmaya Ameer-ul-Muslimeen sach toh yahi hai ke jin ke zibh karnay ka hukum diya gaya woh Hazrat Ismail hi thay lekin chunkay Arab un ki aulad mein se hain toh yeh buzurgi un ki taraf laut-ti hai is hasad ke baray mein Yahudiyon ne isay badal diya aur Hazrat Ishaq ka naam le diya. Haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai hamara imaan hai ke Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ishaq dono hi tahir-o-tayyab aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay. Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah ne apnay walid se jab yeh masla poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke zibh honay walay Hazrat Ismail hi thay. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Abu Tufail, Saeed bin Musayyab, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Saleh (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Baghawi ne aur bhi sahaba aur tabieen ke naam ginuwaye hain. Ek ghareeb hadith bhi isi ki ta'eed mein marwi hai is mein hai ke Shaam mein Ameer Muawiyah ke samnay yeh behas churi ke Zabihullah kaun hain? Toh aap ne farmaya khoob hua jo yeh mamla mujh jaisay bakhabar shakhs ke paas aaya suno hum Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas thay jab ek shakhs aap ke paas aaya aur kehnay laga ae Allah ki raah mein do zibh honay walon ki nasl ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe bhi maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch dilwaiye is par aap hans diye. Ek toh Zabihullah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah thay dusray Hazrat Ismail jin ki nasl mein se aap hain.

Abdullah ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia yeh hai ke aap ke dada Abdul Muttalib ne jab Chah-e-Zamzam khoda to nazr mani thi ke agar yeh kaam aasani se pura ho gaya to apne ek ladke ko rah-e-Allah mein zibah karunga. Jab kaam ho gaya aur qura-andazi ki gayi ke kis bete ko Allah ke naam par zibah karein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah ka naam nikla. Un ke nanhiyal walon ne kaha aap un ki taraf se ek sau oont rah-e-Allah zibah kar dein, chunancha woh zibah kar diye gaye aur Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia to mashhoor hi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein yeh riwayat majood hai aur Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein bhi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ki ek daleel to yeh pesh ki hai ke jis 'Ghulamin Aleem' (ilm wale bache) ki basharat ka zikr hai us se murad Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'Wa bashsharu bi ghulamin aleem' aur Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki basharat ka yeh jawab diya hai ke woh aap ke sath chalne phirne ki umar ko pahunch gaye the aur mumkin hai ke Yaqub (A.S) ke sath hi koi aur aulad bhi hui ho. Aur Ka'batullah mein seengon ki maujoodgi ke bare mein farmate hain bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Bilad-e-Kanaan se la kar yahan rakhe gaye hon aur baaz logon se Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke naam ki sarahat bhi aayi hai, lekin yeh sab baatein haqeeqat se bahut door hain. Haan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone par Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka istidlal bahut saaf aur qawi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pehle Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke tawallud hone ki basharat di gayi thi, yahan us ke baad un ke bhai Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ki basharat di ja rahi hai. Surah Hud aur Surah Hijr mein bhi is ka zikr guzar chuka hai. 'Nabiyan' haal-e-muqaddara hai yani woh Nabi-e-Saleh hoga. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Zabihullah Ishaq (A.S) the aur yahan nabuwat Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ko basharat hai. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bare mein farman hai ke hum ne unhein apni rahmat se un ke bhai Haroon (A.S) ko Nabi bana diya. Halankeh Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bade the to yahan bhi un ki nabuwat ki basharat hai. Pas yeh basharat us waqt di gayi jabkeh imtihan-e-zibah mein woh sabir sabit huye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh basharat do martaba di gayi, paidaish se kuch qabl aur nabuwat se kuch qabl. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Un par aur Ishaq (A.S) par hamari barkatein hum ne nazil farmayin, un ki aulad mein har qisam ke log hain nek bhi bad bhi. Jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se farman hua tha ke ae Nuh! Hamari salam aur barkat ke sath utar. Tu bhi aur tere sath wale bhi aur aise bhi log hain jinhein hum faide pahunchayenge phir unhein hamari taraf se dardnak azab pahunchenge.

Zabihullah ki behas aur Yahudi riwayat. Khalilullah jab apni qoum ki hidayat se mayus hogaye. Bari bari qudrati nishaniyan dekh kar bhi jab unhein iman naseeb na hua toh aap ne un se hat jana pasand farmaya aur elan kardiya ke main ab tum mein se hijrat karjaunga mera rehnuma mera Rab hai. Saath hi apne Rab se apne yahan aulad hone ki dua mangi taake wahi tauheed mein aap ka saath de. Isi waqt dua qabool hoti hai aur ek burdbar bache ki basharat di jati hai. Yeh Hazrat Ismail A.S thay yahi aap ke liye sahibzade thay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S se baray thay. Isay toh Ahl-e-Kitab bhi mantay hain balkay un ki kutub mein majood hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki paidaish ke waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki umar chiyasi saal ki thi aur jis waqt Hazrat Ishaq A.S tawalud hotay hain us waqt aap ki umar ninnanway baras ki thi. Balkay un ki apni kitab mein toh yeh bhi hai ke Janab Ibrahim A.S ko apne iklotay farzand ko zibah karne ka hukum hua tha. Lekin sirf is liye ke yeh log khud toh Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Ishaq A.S ki aulad mein se hain aur Nabi-e-Allah wa Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Arab hain. Inhon ne waqia ki asliyat badal di aur is fazeelat ko Hazrat Ismail A.S se hatakar Hazrat Ishaq A.S ko de diya aur beja taweelein karte Allah ke kalam ko badal dala. Aur kaha hamari kitab mein lafz 'Waheedak' hai is se murad iklota nahin balkay jo tere paas is waqt akela hai woh hai. Yeh is liye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S toh apni walida ke saath Makkah mein thay yahan Khalilullah ke saath sirf Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay. Lekin yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Waheed usi ko kaha jata hai jo iklota ho us ka aur koi bhai na ho. Phir yahan ek baat aur bhi hai ke iklotay aur pehlothi ke bache ke saath jo mohabbat hoti aur us ke jo laad pyar hotay hain umooman dusri aulad ke hone par phir woh baqi nahin rehte. Is liye is ke zabiha ka hukum imtehan aur aazmaish ki zabardast kari hai. Hum isay mantay hain ke baaz salaf bhi is ke qail huay hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay yahan tak ke baaz sahaba se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin yeh cheez Kitab-o-Sunnat se sabit nahin hoti. Balkay khayal yeh hai ke Bani Israel ki ek shohrat di hui baat ko in hazrat ne bhi bedaleel apne yahan le liya door kyun jayen Kitab-e-Allah ke alfaaz mein hi ghaur kar lijiye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ka 'Ghulamin Haleem' keh kar zikr hua aur phir Allah ki raah mein zibah ke liye tayar hone ka zikr hua. Is tamam bayan ko khatam karke phir Nabi-e-Saleh Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke tawalud ki basharat ka bayan hua. Aur farishton ne basharat-e-Ishaq ke mauqay par 'Ghulamin Aleem' farmaya tha. Isi tarah Quran mein hai basharat-e-Ishaq ke saath hi hai (وَمِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ اِسْحٰقَ يَعْقُوْبَ) (Surah Hud: 71) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein hi Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke yahan Hazrat Yaqub A.S paida honge yani un ki toh nasl jaari rehne ka pehle hi ilm karaya ja chuka tha ab unhein zibah karne ka hukum kaise diya jata? Isay hum pehle bhi bayan kar chuke.

Albatta Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ka wasf yahan par bardbari ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Jo Zabih ke liye nihayat munasib hai. Ab Hazrat Ismail bade ho gaye, apne walid ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye. Aap us waqt ma'a apni walida mohtarma ke Faran mein thay, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) umooman wahan jate aate rehte thay, yeh mazkoor hai ke Buraq par jate thay aur is jumle ke yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke jawani ke lag bhag ho gaye, ladakpan ka zamana nikal gaya aur baap ki tarah chalne phirne, kaam kaaj karne ke qabil ban gaye. Toh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne khwab dekha ke goya aap apne pyare bache ko zibah kar rahe hain. Anbiya ke khwab wahi hote hain aur is ki daleel yahi aayat hai. Ek marfoo' riwayat mein bhi yeh hai. Pas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apne lakht-e-jigar ki aazmaish ke liye ke achanak woh ghabra na uthein, apna irada un ke samne zahir kiya. Wahan kya tha? Woh bhi usi darakht ke phal thay, Nabi ibn-e-Nabi thay, jawab dete hain ab phir der kyun laga rahe ho? Yeh baatein bhi poochne ki hoti hain? Jo hukm hua hai use foran kar daliye aur agar meri nisbat khatka ho toh zabani itminani kya karoon, chhuri rakhiye khud maloom ho jayega ke main kaisa kuch sabir hoon. Insha'Allah mera sabr aap ka jee khush kar dega. SubhanAllah jo kaha tha wahi kar ke dikhaya aur Sadiq-ul-Wa'ad hone ka certificate Allah ki taraf se hasil kar hi liya. Aakhir baap beta dono hukm-e-Allah ki ita'at ke liye jaan ba-kaf tayyar ho jate hain, baap bache ko zibah karne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai. Aur baap apne noor-e-chashm lakht-e-jigar ko munh ke bal zameen par girate hain taake zibah ke waqt munh dekh kar mohabbat na aa jaye aur hath sust na pad jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apne noor-e-nazar ko zibah karne ke liye ba-hukm-e-Allah le chale toh sa'ee ke waqt Shaitan samne aaya lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) us se aage badh gaye, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath aap Jamra-e-Aqaba par pahunche toh phir Shaitan samne aaya, aap ne use saat kankariyan maarein. Phir Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas aaya phir wahan saat kankariyan maarein. Phir aage badh kar apne pyare bache ko Allah ke naam par zibah karne ke liye neeche pachhada, Zabihullah ke paak jism par us waqt safed chadar thi, kehne lage abba ji ise utaar lijiye taake is mein aap mujhe kafna sakein. Us waqt bete ko nanga karte waqt baap ka ajab haal tha ke aawaz aayi bas Ibrahim (A.S) khwab ko sacha kar chuke. Mud kar dekha toh ek menda safed rang ka bade bade seengon aur saaf aankhon wala nazar pada. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain isi liye hum is qisam ke mende (chhatre) chun chun kar qurbani ke liye lete thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) hi se dusri riwayat mein Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ka naam marwi hai. Toh go dono naam aap se marwi hain lekin awwal hi awla hai aur is ki daleelein aa rahi hain, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ke badle bada zabiha Allah ne ata farmaya, is ki babat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh Jannati chhatra tha jo wahan chalees saal se kha pee raha tha. Ise dekh kar aap apne bache ko chhod kar is ke peeche ho liye.

Jamra-e-Ula par aakar saat kankariyan phenkin, phir woh bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta par aa gaya. Saat kankariyan maarein aur wahan se Malkhar mein lakar zibah kiya, us ke seeng sar samet ibtida-e-Islam ke zamane tak Ka'be ke parnale ke paas latakte rahe thay phir sookh gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) baithe hue baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) toh hadeesein bayan kar rahe thay aur Hazrat Ka'b kitab ke qisse bayan kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke har Nabi ke liye ek dua qabool shuda hai aur main ne apni is maqbool dua ko posheeda karke rakh chora hai apni ummat ki shafa'at ke liye. Aur farmane lage tum par mere maa baap fida hon ya farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere maa baap sadqe jayein. Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanadan ghareeb aur munkar hai aur is ke ek rawi Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam za'eef hain aur mujhe toh yeh bhi dar hai ke yeh alfaaz ke (jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se) aakhir tak rawi apne na hon jinhein unhon ne hadith mein dakhil kardiye hain. Zabihullah toh Hazrat Ismail A.S hain, mahal-e-zibah Mina hai aur woh Makkah mein hai aur Hazrat Ismail yahin thay na ke Hazrat Ishaq woh toh shehar-e-Kanaan mein thay jo Shaam hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S apne pyare bache ko zibah karne ke liye lita dete hain janab-e-Bari se nida aati hai ke bas Ibrahim tum apne khwab ko poora kar chuke. Suddi se riwayat hai ke jab Khalilullah ne Zabihullah ke halq par chhuri pheri toh gardan taanbe ki ho gayi aur na kati aur yeh aawaz aayi. Hum isi tarah nek karon ko badla dete hain. Ya'ni sakhtiyon se bacha lete hain aur chhutkara kar dete hain. Jaise farmaya Allah se darte rehne walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala chhutkare ki soorat nikal hi deta hai aur use aisi tarah rozi pahunchata hai ke us ke gumaan-o-wahm mein bhi na ho. Allah par bharosa karne walon ko Allah hi kaafi hai Allah apne kaamon ko mukammal karke chhodta hai har cheez ka us ne ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Is aayat se is par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke fe'l par qudrat paane se pehle hi hukm mansookh ho sakta hai haan Mu'tazila ise nahin maante. Wajah-e-istidlal bahut zahir hai is liye ke Khalilullah ko apne bete ke zibah karne ka hukm hota hai aur phir zibah se pehle hi fidiye ke sath mansookh kardiya jata hai. Maqsood is se yeh tha ke sabr ka aur baja aawari-e-hukm par musta'idi ka sawab marhamat farma diya jaye. Isi liye irshad hua yeh toh sirf ek aazmaish thi khula imtehan tha ke idhar hukm hua idhar tayyari hui. Isi liye janab-e-Khalilullah A.S ki tareef mein Quran mein hai Ibrahim bada hi wafadar tha. Bade zabih ke sath un ka fidiya hum ne diya. Safed rang badi aankhon aur bade seengon wala umda khorak se pala hua mendha fidiye mein diya gaya jo zair-e-babool ke darakht se bandha hua mila. Jo jannat mein chalees saal charta raha. Mina mein zair ke paas jo chattan hai us par yeh janwar zibah kiya gaya yeh cheekhta hua oopar se utra tha. Yehi woh mendha hai jise Habil ne Allah ki raah mein qurban kiya tha. Is ki oon qadre surkhi mail thi is ka naam Jareer tha. Ba'az kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ise zibah kiya. Koi kehta hai Mina mein nahr par.

Ek shakhs ne apne tain rah-e-Allah mein zibah karne ki mannat mani thi toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne use ek sau oont zibah karne ka fatwa diya tha lekin phir farmate the ke agar main use ek bhed zibah karne ko kehta tab bhi kafi tha kyunke Kitabullah mein hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah ka fidiya usi se diya gaya tha. Aksar logon ka yahi qaul hai, baaz kehte hain yeh pahadi bakra tha, koi kehta hai nar hiran tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne bhed ke seeng Baitullah Sharif mein dakhle ke waqt andar dekhe the aur mujhe yaad na raha ke main tujhe unke dhank dene ka hukum doon, jao use dhak do, Baitullah mein koi aisi cheez na honi chahiye jo namazi ko apni taraf mutawajja kar le. Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain us bhed ke seeng Baitullah mein hi rahe yahan tak ke ek martaba Baitullah mein aag lagi us mein woh jal gaye, yeh waqia bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the, isi wajah se unki aulad Quraish tak yeh seeng barabar aur musalsal chale aaye yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne mab'oos farmaya. Wallahu A'lam. "Un aasar ka bayan jin mein Zabihullah ka naam hai" Abu Maisara farmate hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne badshah se farmaya kya tu mere sath khana chahta hai? Main Yusuf bin Yaqub Nabiullah bin Ishaq Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah hoon. (Ubaid bin Umair) Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-Bari mein arz ki ke aye Allah kya wajah hai jo logon ki zabanon par yeh chadha hua hai ke Ibrahim, Ismail aur Yaqub ke Allah ki qasam, toh jawab mila is liye ke Ibrahim ne toh har har cheez par mujhi ko tarjeeh di aur Ishaq (A.S) ne apne tain meri rah mein zibah hone ke liye supurd kar diya phir bhala aur cheezein use pesh kar dena kya mushkil thin aur Yaqub ko main joon joon balaon mein dalta gaya uske husn-e-zanni mere sath badhti hi rahi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke samne ek martaba kisi ne fakhran apne baap dadon ka naam liya toh aap ne farmaya qabil-e-fakhr baap dada toh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke the jo Yaqub bin Ishaq aur Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah the. Ikrama, Ibn-e-Abbas, khud Abbas, Ali, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Ubaid bin Umair, Abu Maisara, Zaid bin Aslam, Abdullah bin Shafiq, Zuhri, Qasim bin Abu Barza, Makhool, Usman bin Abi Aas, Suddi, Hasan, Qatada, Abu Al-Huzail, Ibn-e-Sabit, Ka'ab Ahbar (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een), in sab ka yahi qaul hai aur Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the. Sahih ilm toh Allah ko hi hai magar bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ke in sab buzurgon ke ustad Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar hain. Yeh khilafat-e-Farooqi mein musalman hue the aur kabhi kabhi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko qadeemi kitabon ki baatein sunate the, logon ne ise rukhsat samajh kar phir un se har ek baat bayan karni shuru kar di aur sahih ghalat ki tameez uth gayi, haq toh yeh hai ke is ummat ko agli kitabon ki ek baat ki bhi haajat nahin. Baghawi ne kuch aur naam bhi Sahaba-o-Tabieen ke batlaye hain jinhon ne kaha hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain.

Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai agar woh hadith sahi hoti toh jhagray ka faisla tha magar woh hadith sahi nahin is mein do rawi za'eef hain. Hasan bin Dinar matrook hain aur Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an munkar-ul-hadith hain aur zyada sahi yeh hai ke hai yeh bhi mauqif, chunancha ek sanad se yeh maqoola Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ab un aasar ko suniye jin se maloom hota hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi thay aur yahi theek aur bilkul durust bhi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmatay hain aur farmatay hain ke Yahudi Hazrat Ishaq ka naam jhoot moot letay hain. Ibn-e-Umar, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Hasan Basri, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi, Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ke samnay jab Muhammad bin Qurzi ne yeh farmaya aur saath hi is ki daleel bhi di ke zibh ke zikr ke baad Quran mein Khalilullah ko Hazrat Ishaq ke paida honay ki basharat ka zikr hai aur saath hi bayan hai ke un ke haan bhi larka hoga Yaqub nami jab un ke haan larka honay ki basharat di gayi thi phir bawajood un ke haan larka na honay ke us se pehlay hi un ke zibh karnay ka hukum kaisay diya jata hai? Toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya yeh bohat saaf daleel hai mera zehan yahan nahin pohancha tha go yeh main bhi jaanta tha ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi hain phir Shah-e-Islam ne Shaam ke ek Yahudi aalim se poocha jo Musalman ho gaye thay ke tum is baray mein kya ilm rakhtay ho unhon ne farmaya Ameer-ul-Muslimeen sach toh yahi hai ke jin ke zibh karnay ka hukum diya gaya woh Hazrat Ismail hi thay lekin chunkay Arab un ki aulad mein se hain toh yeh buzurgi un ki taraf laut-ti hai is hasad ke baray mein Yahudiyon ne isay badal diya aur Hazrat Ishaq ka naam le diya. Haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai hamara imaan hai ke Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ishaq dono hi tahir-o-tayyab aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay. Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah ne apnay walid se jab yeh masla poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke zibh honay walay Hazrat Ismail hi thay. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Abu Tufail, Saeed bin Musayyab, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Saleh (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Baghawi ne aur bhi sahaba aur tabieen ke naam ginuwaye hain. Ek ghareeb hadith bhi isi ki ta'eed mein marwi hai is mein hai ke Shaam mein Ameer Muawiyah ke samnay yeh behas churi ke Zabihullah kaun hain? Toh aap ne farmaya khoob hua jo yeh mamla mujh jaisay bakhabar shakhs ke paas aaya suno hum Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas thay jab ek shakhs aap ke paas aaya aur kehnay laga ae Allah ki raah mein do zibh honay walon ki nasl ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe bhi maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch dilwaiye is par aap hans diye. Ek toh Zabihullah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah thay dusray Hazrat Ismail jin ki nasl mein se aap hain.

Abdullah ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia yeh hai ke aap ke dada Abdul Muttalib ne jab Chah-e-Zamzam khoda to nazr mani thi ke agar yeh kaam aasani se pura ho gaya to apne ek ladke ko rah-e-Allah mein zibah karunga. Jab kaam ho gaya aur qura-andazi ki gayi ke kis bete ko Allah ke naam par zibah karein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah ka naam nikla. Un ke nanhiyal walon ne kaha aap un ki taraf se ek sau oont rah-e-Allah zibah kar dein, chunancha woh zibah kar diye gaye aur Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia to mashhoor hi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein yeh riwayat majood hai aur Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein bhi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ki ek daleel to yeh pesh ki hai ke jis 'Ghulamin Aleem' (ilm wale bache) ki basharat ka zikr hai us se murad Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'Wa bashsharu bi ghulamin aleem' aur Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki basharat ka yeh jawab diya hai ke woh aap ke sath chalne phirne ki umar ko pahunch gaye the aur mumkin hai ke Yaqub (A.S) ke sath hi koi aur aulad bhi hui ho. Aur Ka'batullah mein seengon ki maujoodgi ke bare mein farmate hain bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Bilad-e-Kanaan se la kar yahan rakhe gaye hon aur baaz logon se Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke naam ki sarahat bhi aayi hai, lekin yeh sab baatein haqeeqat se bahut door hain. Haan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone par Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka istidlal bahut saaf aur qawi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pehle Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke tawallud hone ki basharat di gayi thi, yahan us ke baad un ke bhai Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ki basharat di ja rahi hai. Surah Hud aur Surah Hijr mein bhi is ka zikr guzar chuka hai. 'Nabiyan' haal-e-muqaddara hai yani woh Nabi-e-Saleh hoga. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Zabihullah Ishaq (A.S) the aur yahan nabuwat Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ko basharat hai. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bare mein farman hai ke hum ne unhein apni rahmat se un ke bhai Haroon (A.S) ko Nabi bana diya. Halankeh Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bade the to yahan bhi un ki nabuwat ki basharat hai. Pas yeh basharat us waqt di gayi jabkeh imtihan-e-zibah mein woh sabir sabit huye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh basharat do martaba di gayi, paidaish se kuch qabl aur nabuwat se kuch qabl. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Un par aur Ishaq (A.S) par hamari barkatein hum ne nazil farmayin, un ki aulad mein har qisam ke log hain nek bhi bad bhi. Jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se farman hua tha ke ae Nuh! Hamari salam aur barkat ke sath utar. Tu bhi aur tere sath wale bhi aur aise bhi log hain jinhein hum faide pahunchayenge phir unhein hamari taraf se dardnak azab pahunchenge.

Zabihullah ki behas aur Yahudi riwayat. Khalilullah jab apni qoum ki hidayat se mayus hogaye. Bari bari qudrati nishaniyan dekh kar bhi jab unhein iman naseeb na hua toh aap ne un se hat jana pasand farmaya aur elan kardiya ke main ab tum mein se hijrat karjaunga mera rehnuma mera Rab hai. Saath hi apne Rab se apne yahan aulad hone ki dua mangi taake wahi tauheed mein aap ka saath de. Isi waqt dua qabool hoti hai aur ek burdbar bache ki basharat di jati hai. Yeh Hazrat Ismail A.S thay yahi aap ke liye sahibzade thay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S se baray thay. Isay toh Ahl-e-Kitab bhi mantay hain balkay un ki kutub mein majood hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki paidaish ke waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki umar chiyasi saal ki thi aur jis waqt Hazrat Ishaq A.S tawalud hotay hain us waqt aap ki umar ninnanway baras ki thi. Balkay un ki apni kitab mein toh yeh bhi hai ke Janab Ibrahim A.S ko apne iklotay farzand ko zibah karne ka hukum hua tha. Lekin sirf is liye ke yeh log khud toh Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Ishaq A.S ki aulad mein se hain aur Nabi-e-Allah wa Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Arab hain. Inhon ne waqia ki asliyat badal di aur is fazeelat ko Hazrat Ismail A.S se hatakar Hazrat Ishaq A.S ko de diya aur beja taweelein karte Allah ke kalam ko badal dala. Aur kaha hamari kitab mein lafz 'Waheedak' hai is se murad iklota nahin balkay jo tere paas is waqt akela hai woh hai. Yeh is liye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S toh apni walida ke saath Makkah mein thay yahan Khalilullah ke saath sirf Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay. Lekin yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Waheed usi ko kaha jata hai jo iklota ho us ka aur koi bhai na ho. Phir yahan ek baat aur bhi hai ke iklotay aur pehlothi ke bache ke saath jo mohabbat hoti aur us ke jo laad pyar hotay hain umooman dusri aulad ke hone par phir woh baqi nahin rehte. Is liye is ke zabiha ka hukum imtehan aur aazmaish ki zabardast kari hai. Hum isay mantay hain ke baaz salaf bhi is ke qail huay hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay yahan tak ke baaz sahaba se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin yeh cheez Kitab-o-Sunnat se sabit nahin hoti. Balkay khayal yeh hai ke Bani Israel ki ek shohrat di hui baat ko in hazrat ne bhi bedaleel apne yahan le liya door kyun jayen Kitab-e-Allah ke alfaaz mein hi ghaur kar lijiye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ka 'Ghulamin Haleem' keh kar zikr hua aur phir Allah ki raah mein zibah ke liye tayar hone ka zikr hua. Is tamam bayan ko khatam karke phir Nabi-e-Saleh Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke tawalud ki basharat ka bayan hua. Aur farishton ne basharat-e-Ishaq ke mauqay par 'Ghulamin Aleem' farmaya tha. Isi tarah Quran mein hai basharat-e-Ishaq ke saath hi hai (وَمِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ اِسْحٰقَ يَعْقُوْبَ) (Surah Hud: 71) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein hi Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke yahan Hazrat Yaqub A.S paida honge yani un ki toh nasl jaari rehne ka pehle hi ilm karaya ja chuka tha ab unhein zibah karne ka hukum kaise diya jata? Isay hum pehle bhi bayan kar chuke.

Albatta Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ka wasf yahan par bardbari ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Jo Zabih ke liye nihayat munasib hai. Ab Hazrat Ismail bade ho gaye, apne walid ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye. Aap us waqt ma'a apni walida mohtarma ke Faran mein thay, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) umooman wahan jate aate rehte thay, yeh mazkoor hai ke Buraq par jate thay aur is jumle ke yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke jawani ke lag bhag ho gaye, ladakpan ka zamana nikal gaya aur baap ki tarah chalne phirne, kaam kaaj karne ke qabil ban gaye. Toh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne khwab dekha ke goya aap apne pyare bache ko zibah kar rahe hain. Anbiya ke khwab wahi hote hain aur is ki daleel yahi aayat hai. Ek marfoo' riwayat mein bhi yeh hai. Pas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apne lakht-e-jigar ki aazmaish ke liye ke achanak woh ghabra na uthein, apna irada un ke samne zahir kiya. Wahan kya tha? Woh bhi usi darakht ke phal thay, Nabi ibn-e-Nabi thay, jawab dete hain ab phir der kyun laga rahe ho? Yeh baatein bhi poochne ki hoti hain? Jo hukm hua hai use foran kar daliye aur agar meri nisbat khatka ho toh zabani itminani kya karoon, chhuri rakhiye khud maloom ho jayega ke main kaisa kuch sabir hoon. Insha'Allah mera sabr aap ka jee khush kar dega. SubhanAllah jo kaha tha wahi kar ke dikhaya aur Sadiq-ul-Wa'ad hone ka certificate Allah ki taraf se hasil kar hi liya. Aakhir baap beta dono hukm-e-Allah ki ita'at ke liye jaan ba-kaf tayyar ho jate hain, baap bache ko zibah karne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai. Aur baap apne noor-e-chashm lakht-e-jigar ko munh ke bal zameen par girate hain taake zibah ke waqt munh dekh kar mohabbat na aa jaye aur hath sust na pad jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apne noor-e-nazar ko zibah karne ke liye ba-hukm-e-Allah le chale toh sa'ee ke waqt Shaitan samne aaya lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) us se aage badh gaye, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath aap Jamra-e-Aqaba par pahunche toh phir Shaitan samne aaya, aap ne use saat kankariyan maarein. Phir Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas aaya phir wahan saat kankariyan maarein. Phir aage badh kar apne pyare bache ko Allah ke naam par zibah karne ke liye neeche pachhada, Zabihullah ke paak jism par us waqt safed chadar thi, kehne lage abba ji ise utaar lijiye taake is mein aap mujhe kafna sakein. Us waqt bete ko nanga karte waqt baap ka ajab haal tha ke aawaz aayi bas Ibrahim (A.S) khwab ko sacha kar chuke. Mud kar dekha toh ek menda safed rang ka bade bade seengon aur saaf aankhon wala nazar pada. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain isi liye hum is qisam ke mende (chhatre) chun chun kar qurbani ke liye lete thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) hi se dusri riwayat mein Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ka naam marwi hai. Toh go dono naam aap se marwi hain lekin awwal hi awla hai aur is ki daleelein aa rahi hain, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ke badle bada zabiha Allah ne ata farmaya, is ki babat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh Jannati chhatra tha jo wahan chalees saal se kha pee raha tha. Ise dekh kar aap apne bache ko chhod kar is ke peeche ho liye.

Jamra-e-Ula par aakar saat kankariyan phenkin, phir woh bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta par aa gaya. Saat kankariyan maarein aur wahan se Malkhar mein lakar zibah kiya, us ke seeng sar samet ibtida-e-Islam ke zamane tak Ka'be ke parnale ke paas latakte rahe thay phir sookh gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) baithe hue baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) toh hadeesein bayan kar rahe thay aur Hazrat Ka'b kitab ke qisse bayan kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke har Nabi ke liye ek dua qabool shuda hai aur main ne apni is maqbool dua ko posheeda karke rakh chora hai apni ummat ki shafa'at ke liye. Aur farmane lage tum par mere maa baap fida hon ya farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere maa baap sadqe jayein. Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanadan ghareeb aur munkar hai aur is ke ek rawi Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam za'eef hain aur mujhe toh yeh bhi dar hai ke yeh alfaaz ke (jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se) aakhir tak rawi apne na hon jinhein unhon ne hadith mein dakhil kardiye hain. Zabihullah toh Hazrat Ismail A.S hain, mahal-e-zibah Mina hai aur woh Makkah mein hai aur Hazrat Ismail yahin thay na ke Hazrat Ishaq woh toh shehar-e-Kanaan mein thay jo Shaam hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S apne pyare bache ko zibah karne ke liye lita dete hain janab-e-Bari se nida aati hai ke bas Ibrahim tum apne khwab ko poora kar chuke. Suddi se riwayat hai ke jab Khalilullah ne Zabihullah ke halq par chhuri pheri toh gardan taanbe ki ho gayi aur na kati aur yeh aawaz aayi. Hum isi tarah nek karon ko badla dete hain. Ya'ni sakhtiyon se bacha lete hain aur chhutkara kar dete hain. Jaise farmaya Allah se darte rehne walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala chhutkare ki soorat nikal hi deta hai aur use aisi tarah rozi pahunchata hai ke us ke gumaan-o-wahm mein bhi na ho. Allah par bharosa karne walon ko Allah hi kaafi hai Allah apne kaamon ko mukammal karke chhodta hai har cheez ka us ne ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Is aayat se is par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke fe'l par qudrat paane se pehle hi hukm mansookh ho sakta hai haan Mu'tazila ise nahin maante. Wajah-e-istidlal bahut zahir hai is liye ke Khalilullah ko apne bete ke zibah karne ka hukm hota hai aur phir zibah se pehle hi fidiye ke sath mansookh kardiya jata hai.
