Maqsood is se yeh tha ke sabr ka aur baja aawari-e-hukm par musta'idi ka sawab marhamat farma diya jaye. Isi liye irshad hua yeh toh sirf ek aazmaish thi khula imtehan tha ke idhar hukm hua idhar tayyari hui. Isi liye janab-e-Khalilullah A.S ki tareef mein Quran mein hai Ibrahim bada hi wafadar tha. Bade zabih ke sath un ka fidiya hum ne diya. Safed rang badi aankhon aur bade seengon wala umda khorak se pala hua mendha fidiye mein diya gaya jo zair-e-babool ke darakht se bandha hua mila. Jo jannat mein chalees saal charta raha. Mina mein zair ke paas jo chattan hai us par yeh janwar zibah kiya gaya yeh cheekhta hua oopar se utra tha. Yehi woh mendha hai jise Habil ne Allah ki raah mein qurban kiya tha. Is ki oon qadre surkhi mail thi is ka naam Jareer tha. Ba'az kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ise zibah kiya. Koi kehta hai Mina mein nahr par.

Ek shakhs ne apne tain rah-e-Allah mein zibah karne ki mannat mani thi toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne use ek sau oont zibah karne ka fatwa diya tha lekin phir farmate the ke agar main use ek bhed zibah karne ko kehta tab bhi kafi tha kyunke Kitabullah mein hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah ka fidiya usi se diya gaya tha. Aksar logon ka yahi qaul hai, baaz kehte hain yeh pahadi bakra tha, koi kehta hai nar hiran tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne bhed ke seeng Baitullah Sharif mein dakhle ke waqt andar dekhe the aur mujhe yaad na raha ke main tujhe unke dhank dene ka hukum doon, jao use dhak do, Baitullah mein koi aisi cheez na honi chahiye jo namazi ko apni taraf mutawajja kar le. Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain us bhed ke seeng Baitullah mein hi rahe yahan tak ke ek martaba Baitullah mein aag lagi us mein woh jal gaye, yeh waqia bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the, isi wajah se unki aulad Quraish tak yeh seeng barabar aur musalsal chale aaye yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne mab'oos farmaya. Wallahu A'lam. "Un aasar ka bayan jin mein Zabihullah ka naam hai" Abu Maisara farmate hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne badshah se farmaya kya tu mere sath khana chahta hai? Main Yusuf bin Yaqub Nabiullah bin Ishaq Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah hoon. (Ubaid bin Umair) Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-Bari mein arz ki ke aye Allah kya wajah hai jo logon ki zabanon par yeh chadha hua hai ke Ibrahim, Ismail aur Yaqub ke Allah ki qasam, toh jawab mila is liye ke Ibrahim ne toh har har cheez par mujhi ko tarjeeh di aur Ishaq (A.S) ne apne tain meri rah mein zibah hone ke liye supurd kar diya phir bhala aur cheezein use pesh kar dena kya mushkil thin aur Yaqub ko main joon joon balaon mein dalta gaya uske husn-e-zanni mere sath badhti hi rahi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke samne ek martaba kisi ne fakhran apne baap dadon ka naam liya toh aap ne farmaya qabil-e-fakhr baap dada toh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke the jo Yaqub bin Ishaq aur Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah the. Ikrama, Ibn-e-Abbas, khud Abbas, Ali, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Ubaid bin Umair, Abu Maisara, Zaid bin Aslam, Abdullah bin Shafiq, Zuhri, Qasim bin Abu Barza, Makhool, Usman bin Abi Aas, Suddi, Hasan, Qatada, Abu Al-Huzail, Ibn-e-Sabit, Ka'ab Ahbar (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een), in sab ka yahi qaul hai aur Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the. Sahih ilm toh Allah ko hi hai magar bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ke in sab buzurgon ke ustad Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar hain. Yeh khilafat-e-Farooqi mein musalman hue the aur kabhi kabhi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko qadeemi kitabon ki baatein sunate the, logon ne ise rukhsat samajh kar phir un se har ek baat bayan karni shuru kar di aur sahih ghalat ki tameez uth gayi, haq toh yeh hai ke is ummat ko agli kitabon ki ek baat ki bhi haajat nahin. Baghawi ne kuch aur naam bhi Sahaba-o-Tabieen ke batlaye hain jinhon ne kaha hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain.

Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai agar woh hadith sahi hoti toh jhagray ka faisla tha magar woh hadith sahi nahin is mein do rawi za'eef hain. Hasan bin Dinar matrook hain aur Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an munkar-ul-hadith hain aur zyada sahi yeh hai ke hai yeh bhi mauqif, chunancha ek sanad se yeh maqoola Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ab un aasar ko suniye jin se maloom hota hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi thay aur yahi theek aur bilkul durust bhi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmatay hain aur farmatay hain ke Yahudi Hazrat Ishaq ka naam jhoot moot letay hain. Ibn-e-Umar, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Hasan Basri, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi, Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ke samnay jab Muhammad bin Qurzi ne yeh farmaya aur saath hi is ki daleel bhi di ke zibh ke zikr ke baad Quran mein Khalilullah ko Hazrat Ishaq ke paida honay ki basharat ka zikr hai aur saath hi bayan hai ke un ke haan bhi larka hoga Yaqub nami jab un ke haan larka honay ki basharat di gayi thi phir bawajood un ke haan larka na honay ke us se pehlay hi un ke zibh karnay ka hukum kaisay diya jata hai? Toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya yeh bohat saaf daleel hai mera zehan yahan nahin pohancha tha go yeh main bhi jaanta tha ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi hain phir Shah-e-Islam ne Shaam ke ek Yahudi aalim se poocha jo Musalman ho gaye thay ke tum is baray mein kya ilm rakhtay ho unhon ne farmaya Ameer-ul-Muslimeen sach toh yahi hai ke jin ke zibh karnay ka hukum diya gaya woh Hazrat Ismail hi thay lekin chunkay Arab un ki aulad mein se hain toh yeh buzurgi un ki taraf laut-ti hai is hasad ke baray mein Yahudiyon ne isay badal diya aur Hazrat Ishaq ka naam le diya. Haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai hamara imaan hai ke Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ishaq dono hi tahir-o-tayyab aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay. Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah ne apnay walid se jab yeh masla poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke zibh honay walay Hazrat Ismail hi thay. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Abu Tufail, Saeed bin Musayyab, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Saleh (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Baghawi ne aur bhi sahaba aur tabieen ke naam ginuwaye hain. Ek ghareeb hadith bhi isi ki ta'eed mein marwi hai is mein hai ke Shaam mein Ameer Muawiyah ke samnay yeh behas churi ke Zabihullah kaun hain? Toh aap ne farmaya khoob hua jo yeh mamla mujh jaisay bakhabar shakhs ke paas aaya suno hum Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas thay jab ek shakhs aap ke paas aaya aur kehnay laga ae Allah ki raah mein do zibh honay walon ki nasl ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe bhi maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch dilwaiye is par aap hans diye. Ek toh Zabihullah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah thay dusray Hazrat Ismail jin ki nasl mein se aap hain.

Abdullah ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia yeh hai ke aap ke dada Abdul Muttalib ne jab Chah-e-Zamzam khoda to nazr mani thi ke agar yeh kaam aasani se pura ho gaya to apne ek ladke ko rah-e-Allah mein zibah karunga. Jab kaam ho gaya aur qura-andazi ki gayi ke kis bete ko Allah ke naam par zibah karein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah ka naam nikla. Un ke nanhiyal walon ne kaha aap un ki taraf se ek sau oont rah-e-Allah zibah kar dein, chunancha woh zibah kar diye gaye aur Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia to mashhoor hi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein yeh riwayat majood hai aur Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein bhi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ki ek daleel to yeh pesh ki hai ke jis 'Ghulamin Aleem' (ilm wale bache) ki basharat ka zikr hai us se murad Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'Wa bashsharu bi ghulamin aleem' aur Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki basharat ka yeh jawab diya hai ke woh aap ke sath chalne phirne ki umar ko pahunch gaye the aur mumkin hai ke Yaqub (A.S) ke sath hi koi aur aulad bhi hui ho. Aur Ka'batullah mein seengon ki maujoodgi ke bare mein farmate hain bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Bilad-e-Kanaan se la kar yahan rakhe gaye hon aur baaz logon se Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke naam ki sarahat bhi aayi hai, lekin yeh sab baatein haqeeqat se bahut door hain. Haan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone par Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka istidlal bahut saaf aur qawi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pehle Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke tawallud hone ki basharat di gayi thi, yahan us ke baad un ke bhai Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ki basharat di ja rahi hai. Surah Hud aur Surah Hijr mein bhi is ka zikr guzar chuka hai. 'Nabiyan' haal-e-muqaddara hai yani woh Nabi-e-Saleh hoga. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Zabihullah Ishaq (A.S) the aur yahan nabuwat Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ko basharat hai. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bare mein farman hai ke hum ne unhein apni rahmat se un ke bhai Haroon (A.S) ko Nabi bana diya. Halankeh Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bade the to yahan bhi un ki nabuwat ki basharat hai. Pas yeh basharat us waqt di gayi jabkeh imtihan-e-zibah mein woh sabir sabit huye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh basharat do martaba di gayi, paidaish se kuch qabl aur nabuwat se kuch qabl. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Un par aur Ishaq (A.S) par hamari barkatein hum ne nazil farmayin, un ki aulad mein har qisam ke log hain nek bhi bad bhi. Jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se farman hua tha ke ae Nuh! Hamari salam aur barkat ke sath utar. Tu bhi aur tere sath wale bhi aur aise bhi log hain jinhein hum faide pahunchayenge phir unhein hamari taraf se dardnak azab pahunchenge.

Zabihullah ki behas aur Yahudi riwayat. Khalilullah jab apni qoum ki hidayat se mayus hogaye. Bari bari qudrati nishaniyan dekh kar bhi jab unhein iman naseeb na hua toh aap ne un se hat jana pasand farmaya aur elan kardiya ke main ab tum mein se hijrat karjaunga mera rehnuma mera Rab hai. Saath hi apne Rab se apne yahan aulad hone ki dua mangi taake wahi tauheed mein aap ka saath de. Isi waqt dua qabool hoti hai aur ek burdbar bache ki basharat di jati hai. Yeh Hazrat Ismail A.S thay yahi aap ke liye sahibzade thay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S se baray thay. Isay toh Ahl-e-Kitab bhi mantay hain balkay un ki kutub mein majood hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki paidaish ke waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki umar chiyasi saal ki thi aur jis waqt Hazrat Ishaq A.S tawalud hotay hain us waqt aap ki umar ninnanway baras ki thi. Balkay un ki apni kitab mein toh yeh bhi hai ke Janab Ibrahim A.S ko apne iklotay farzand ko zibah karne ka hukum hua tha. Lekin sirf is liye ke yeh log khud toh Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Ishaq A.S ki aulad mein se hain aur Nabi-e-Allah wa Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Arab hain. Inhon ne waqia ki asliyat badal di aur is fazeelat ko Hazrat Ismail A.S se hatakar Hazrat Ishaq A.S ko de diya aur beja taweelein karte Allah ke kalam ko badal dala. Aur kaha hamari kitab mein lafz 'Waheedak' hai is se murad iklota nahin balkay jo tere paas is waqt akela hai woh hai. Yeh is liye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S toh apni walida ke saath Makkah mein thay yahan Khalilullah ke saath sirf Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay. Lekin yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Waheed usi ko kaha jata hai jo iklota ho us ka aur koi bhai na ho. Phir yahan ek baat aur bhi hai ke iklotay aur pehlothi ke bache ke saath jo mohabbat hoti aur us ke jo laad pyar hotay hain umooman dusri aulad ke hone par phir woh baqi nahin rehte. Is liye is ke zabiha ka hukum imtehan aur aazmaish ki zabardast kari hai. Hum isay mantay hain ke baaz salaf bhi is ke qail huay hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay yahan tak ke baaz sahaba se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin yeh cheez Kitab-o-Sunnat se sabit nahin hoti. Balkay khayal yeh hai ke Bani Israel ki ek shohrat di hui baat ko in hazrat ne bhi bedaleel apne yahan le liya door kyun jayen Kitab-e-Allah ke alfaaz mein hi ghaur kar lijiye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ka 'Ghulamin Haleem' keh kar zikr hua aur phir Allah ki raah mein zibah ke liye tayar hone ka zikr hua. Is tamam bayan ko khatam karke phir Nabi-e-Saleh Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke tawalud ki basharat ka bayan hua. Aur farishton ne basharat-e-Ishaq ke mauqay par 'Ghulamin Aleem' farmaya tha. Isi tarah Quran mein hai basharat-e-Ishaq ke saath hi hai (وَمِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ اِسْحٰقَ يَعْقُوْبَ) (Surah Hud: 71) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein hi Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke yahan Hazrat Yaqub A.S paida honge yani un ki toh nasl jaari rehne ka pehle hi ilm karaya ja chuka tha ab unhein zibah karne ka hukum kaise diya jata? Isay hum pehle bhi bayan kar chuke.

Albatta Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ka wasf yahan par bardbari ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Jo Zabih ke liye nihayat munasib hai. Ab Hazrat Ismail bade ho gaye, apne walid ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye. Aap us waqt ma'a apni walida mohtarma ke Faran mein thay, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) umooman wahan jate aate rehte thay, yeh mazkoor hai ke Buraq par jate thay aur is jumle ke yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke jawani ke lag bhag ho gaye, ladakpan ka zamana nikal gaya aur baap ki tarah chalne phirne, kaam kaaj karne ke qabil ban gaye. Toh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne khwab dekha ke goya aap apne pyare bache ko zibah kar rahe hain. Anbiya ke khwab wahi hote hain aur is ki daleel yahi aayat hai. Ek marfoo' riwayat mein bhi yeh hai. Pas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apne lakht-e-jigar ki aazmaish ke liye ke achanak woh ghabra na uthein, apna irada un ke samne zahir kiya. Wahan kya tha? Woh bhi usi darakht ke phal thay, Nabi ibn-e-Nabi thay, jawab dete hain ab phir der kyun laga rahe ho? Yeh baatein bhi poochne ki hoti hain? Jo hukm hua hai use foran kar daliye aur agar meri nisbat khatka ho toh zabani itminani kya karoon, chhuri rakhiye khud maloom ho jayega ke main kaisa kuch sabir hoon. Insha'Allah mera sabr aap ka jee khush kar dega. SubhanAllah jo kaha tha wahi kar ke dikhaya aur Sadiq-ul-Wa'ad hone ka certificate Allah ki taraf se hasil kar hi liya. Aakhir baap beta dono hukm-e-Allah ki ita'at ke liye jaan ba-kaf tayyar ho jate hain, baap bache ko zibah karne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai. Aur baap apne noor-e-chashm lakht-e-jigar ko munh ke bal zameen par girate hain taake zibah ke waqt munh dekh kar mohabbat na aa jaye aur hath sust na pad jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apne noor-e-nazar ko zibah karne ke liye ba-hukm-e-Allah le chale toh sa'ee ke waqt Shaitan samne aaya lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) us se aage badh gaye, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath aap Jamra-e-Aqaba par pahunche toh phir Shaitan samne aaya, aap ne use saat kankariyan maarein. Phir Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas aaya phir wahan saat kankariyan maarein. Phir aage badh kar apne pyare bache ko Allah ke naam par zibah karne ke liye neeche pachhada, Zabihullah ke paak jism par us waqt safed chadar thi, kehne lage abba ji ise utaar lijiye taake is mein aap mujhe kafna sakein. Us waqt bete ko nanga karte waqt baap ka ajab haal tha ke aawaz aayi bas Ibrahim (A.S) khwab ko sacha kar chuke. Mud kar dekha toh ek menda safed rang ka bade bade seengon aur saaf aankhon wala nazar pada. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain isi liye hum is qisam ke mende (chhatre) chun chun kar qurbani ke liye lete thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) hi se dusri riwayat mein Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ka naam marwi hai. Toh go dono naam aap se marwi hain lekin awwal hi awla hai aur is ki daleelein aa rahi hain, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ke badle bada zabiha Allah ne ata farmaya, is ki babat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh Jannati chhatra tha jo wahan chalees saal se kha pee raha tha. Ise dekh kar aap apne bache ko chhod kar is ke peeche ho liye.

Jamra-e-Ula par aakar saat kankariyan phenkin, phir woh bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta par aa gaya. Saat kankariyan maarein aur wahan se Malkhar mein lakar zibah kiya, us ke seeng sar samet ibtida-e-Islam ke zamane tak Ka'be ke parnale ke paas latakte rahe thay phir sookh gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) baithe hue baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) toh hadeesein bayan kar rahe thay aur Hazrat Ka'b kitab ke qisse bayan kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke har Nabi ke liye ek dua qabool shuda hai aur main ne apni is maqbool dua ko posheeda karke rakh chora hai apni ummat ki shafa'at ke liye. Aur farmane lage tum par mere maa baap fida hon ya farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere maa baap sadqe jayein. Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanadan ghareeb aur munkar hai aur is ke ek rawi Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam za'eef hain aur mujhe toh yeh bhi dar hai ke yeh alfaaz ke (jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se) aakhir tak rawi apne na hon jinhein unhon ne hadith mein dakhil kardiye hain. Zabihullah toh Hazrat Ismail A.S hain, mahal-e-zibah Mina hai aur woh Makkah mein hai aur Hazrat Ismail yahin thay na ke Hazrat Ishaq woh toh shehar-e-Kanaan mein thay jo Shaam hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S apne pyare bache ko zibah karne ke liye lita dete hain janab-e-Bari se nida aati hai ke bas Ibrahim tum apne khwab ko poora kar chuke. Suddi se riwayat hai ke jab Khalilullah ne Zabihullah ke halq par chhuri pheri toh gardan taanbe ki ho gayi aur na kati aur yeh aawaz aayi. Hum isi tarah nek karon ko badla dete hain. Ya'ni sakhtiyon se bacha lete hain aur chhutkara kar dete hain. Jaise farmaya Allah se darte rehne walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala chhutkare ki soorat nikal hi deta hai aur use aisi tarah rozi pahunchata hai ke us ke gumaan-o-wahm mein bhi na ho. Allah par bharosa karne walon ko Allah hi kaafi hai Allah apne kaamon ko mukammal karke chhodta hai har cheez ka us ne ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Is aayat se is par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke fe'l par qudrat paane se pehle hi hukm mansookh ho sakta hai haan Mu'tazila ise nahin maante. Wajah-e-istidlal bahut zahir hai is liye ke Khalilullah ko apne bete ke zibah karne ka hukm hota hai aur phir zibah se pehle hi fidiye ke sath mansookh kardiya jata hai. Maqsood is se yeh tha ke sabr ka aur baja aawari-e-hukm par musta'idi ka sawab marhamat farma diya jaye. Isi liye irshad hua yeh toh sirf ek aazmaish thi khula imtehan tha ke idhar hukm hua idhar tayyari hui. Isi liye janab-e-Khalilullah A.S ki tareef mein Quran mein hai Ibrahim bada hi wafadar tha. Bade zabih ke sath un ka fidiya hum ne diya. Safed rang badi aankhon aur bade seengon wala umda khorak se pala hua mendha fidiye mein diya gaya jo zair-e-babool ke darakht se bandha hua mila. Jo jannat mein chalees saal charta raha. Mina mein zair ke paas jo chattan hai us par yeh janwar zibah kiya gaya yeh cheekhta hua oopar se utra tha. Yehi woh mendha hai jise Habil ne Allah ki raah mein qurban kiya tha. Is ki oon qadre surkhi mail thi is ka naam Jareer tha. Ba'az kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ise zibah kiya. Koi kehta hai Mina mein nahr par.

Ek shakhs ne apne tain rah-e-Allah mein zibah karne ki mannat mani thi toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne use ek sau oont zibah karne ka fatwa diya tha lekin phir farmate the ke agar main use ek bhed zibah karne ko kehta tab bhi kafi tha kyunke Kitabullah mein hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah ka fidiya usi se diya gaya tha. Aksar logon ka yahi qaul hai, baaz kehte hain yeh pahadi bakra tha, koi kehta hai nar hiran tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne bhed ke seeng Baitullah Sharif mein dakhle ke waqt andar dekhe the aur mujhe yaad na raha ke main tujhe unke dhank dene ka hukum doon, jao use dhak do, Baitullah mein koi aisi cheez na honi chahiye jo namazi ko apni taraf mutawajja kar le. Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain us bhed ke seeng Baitullah mein hi rahe yahan tak ke ek martaba Baitullah mein aag lagi us mein woh jal gaye, yeh waqia bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the, isi wajah se unki aulad Quraish tak yeh seeng barabar aur musalsal chale aaye yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne mab'oos farmaya. Wallahu A'lam. "Un aasar ka bayan jin mein Zabihullah ka naam hai" Abu Maisara farmate hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne badshah se farmaya kya tu mere sath khana chahta hai? Main Yusuf bin Yaqub Nabiullah bin Ishaq Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah hoon. (Ubaid bin Umair) Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-Bari mein arz ki ke aye Allah kya wajah hai jo logon ki zabanon par yeh chadha hua hai ke Ibrahim, Ismail aur Yaqub ke Allah ki qasam, toh jawab mila is liye ke Ibrahim ne toh har har cheez par mujhi ko tarjeeh di aur Ishaq (A.S) ne apne tain meri rah mein zibah hone ke liye supurd kar diya phir bhala aur cheezein use pesh kar dena kya mushkil thin aur Yaqub ko main joon joon balaon mein dalta gaya uske husn-e-zanni mere sath badhti hi rahi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke samne ek martaba kisi ne fakhran apne baap dadon ka naam liya toh aap ne farmaya qabil-e-fakhr baap dada toh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke the jo Yaqub bin Ishaq aur Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah the. Ikrama, Ibn-e-Abbas, khud Abbas, Ali, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Ubaid bin Umair, Abu Maisara, Zaid bin Aslam, Abdullah bin Shafiq, Zuhri, Qasim bin Abu Barza, Makhool, Usman bin Abi Aas, Suddi, Hasan, Qatada, Abu Al-Huzail, Ibn-e-Sabit, Ka'ab Ahbar (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een), in sab ka yahi qaul hai aur Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the. Sahih ilm toh Allah ko hi hai magar bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ke in sab buzurgon ke ustad Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar hain. Yeh khilafat-e-Farooqi mein musalman hue the aur kabhi kabhi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko qadeemi kitabon ki baatein sunate the, logon ne ise rukhsat samajh kar phir un se har ek baat bayan karni shuru kar di aur sahih ghalat ki tameez uth gayi, haq toh yeh hai ke is ummat ko agli kitabon ki ek baat ki bhi haajat nahin. Baghawi ne kuch aur naam bhi Sahaba-o-Tabieen ke batlaye hain jinhon ne kaha hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain.

Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai agar woh hadith sahi hoti toh jhagray ka faisla tha magar woh hadith sahi nahin is mein do rawi za'eef hain. Hasan bin Dinar matrook hain aur Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an munkar-ul-hadith hain aur zyada sahi yeh hai ke hai yeh bhi mauqif, chunancha ek sanad se yeh maqoola Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ab un aasar ko suniye jin se maloom hota hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi thay aur yahi theek aur bilkul durust bhi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmatay hain aur farmatay hain ke Yahudi Hazrat Ishaq ka naam jhoot moot letay hain. Ibn-e-Umar, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Hasan Basri, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi, Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ke samnay jab Muhammad bin Qurzi ne yeh farmaya aur saath hi is ki daleel bhi di ke zibh ke zikr ke baad Quran mein Khalilullah ko Hazrat Ishaq ke paida honay ki basharat ka zikr hai aur saath hi bayan hai ke un ke haan bhi larka hoga Yaqub nami jab un ke haan larka honay ki basharat di gayi thi phir bawajood un ke haan larka na honay ke us se pehlay hi un ke zibh karnay ka hukum kaisay diya jata hai? Toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya yeh bohat saaf daleel hai mera zehan yahan nahin pohancha tha go yeh main bhi jaanta tha ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi hain phir Shah-e-Islam ne Shaam ke ek Yahudi aalim se poocha jo Musalman ho gaye thay ke tum is baray mein kya ilm rakhtay ho unhon ne farmaya Ameer-ul-Muslimeen sach toh yahi hai ke jin ke zibh karnay ka hukum diya gaya woh Hazrat Ismail hi thay lekin chunkay Arab un ki aulad mein se hain toh yeh buzurgi un ki taraf laut-ti hai is hasad ke baray mein Yahudiyon ne isay badal diya aur Hazrat Ishaq ka naam le diya. Haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai hamara imaan hai ke Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ishaq dono hi tahir-o-tayyab aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay. Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah ne apnay walid se jab yeh masla poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke zibh honay walay Hazrat Ismail hi thay. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Abu Tufail, Saeed bin Musayyab, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Saleh (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Baghawi ne aur bhi sahaba aur tabieen ke naam ginuwaye hain. Ek ghareeb hadith bhi isi ki ta'eed mein marwi hai is mein hai ke Shaam mein Ameer Muawiyah ke samnay yeh behas churi ke Zabihullah kaun hain? Toh aap ne farmaya khoob hua jo yeh mamla mujh jaisay bakhabar shakhs ke paas aaya suno hum Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas thay jab ek shakhs aap ke paas aaya aur kehnay laga ae Allah ki raah mein do zibh honay walon ki nasl ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe bhi maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch dilwaiye is par aap hans diye. Ek toh Zabihullah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah thay dusray Hazrat Ismail jin ki nasl mein se aap hain.

Abdullah ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia yeh hai ke aap ke dada Abdul Muttalib ne jab Chah-e-Zamzam khoda to nazr mani thi ke agar yeh kaam aasani se pura ho gaya to apne ek ladke ko rah-e-Allah mein zibah karunga. Jab kaam ho gaya aur qura-andazi ki gayi ke kis bete ko Allah ke naam par zibah karein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah ka naam nikla. Un ke nanhiyal walon ne kaha aap un ki taraf se ek sau oont rah-e-Allah zibah kar dein, chunancha woh zibah kar diye gaye aur Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia to mashhoor hi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein yeh riwayat majood hai aur Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein bhi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ki ek daleel to yeh pesh ki hai ke jis 'Ghulamin Aleem' (ilm wale bache) ki basharat ka zikr hai us se murad Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'Wa bashsharu bi ghulamin aleem' aur Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki basharat ka yeh jawab diya hai ke woh aap ke sath chalne phirne ki umar ko pahunch gaye the aur mumkin hai ke Yaqub (A.S) ke sath hi koi aur aulad bhi hui ho. Aur Ka'batullah mein seengon ki maujoodgi ke bare mein farmate hain bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Bilad-e-Kanaan se la kar yahan rakhe gaye hon aur baaz logon se Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke naam ki sarahat bhi aayi hai, lekin yeh sab baatein haqeeqat se bahut door hain. Haan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone par Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka istidlal bahut saaf aur qawi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pehle Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke tawallud hone ki basharat di gayi thi, yahan us ke baad un ke bhai Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ki basharat di ja rahi hai. Surah Hud aur Surah Hijr mein bhi is ka zikr guzar chuka hai. 'Nabiyan' haal-e-muqaddara hai yani woh Nabi-e-Saleh hoga. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Zabihullah Ishaq (A.S) the aur yahan nabuwat Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ko basharat hai. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bare mein farman hai ke hum ne unhein apni rahmat se un ke bhai Haroon (A.S) ko Nabi bana diya. Halankeh Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bade the to yahan bhi un ki nabuwat ki basharat hai. Pas yeh basharat us waqt di gayi jabkeh imtihan-e-zibah mein woh sabir sabit huye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh basharat do martaba di gayi, paidaish se kuch qabl aur nabuwat se kuch qabl. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Un par aur Ishaq (A.S) par hamari barkatein hum ne nazil farmayin, un ki aulad mein har qisam ke log hain nek bhi bad bhi. Jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se farman hua tha ke ae Nuh! Hamari salam aur barkat ke sath utar. Tu bhi aur tere sath wale bhi aur aise bhi log hain jinhein hum faide pahunchayenge phir unhein hamari taraf se dardnak azab pahunchenge.

Zabihullah ki behas aur Yahudi riwayat. Khalilullah jab apni qoum ki hidayat se mayus hogaye. Bari bari qudrati nishaniyan dekh kar bhi jab unhein iman naseeb na hua toh aap ne un se hat jana pasand farmaya aur elan kardiya ke main ab tum mein se hijrat karjaunga mera rehnuma mera Rab hai. Saath hi apne Rab se apne yahan aulad hone ki dua mangi taake wahi tauheed mein aap ka saath de. Isi waqt dua qabool hoti hai aur ek burdbar bache ki basharat di jati hai. Yeh Hazrat Ismail A.S thay yahi aap ke liye sahibzade thay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S se baray thay. Isay toh Ahl-e-Kitab bhi mantay hain balkay un ki kutub mein majood hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki paidaish ke waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki umar chiyasi saal ki thi aur jis waqt Hazrat Ishaq A.S tawalud hotay hain us waqt aap ki umar ninnanway baras ki thi. Balkay un ki apni kitab mein toh yeh bhi hai ke Janab Ibrahim A.S ko apne iklotay farzand ko zibah karne ka hukum hua tha. Lekin sirf is liye ke yeh log khud toh Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Ishaq A.S ki aulad mein se hain aur Nabi-e-Allah wa Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Arab hain. Inhon ne waqia ki asliyat badal di aur is fazeelat ko Hazrat Ismail A.S se hatakar Hazrat Ishaq A.S ko de diya aur beja taweelein karte Allah ke kalam ko badal dala. Aur kaha hamari kitab mein lafz 'Waheedak' hai is se murad iklota nahin balkay jo tere paas is waqt akela hai woh hai. Yeh is liye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S toh apni walida ke saath Makkah mein thay yahan Khalilullah ke saath sirf Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay. Lekin yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Waheed usi ko kaha jata hai jo iklota ho us ka aur koi bhai na ho. Phir yahan ek baat aur bhi hai ke iklotay aur pehlothi ke bache ke saath jo mohabbat hoti aur us ke jo laad pyar hotay hain umooman dusri aulad ke hone par phir woh baqi nahin rehte. Is liye is ke zabiha ka hukum imtehan aur aazmaish ki zabardast kari hai. Hum isay mantay hain ke baaz salaf bhi is ke qail huay hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay yahan tak ke baaz sahaba se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin yeh cheez Kitab-o-Sunnat se sabit nahin hoti. Balkay khayal yeh hai ke Bani Israel ki ek shohrat di hui baat ko in hazrat ne bhi bedaleel apne yahan le liya door kyun jayen Kitab-e-Allah ke alfaaz mein hi ghaur kar lijiye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ka 'Ghulamin Haleem' keh kar zikr hua aur phir Allah ki raah mein zibah ke liye tayar hone ka zikr hua. Is tamam bayan ko khatam karke phir Nabi-e-Saleh Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke tawalud ki basharat ka bayan hua. Aur farishton ne basharat-e-Ishaq ke mauqay par 'Ghulamin Aleem' farmaya tha. Isi tarah Quran mein hai basharat-e-Ishaq ke saath hi hai (وَمِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ اِسْحٰقَ يَعْقُوْبَ) (Surah Hud: 71) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein hi Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke yahan Hazrat Yaqub A.S paida honge yani un ki toh nasl jaari rehne ka pehle hi ilm karaya ja chuka tha ab unhein zibah karne ka hukum kaise diya jata? Isay hum pehle bhi bayan kar chuke.

Albatta Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ka wasf yahan par bardbari ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Jo Zabih ke liye nihayat munasib hai. Ab Hazrat Ismail bade ho gaye, apne walid ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye. Aap us waqt ma'a apni walida mohtarma ke Faran mein thay, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) umooman wahan jate aate rehte thay, yeh mazkoor hai ke Buraq par jate thay aur is jumle ke yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke jawani ke lag bhag ho gaye, ladakpan ka zamana nikal gaya aur baap ki tarah chalne phirne, kaam kaaj karne ke qabil ban gaye. Toh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne khwab dekha ke goya aap apne pyare bache ko zibah kar rahe hain. Anbiya ke khwab wahi hote hain aur is ki daleel yahi aayat hai. Ek marfoo' riwayat mein bhi yeh hai. Pas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apne lakht-e-jigar ki aazmaish ke liye ke achanak woh ghabra na uthein, apna irada un ke samne zahir kiya. Wahan kya tha? Woh bhi usi darakht ke phal thay, Nabi ibn-e-Nabi thay, jawab dete hain ab phir der kyun laga rahe ho? Yeh baatein bhi poochne ki hoti hain? Jo hukm hua hai use foran kar daliye aur agar meri nisbat khatka ho toh zabani itminani kya karoon, chhuri rakhiye khud maloom ho jayega ke main kaisa kuch sabir hoon. Insha'Allah mera sabr aap ka jee khush kar dega. SubhanAllah jo kaha tha wahi kar ke dikhaya aur Sadiq-ul-Wa'ad hone ka certificate Allah ki taraf se hasil kar hi liya. Aakhir baap beta dono hukm-e-Allah ki ita'at ke liye jaan ba-kaf tayyar ho jate hain, baap bache ko zibah karne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai. Aur baap apne noor-e-chashm lakht-e-jigar ko munh ke bal zameen par girate hain taake zibah ke waqt munh dekh kar mohabbat na aa jaye aur hath sust na pad jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apne noor-e-nazar ko zibah karne ke liye ba-hukm-e-Allah le chale toh sa'ee ke waqt Shaitan samne aaya lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) us se aage badh gaye, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath aap Jamra-e-Aqaba par pahunche toh phir Shaitan samne aaya, aap ne use saat kankariyan maarein. Phir Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas aaya phir wahan saat kankariyan maarein. Phir aage badh kar apne pyare bache ko Allah ke naam par zibah karne ke liye neeche pachhada, Zabihullah ke paak jism par us waqt safed chadar thi, kehne lage abba ji ise utaar lijiye taake is mein aap mujhe kafna sakein. Us waqt bete ko nanga karte waqt baap ka ajab haal tha ke aawaz aayi bas Ibrahim (A.S) khwab ko sacha kar chuke. Mud kar dekha toh ek menda safed rang ka bade bade seengon aur saaf aankhon wala nazar pada. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain isi liye hum is qisam ke mende (chhatre) chun chun kar qurbani ke liye lete thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) hi se dusri riwayat mein Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ka naam marwi hai. Toh go dono naam aap se marwi hain lekin awwal hi awla hai aur is ki daleelein aa rahi hain, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ke badle bada zabiha Allah ne ata farmaya, is ki babat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh Jannati chhatra tha jo wahan chalees saal se kha pee raha tha. Ise dekh kar aap apne bache ko chhod kar is ke peeche ho liye.

Jamra-e-Ula par aakar saat kankariyan phenkin, phir woh bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta par aa gaya. Saat kankariyan maarein aur wahan se Malkhar mein lakar zibah kiya, us ke seeng sar samet ibtida-e-Islam ke zamane tak Ka'be ke parnale ke paas latakte rahe thay phir sookh gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) baithe hue baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) toh hadeesein bayan kar rahe thay aur Hazrat Ka'b kitab ke qisse bayan kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke har Nabi ke liye ek dua qabool shuda hai aur main ne apni is maqbool dua ko posheeda karke rakh chora hai apni ummat ki shafa'at ke liye. Aur farmane lage tum par mere maa baap fida hon ya farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere maa baap sadqe jayein. Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanadan ghareeb aur munkar hai aur is ke ek rawi Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam za'eef hain aur mujhe toh yeh bhi dar hai ke yeh alfaaz ke (jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se) aakhir tak rawi apne na hon jinhein unhon ne hadith mein dakhil kardiye hain. Zabihullah toh Hazrat Ismail A.S hain, mahal-e-zibah Mina hai aur woh Makkah mein hai aur Hazrat Ismail yahin thay na ke Hazrat Ishaq woh toh shehar-e-Kanaan mein thay jo Shaam hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S apne pyare bache ko zibah karne ke liye lita dete hain janab-e-Bari se nida aati hai ke bas Ibrahim tum apne khwab ko poora kar chuke. Suddi se riwayat hai ke jab Khalilullah ne Zabihullah ke halq par chhuri pheri toh gardan taanbe ki ho gayi aur na kati aur yeh aawaz aayi. Hum isi tarah nek karon ko badla dete hain. Ya'ni sakhtiyon se bacha lete hain aur chhutkara kar dete hain. Jaise farmaya Allah se darte rehne walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala chhutkare ki soorat nikal hi deta hai aur use aisi tarah rozi pahunchata hai ke us ke gumaan-o-wahm mein bhi na ho. Allah par bharosa karne walon ko Allah hi kaafi hai Allah apne kaamon ko mukammal karke chhodta hai har cheez ka us ne ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Is aayat se is par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke fe'l par qudrat paane se pehle hi hukm mansookh ho sakta hai haan Mu'tazila ise nahin maante. Wajah-e-istidlal bahut zahir hai is liye ke Khalilullah ko apne bete ke zibah karne ka hukm hota hai aur phir zibah se pehle hi fidiye ke sath mansookh kardiya jata hai. Maqsood is se yeh tha ke sabr ka aur baja aawari-e-hukm par musta'idi ka sawab marhamat farma diya jaye. Isi liye irshad hua yeh toh sirf ek aazmaish thi khula imtehan tha ke idhar hukm hua idhar tayyari hui. Isi liye janab-e-Khalilullah A.S ki tareef mein Quran mein hai Ibrahim bada hi wafadar tha. Bade zabih ke sath un ka fidiya hum ne diya. Safed rang badi aankhon aur bade seengon wala umda khorak se pala hua mendha fidiye mein diya gaya jo zair-e-babool ke darakht se bandha hua mila. Jo jannat mein chalees saal charta raha. Mina mein zair ke paas jo chattan hai us par yeh janwar zibah kiya gaya yeh cheekhta hua oopar se utra tha. Yehi woh mendha hai jise Habil ne Allah ki raah mein qurban kiya tha. Is ki oon qadre surkhi mail thi is ka naam Jareer tha. Ba'az kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ise zibah kiya. Koi kehta hai Mina mein nahr par.

Ek shakhs ne apne tain rah-e-Allah mein zibah karne ki mannat mani thi toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne use ek sau oont zibah karne ka fatwa diya tha lekin phir farmate the ke agar main use ek bhed zibah karne ko kehta tab bhi kafi tha kyunke Kitabullah mein hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah ka fidiya usi se diya gaya tha. Aksar logon ka yahi qaul hai, baaz kehte hain yeh pahadi bakra tha, koi kehta hai nar hiran tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne bhed ke seeng Baitullah Sharif mein dakhle ke waqt andar dekhe the aur mujhe yaad na raha ke main tujhe unke dhank dene ka hukum doon, jao use dhak do, Baitullah mein koi aisi cheez na honi chahiye jo namazi ko apni taraf mutawajja kar le. Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain us bhed ke seeng Baitullah mein hi rahe yahan tak ke ek martaba Baitullah mein aag lagi us mein woh jal gaye, yeh waqia bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the, isi wajah se unki aulad Quraish tak yeh seeng barabar aur musalsal chale aaye yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne mab'oos farmaya. Wallahu A'lam. "Un aasar ka bayan jin mein Zabihullah ka naam hai" Abu Maisara farmate hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne badshah se farmaya kya tu mere sath khana chahta hai? Main Yusuf bin Yaqub Nabiullah bin Ishaq Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah hoon. (Ubaid bin Umair) Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-Bari mein arz ki ke aye Allah kya wajah hai jo logon ki zabanon par yeh chadha hua hai ke Ibrahim, Ismail aur Yaqub ke Allah ki qasam, toh jawab mila is liye ke Ibrahim ne toh har har cheez par mujhi ko tarjeeh di aur Ishaq (A.S) ne apne tain meri rah mein zibah hone ke liye supurd kar diya phir bhala aur cheezein use pesh kar dena kya mushkil thin aur Yaqub ko main joon joon balaon mein dalta gaya uske husn-e-zanni mere sath badhti hi rahi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke samne ek martaba kisi ne fakhran apne baap dadon ka naam liya toh aap ne farmaya qabil-e-fakhr baap dada toh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke the jo Yaqub bin Ishaq aur Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah the. Ikrama, Ibn-e-Abbas, khud Abbas, Ali, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Ubaid bin Umair, Abu Maisara, Zaid bin Aslam, Abdullah bin Shafiq, Zuhri, Qasim bin Abu Barza, Makhool, Usman bin Abi Aas, Suddi, Hasan, Qatada, Abu Al-Huzail, Ibn-e-Sabit, Ka'ab Ahbar (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een), in sab ka yahi qaul hai aur Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the. Sahih ilm toh Allah ko hi hai magar bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ke in sab buzurgon ke ustad Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar hain. Yeh khilafat-e-Farooqi mein musalman hue the aur kabhi kabhi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko qadeemi kitabon ki baatein sunate the, logon ne ise rukhsat samajh kar phir un se har ek baat bayan karni shuru kar di aur sahih ghalat ki tameez uth gayi, haq toh yeh hai ke is ummat ko agli kitabon ki ek baat ki bhi haajat nahin. Baghawi ne kuch aur naam bhi Sahaba-o-Tabieen ke batlaye hain jinhon ne kaha hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain.

Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai agar woh hadith sahi hoti toh jhagray ka faisla tha magar woh hadith sahi nahin is mein do rawi za'eef hain. Hasan bin Dinar matrook hain aur Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an munkar-ul-hadith hain aur zyada sahi yeh hai ke hai yeh bhi mauqif, chunancha ek sanad se yeh maqoola Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ab un aasar ko suniye jin se maloom hota hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi thay aur yahi theek aur bilkul durust bhi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmatay hain aur farmatay hain ke Yahudi Hazrat Ishaq ka naam jhoot moot letay hain. Ibn-e-Umar, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Hasan Basri, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi, Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ke samnay jab Muhammad bin Qurzi ne yeh farmaya aur saath hi is ki daleel bhi di ke zibh ke zikr ke baad Quran mein Khalilullah ko Hazrat Ishaq ke paida honay ki basharat ka zikr hai aur saath hi bayan hai ke un ke haan bhi larka hoga Yaqub nami jab un ke haan larka honay ki basharat di gayi thi phir bawajood un ke haan larka na honay ke us se pehlay hi un ke zibh karnay ka hukum kaisay diya jata hai? Toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya yeh bohat saaf daleel hai mera zehan yahan nahin pohancha tha go yeh main bhi jaanta tha ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi hain phir Shah-e-Islam ne Shaam ke ek Yahudi aalim se poocha jo Musalman ho gaye thay ke tum is baray mein kya ilm rakhtay ho unhon ne farmaya Ameer-ul-Muslimeen sach toh yahi hai ke jin ke zibh karnay ka hukum diya gaya woh Hazrat Ismail hi thay lekin chunkay Arab un ki aulad mein se hain toh yeh buzurgi un ki taraf laut-ti hai is hasad ke baray mein Yahudiyon ne isay badal diya aur Hazrat Ishaq ka naam le diya. Haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai hamara imaan hai ke Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ishaq dono hi tahir-o-tayyab aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay. Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah ne apnay walid se jab yeh masla poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke zibh honay walay Hazrat Ismail hi thay. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Abu Tufail, Saeed bin Musayyab, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Saleh (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Baghawi ne aur bhi sahaba aur tabieen ke naam ginuwaye hain. Ek ghareeb hadith bhi isi ki ta'eed mein marwi hai is mein hai ke Shaam mein Ameer Muawiyah ke samnay yeh behas churi ke Zabihullah kaun hain? Toh aap ne farmaya khoob hua jo yeh mamla mujh jaisay bakhabar shakhs ke paas aaya suno hum Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas thay jab ek shakhs aap ke paas aaya aur kehnay laga ae Allah ki raah mein do zibh honay walon ki nasl ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe bhi maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch dilwaiye is par aap hans diye. Ek toh Zabihullah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah thay dusray Hazrat Ismail jin ki nasl mein se aap hain.

Abdullah ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia yeh hai ke aap ke dada Abdul Muttalib ne jab Chah-e-Zamzam khoda to nazr mani thi ke agar yeh kaam aasani se pura ho gaya to apne ek ladke ko rah-e-Allah mein zibah karunga. Jab kaam ho gaya aur qura-andazi ki gayi ke kis bete ko Allah ke naam par zibah karein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah ka naam nikla. Un ke nanhiyal walon ne kaha aap un ki taraf se ek sau oont rah-e-Allah zibah kar dein, chunancha woh zibah kar diye gaye aur Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia to mashhoor hi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein yeh riwayat majood hai aur Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein bhi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ki ek daleel to yeh pesh ki hai ke jis 'Ghulamin Aleem' (ilm wale bache) ki basharat ka zikr hai us se murad Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'Wa bashsharu bi ghulamin aleem' aur Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki basharat ka yeh jawab diya hai ke woh aap ke sath chalne phirne ki umar ko pahunch gaye the aur mumkin hai ke Yaqub (A.S) ke sath hi koi aur aulad bhi hui ho. Aur Ka'batullah mein seengon ki maujoodgi ke bare mein farmate hain bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Bilad-e-Kanaan se la kar yahan rakhe gaye hon aur baaz logon se Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke naam ki sarahat bhi aayi hai, lekin yeh sab baatein haqeeqat se bahut door hain. Haan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone par Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka istidlal bahut saaf aur qawi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pehle Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke tawallud hone ki basharat di gayi thi, yahan us ke baad un ke bhai Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ki basharat di ja rahi hai. Surah Hud aur Surah Hijr mein bhi is ka zikr guzar chuka hai. 'Nabiyan' haal-e-muqaddara hai yani woh Nabi-e-Saleh hoga. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Zabihullah Ishaq (A.S) the aur yahan nabuwat Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ko basharat hai. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bare mein farman hai ke hum ne unhein apni rahmat se un ke bhai Haroon (A.S) ko Nabi bana diya. Halankeh Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bade the to yahan bhi un ki nabuwat ki basharat hai. Pas yeh basharat us waqt di gayi jabkeh imtihan-e-zibah mein woh sabir sabit huye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh basharat do martaba di gayi, paidaish se kuch qabl aur nabuwat se kuch qabl. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Un par aur Ishaq (A.S) par hamari barkatein hum ne nazil farmayin, un ki aulad mein har qisam ke log hain nek bhi bad bhi. Jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se farman hua tha ke ae Nuh! Hamari salam aur barkat ke sath utar. Tu bhi aur tere sath wale bhi aur aise bhi log hain jinhein hum faide pahunchayenge phir unhein hamari taraf se dardnak azab pahunchenge.

Zabihullah ki behas aur Yahudi riwayat. Khalilullah jab apni qoum ki hidayat se mayus hogaye. Bari bari qudrati nishaniyan dekh kar bhi jab unhein iman naseeb na hua toh aap ne un se hat jana pasand farmaya aur elan kardiya ke main ab tum mein se hijrat karjaunga mera rehnuma mera Rab hai. Saath hi apne Rab se apne yahan aulad hone ki dua mangi taake wahi tauheed mein aap ka saath de. Isi waqt dua qabool hoti hai aur ek burdbar bache ki basharat di jati hai. Yeh Hazrat Ismail A.S thay yahi aap ke liye sahibzade thay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S se baray thay. Isay toh Ahl-e-Kitab bhi mantay hain balkay un ki kutub mein majood hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki paidaish ke waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki umar chiyasi saal ki thi aur jis waqt Hazrat Ishaq A.S tawalud hotay hain us waqt aap ki umar ninnanway baras ki thi. Balkay un ki apni kitab mein toh yeh bhi hai ke Janab Ibrahim A.S ko apne iklotay farzand ko zibah karne ka hukum hua tha. Lekin sirf is liye ke yeh log khud toh Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Ishaq A.S ki aulad mein se hain aur Nabi-e-Allah wa Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Arab hain. Inhon ne waqia ki asliyat badal di aur is fazeelat ko Hazrat Ismail A.S se hatakar Hazrat Ishaq A.S ko de diya aur beja taweelein karte Allah ke kalam ko badal dala. Aur kaha hamari kitab mein lafz 'Waheedak' hai is se murad iklota nahin balkay jo tere paas is waqt akela hai woh hai. Yeh is liye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S toh apni walida ke saath Makkah mein thay yahan Khalilullah ke saath sirf Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay. Lekin yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Waheed usi ko kaha jata hai jo iklota ho us ka aur koi bhai na ho. Phir yahan ek baat aur bhi hai ke iklotay aur pehlothi ke bache ke saath jo mohabbat hoti aur us ke jo laad pyar hotay hain umooman dusri aulad ke hone par phir woh baqi nahin rehte. Is liye is ke zabiha ka hukum imtehan aur aazmaish ki zabardast kari hai. Hum isay mantay hain ke baaz salaf bhi is ke qail huay hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay yahan tak ke baaz sahaba se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin yeh cheez Kitab-o-Sunnat se sabit nahin hoti. Balkay khayal yeh hai ke Bani Israel ki ek shohrat di hui baat ko in hazrat ne bhi bedaleel apne yahan le liya door kyun jayen Kitab-e-Allah ke alfaaz mein hi ghaur kar lijiye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ka 'Ghulamin Haleem' keh kar zikr hua aur phir Allah ki raah mein zibah ke liye tayar hone ka zikr hua. Is tamam bayan ko khatam karke phir Nabi-e-Saleh Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke tawalud ki basharat ka bayan hua. Aur farishton ne basharat-e-Ishaq ke mauqay par 'Ghulamin Aleem' farmaya tha. Isi tarah Quran mein hai basharat-e-Ishaq ke saath hi hai (وَمِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ اِسْحٰقَ يَعْقُوْبَ) (Surah Hud: 71) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein hi Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke yahan Hazrat Yaqub A.S paida honge yani un ki toh nasl jaari rehne ka pehle hi ilm karaya ja chuka tha ab unhein zibah karne ka hukum kaise diya jata? Isay hum pehle bhi bayan kar chuke.

Albatta Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ka wasf yahan par bardbari ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Jo Zabih ke liye nihayat munasib hai. Ab Hazrat Ismail bade ho gaye, apne walid ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye. Aap us waqt ma'a apni walida mohtarma ke Faran mein thay, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) umooman wahan jate aate rehte thay, yeh mazkoor hai ke Buraq par jate thay aur is jumle ke yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke jawani ke lag bhag ho gaye, ladakpan ka zamana nikal gaya aur baap ki tarah chalne phirne, kaam kaaj karne ke qabil ban gaye. Toh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne khwab dekha ke goya aap apne pyare bache ko zibah kar rahe hain. Anbiya ke khwab wahi hote hain aur is ki daleel yahi aayat hai. Ek marfoo' riwayat mein bhi yeh hai. Pas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apne lakht-e-jigar ki aazmaish ke liye ke achanak woh ghabra na uthein, apna irada un ke samne zahir kiya. Wahan kya tha? Woh bhi usi darakht ke phal thay, Nabi ibn-e-Nabi thay, jawab dete hain ab phir der kyun laga rahe ho? Yeh baatein bhi poochne ki hoti hain? Jo hukm hua hai use foran kar daliye aur agar meri nisbat khatka ho toh zabani itminani kya karoon, chhuri rakhiye khud maloom ho jayega ke main kaisa kuch sabir hoon. Insha'Allah mera sabr aap ka jee khush kar dega. SubhanAllah jo kaha tha wahi kar ke dikhaya aur Sadiq-ul-Wa'ad hone ka certificate Allah ki taraf se hasil kar hi liya. Aakhir baap beta dono hukm-e-Allah ki ita'at ke liye jaan ba-kaf tayyar ho jate hain, baap bache ko zibah karne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai. Aur baap apne noor-e-chashm lakht-e-jigar ko munh ke bal zameen par girate hain taake zibah ke waqt munh dekh kar mohabbat na aa jaye aur hath sust na pad jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apne noor-e-nazar ko zibah karne ke liye ba-hukm-e-Allah le chale toh sa'ee ke waqt Shaitan samne aaya lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) us se aage badh gaye, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath aap Jamra-e-Aqaba par pahunche toh phir Shaitan samne aaya, aap ne use saat kankariyan maarein. Phir Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas aaya phir wahan saat kankariyan maarein. Phir aage badh kar apne pyare bache ko Allah ke naam par zibah karne ke liye neeche pachhada, Zabihullah ke paak jism par us waqt safed chadar thi, kehne lage abba ji ise utaar lijiye taake is mein aap mujhe kafna sakein. Us waqt bete ko nanga karte waqt baap ka ajab haal tha ke aawaz aayi bas Ibrahim (A.S) khwab ko sacha kar chuke. Mud kar dekha toh ek menda safed rang ka bade bade seengon aur saaf aankhon wala nazar pada. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain isi liye hum is qisam ke mende (chhatre) chun chun kar qurbani ke liye lete thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) hi se dusri riwayat mein Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ka naam marwi hai. Toh go dono naam aap se marwi hain lekin awwal hi awla hai aur is ki daleelein aa rahi hain, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ke badle bada zabiha Allah ne ata farmaya, is ki babat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh Jannati chhatra tha jo wahan chalees saal se kha pee raha tha. Ise dekh kar aap apne bache ko chhod kar is ke peeche ho liye.

Jamra-e-Ula par aakar saat kankariyan phenkin, phir woh bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta par aa gaya. Saat kankariyan maarein aur wahan se Malkhar mein lakar zibah kiya, us ke seeng sar samet ibtida-e-Islam ke zamane tak Ka'be ke parnale ke paas latakte rahe thay phir sookh gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) baithe hue baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) toh hadeesein bayan kar rahe thay aur Hazrat Ka'b kitab ke qisse bayan kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke har Nabi ke liye ek dua qabool shuda hai aur main ne apni is maqbool dua ko posheeda karke rakh chora hai apni ummat ki shafa'at ke liye. Aur farmane lage tum par mere maa baap fida hon ya farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere maa baap sadqe jayein. Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanadan ghareeb aur munkar hai aur is ke ek rawi Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam za'eef hain aur mujhe toh yeh bhi dar hai ke yeh alfaaz ke (jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se) aakhir tak rawi apne na hon jinhein unhon ne hadith mein dakhil kardiye hain. Zabihullah toh Hazrat Ismail A.S hain, mahal-e-zibah Mina hai aur woh Makkah mein hai aur Hazrat Ismail yahin thay na ke Hazrat Ishaq woh toh shehar-e-Kanaan mein thay jo Shaam hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S apne pyare bache ko zibah karne ke liye lita dete hain janab-e-Bari se nida aati hai ke bas Ibrahim tum apne khwab ko poora kar chuke. Suddi se riwayat hai ke jab Khalilullah ne Zabihullah ke halq par chhuri pheri toh gardan taanbe ki ho gayi aur na kati aur yeh aawaz aayi. Hum isi tarah nek karon ko badla dete hain. Ya'ni sakhtiyon se bacha lete hain aur chhutkara kar dete hain. Jaise farmaya Allah se darte rehne walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala chhutkare ki soorat nikal hi deta hai aur use aisi tarah rozi pahunchata hai ke us ke gumaan-o-wahm mein bhi na ho. Allah par bharosa karne walon ko Allah hi kaafi hai Allah apne kaamon ko mukammal karke chhodta hai har cheez ka us ne ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Is aayat se is par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke fe'l par qudrat paane se pehle hi hukm mansookh ho sakta hai haan Mu'tazila ise nahin maante. Wajah-e-istidlal bahut zahir hai is liye ke Khalilullah ko apne bete ke zibah karne ka hukm hota hai aur phir zibah se pehle hi fidiye ke sath mansookh kardiya jata hai. Maqsood is se yeh tha ke sabr ka aur baja aawari-e-hukm par musta'idi ka sawab marhamat farma diya jaye. Isi liye irshad hua yeh toh sirf ek aazmaish thi khula imtehan tha ke idhar hukm hua idhar tayyari hui. Isi liye janab-e-Khalilullah A.S ki tareef mein Quran mein hai Ibrahim bada hi wafadar tha. Bade zabih ke sath un ka fidiya hum ne diya. Safed rang badi aankhon aur bade seengon wala umda khorak se pala hua mendha fidiye mein diya gaya jo zair-e-babool ke darakht se bandha hua mila. Jo jannat mein chalees saal charta raha. Mina mein zair ke paas jo chattan hai us par yeh janwar zibah kiya gaya yeh cheekhta hua oopar se utra tha. Yehi woh mendha hai jise Habil ne Allah ki raah mein qurban kiya tha. Is ki oon qadre surkhi mail thi is ka naam Jareer tha. Ba'az kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ise zibah kiya. Koi kehta hai Mina mein nahr par.

Ek shakhs ne apne tain rah-e-Allah mein zibah karne ki mannat mani thi toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne use ek sau oont zibah karne ka fatwa diya tha lekin phir farmate the ke agar main use ek bhed zibah karne ko kehta tab bhi kafi tha kyunke Kitabullah mein hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah ka fidiya usi se diya gaya tha. Aksar logon ka yahi qaul hai, baaz kehte hain yeh pahadi bakra tha, koi kehta hai nar hiran tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne bhed ke seeng Baitullah Sharif mein dakhle ke waqt andar dekhe the aur mujhe yaad na raha ke main tujhe unke dhank dene ka hukum doon, jao use dhak do, Baitullah mein koi aisi cheez na honi chahiye jo namazi ko apni taraf mutawajja kar le. Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain us bhed ke seeng Baitullah mein hi rahe yahan tak ke ek martaba Baitullah mein aag lagi us mein woh jal gaye, yeh waqia bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the, isi wajah se unki aulad Quraish tak yeh seeng barabar aur musalsal chale aaye yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne mab'oos farmaya. Wallahu A'lam. "Un aasar ka bayan jin mein Zabihullah ka naam hai" Abu Maisara farmate hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne badshah se farmaya kya tu mere sath khana chahta hai? Main Yusuf bin Yaqub Nabiullah bin Ishaq Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah hoon. (Ubaid bin Umair) Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-Bari mein arz ki ke aye Allah kya wajah hai jo logon ki zabanon par yeh chadha hua hai ke Ibrahim, Ismail aur Yaqub ke Allah ki qasam, toh jawab mila is liye ke Ibrahim ne toh har har cheez par mujhi ko tarjeeh di aur Ishaq (A.S) ne apne tain meri rah mein zibah hone ke liye supurd kar diya phir bhala aur cheezein use pesh kar dena kya mushkil thin aur Yaqub ko main joon joon balaon mein dalta gaya uske husn-e-zanni mere sath badhti hi rahi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke samne ek martaba kisi ne fakhran apne baap dadon ka naam liya toh aap ne farmaya qabil-e-fakhr baap dada toh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke the jo Yaqub bin Ishaq aur Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah the. Ikrama, Ibn-e-Abbas, khud Abbas, Ali, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Ubaid bin Umair, Abu Maisara, Zaid bin Aslam, Abdullah bin Shafiq, Zuhri, Qasim bin Abu Barza, Makhool, Usman bin Abi Aas, Suddi, Hasan, Qatada, Abu Al-Huzail, Ibn-e-Sabit, Ka'ab Ahbar (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een), in sab ka yahi qaul hai aur Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the. Sahih ilm toh Allah ko hi hai magar bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ke in sab buzurgon ke ustad Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar hain. Yeh khilafat-e-Farooqi mein musalman hue the aur kabhi kabhi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko qadeemi kitabon ki baatein sunate the, logon ne ise rukhsat samajh kar phir un se har ek baat bayan karni shuru kar di aur sahih ghalat ki tameez uth gayi, haq toh yeh hai ke is ummat ko agli kitabon ki ek baat ki bhi haajat nahin. Baghawi ne kuch aur naam bhi Sahaba-o-Tabieen ke batlaye hain jinhon ne kaha hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain.

Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai agar woh hadith sahi hoti toh jhagray ka faisla tha magar woh hadith sahi nahin is mein do rawi za'eef hain. Hasan bin Dinar matrook hain aur Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an munkar-ul-hadith hain aur zyada sahi yeh hai ke hai yeh bhi mauqif, chunancha ek sanad se yeh maqoola Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ab un aasar ko suniye jin se maloom hota hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi thay aur yahi theek aur bilkul durust bhi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmatay hain aur farmatay hain ke Yahudi Hazrat Ishaq ka naam jhoot moot letay hain. Ibn-e-Umar, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Hasan Basri, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi, Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ke samnay jab Muhammad bin Qurzi ne yeh farmaya aur saath hi is ki daleel bhi di ke zibh ke zikr ke baad Quran mein Khalilullah ko Hazrat Ishaq ke paida honay ki basharat ka zikr hai aur saath hi bayan hai ke un ke haan bhi larka hoga Yaqub nami jab un ke haan larka honay ki basharat di gayi thi phir bawajood un ke haan larka na honay ke us se pehlay hi un ke zibh karnay ka hukum kaisay diya jata hai? Toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya yeh bohat saaf daleel hai mera zehan yahan nahin pohancha tha go yeh main bhi jaanta tha ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi hain phir Shah-e-Islam ne Shaam ke ek Yahudi aalim se poocha jo Musalman ho gaye thay ke tum is baray mein kya ilm rakhtay ho unhon ne farmaya Ameer-ul-Muslimeen sach toh yahi hai ke jin ke zibh karnay ka hukum diya gaya woh Hazrat Ismail hi thay lekin chunkay Arab un ki aulad mein se hain toh yeh buzurgi un ki taraf laut-ti hai is hasad ke baray mein Yahudiyon ne isay badal diya aur Hazrat Ishaq ka naam le diya. Haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai hamara imaan hai ke Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ishaq dono hi tahir-o-tayyab aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay. Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah ne apnay walid se jab yeh masla poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke zibh honay walay Hazrat Ismail hi thay. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Abu Tufail, Saeed bin Musayyab, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Saleh (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Baghawi ne aur bhi sahaba aur tabieen ke naam ginuwaye hain. Ek ghareeb hadith bhi isi ki ta'eed mein marwi hai is mein hai ke Shaam mein Ameer Muawiyah ke samnay yeh behas churi ke Zabihullah kaun hain? Toh aap ne farmaya khoob hua jo yeh mamla mujh jaisay bakhabar shakhs ke paas aaya suno hum Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas thay jab ek shakhs aap ke paas aaya aur kehnay laga ae Allah ki raah mein do zibh honay walon ki nasl ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe bhi maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch dilwaiye is par aap hans diye. Ek toh Zabihullah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah thay dusray Hazrat Ismail jin ki nasl mein se aap hain.

Abdullah ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia yeh hai ke aap ke dada Abdul Muttalib ne jab Chah-e-Zamzam khoda to nazr mani thi ke agar yeh kaam aasani se pura ho gaya to apne ek ladke ko rah-e-Allah mein zibah karunga. Jab kaam ho gaya aur qura-andazi ki gayi ke kis bete ko Allah ke naam par zibah karein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah ka naam nikla. Un ke nanhiyal walon ne kaha aap un ki taraf se ek sau oont rah-e-Allah zibah kar dein, chunancha woh zibah kar diye gaye aur Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia to mashhoor hi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein yeh riwayat majood hai aur Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein bhi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ki ek daleel to yeh pesh ki hai ke jis 'Ghulamin Aleem' (ilm wale bache) ki basharat ka zikr hai us se murad Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'Wa bashsharu bi ghulamin aleem' aur Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki basharat ka yeh jawab diya hai ke woh aap ke sath chalne phirne ki umar ko pahunch gaye the aur mumkin hai ke Yaqub (A.S) ke sath hi koi aur aulad bhi hui ho. Aur Ka'batullah mein seengon ki maujoodgi ke bare mein farmate hain bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Bilad-e-Kanaan se la kar yahan rakhe gaye hon aur baaz logon se Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke naam ki sarahat bhi aayi hai, lekin yeh sab baatein haqeeqat se bahut door hain. Haan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone par Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka istidlal bahut saaf aur qawi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pehle Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke tawallud hone ki basharat di gayi thi, yahan us ke baad un ke bhai Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ki basharat di ja rahi hai. Surah Hud aur Surah Hijr mein bhi is ka zikr guzar chuka hai. 'Nabiyan' haal-e-muqaddara hai yani woh Nabi-e-Saleh hoga. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Zabihullah Ishaq (A.S) the aur yahan nabuwat Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ko basharat hai. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bare mein farman hai ke hum ne unhein apni rahmat se un ke bhai Haroon (A.S) ko Nabi bana diya. Halankeh Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bade the to yahan bhi un ki nabuwat ki basharat hai. Pas yeh basharat us waqt di gayi jabkeh imtihan-e-zibah mein woh sabir sabit huye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh basharat do martaba di gayi, paidaish se kuch qabl aur nabuwat se kuch qabl. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Un par aur Ishaq (A.S) par hamari barkatein hum ne nazil farmayin, un ki aulad mein har qisam ke log hain nek bhi bad bhi. Jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se farman hua tha ke ae Nuh! Hamari salam aur barkat ke sath utar. Tu bhi aur tere sath wale bhi aur aise bhi log hain jinhein hum faide pahunchayenge phir unhein hamari taraf se dardnak azab pahunchenge.

Zabihullah ki behas aur Yahudi riwayat. Khalilullah jab apni qoum ki hidayat se mayus hogaye. Bari bari qudrati nishaniyan dekh kar bhi jab unhein iman naseeb na hua toh aap ne un se hat jana pasand farmaya aur elan kardiya ke main ab tum mein se hijrat karjaunga mera rehnuma mera Rab hai. Saath hi apne Rab se apne yahan aulad hone ki dua mangi taake wahi tauheed mein aap ka saath de. Isi waqt dua qabool hoti hai aur ek burdbar bache ki basharat di jati hai. Yeh Hazrat Ismail A.S thay yahi aap ke liye sahibzade thay aur Hazrat Ishaq A.S se baray thay. Isay toh Ahl-e-Kitab bhi mantay hain balkay un ki kutub mein majood hai ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki paidaish ke waqt Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki umar chiyasi saal ki thi aur jis waqt Hazrat Ishaq A.S tawalud hotay hain us waqt aap ki umar ninnanway baras ki thi. Balkay un ki apni kitab mein toh yeh bhi hai ke Janab Ibrahim A.S ko apne iklotay farzand ko zibah karne ka hukum hua tha. Lekin sirf is liye ke yeh log khud toh Nabi-e-Allah Hazrat Ishaq A.S ki aulad mein se hain aur Nabi-e-Allah wa Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail A.S ki aulad mein se Arab hain. Inhon ne waqia ki asliyat badal di aur is fazeelat ko Hazrat Ismail A.S se hatakar Hazrat Ishaq A.S ko de diya aur beja taweelein karte Allah ke kalam ko badal dala. Aur kaha hamari kitab mein lafz 'Waheedak' hai is se murad iklota nahin balkay jo tere paas is waqt akela hai woh hai. Yeh is liye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S toh apni walida ke saath Makkah mein thay yahan Khalilullah ke saath sirf Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay. Lekin yeh bilkul ghalat hai. Waheed usi ko kaha jata hai jo iklota ho us ka aur koi bhai na ho. Phir yahan ek baat aur bhi hai ke iklotay aur pehlothi ke bache ke saath jo mohabbat hoti aur us ke jo laad pyar hotay hain umooman dusri aulad ke hone par phir woh baqi nahin rehte. Is liye is ke zabiha ka hukum imtehan aur aazmaish ki zabardast kari hai. Hum isay mantay hain ke baaz salaf bhi is ke qail huay hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq A.S thay yahan tak ke baaz sahaba se bhi yeh marwi hai lekin yeh cheez Kitab-o-Sunnat se sabit nahin hoti. Balkay khayal yeh hai ke Bani Israel ki ek shohrat di hui baat ko in hazrat ne bhi bedaleel apne yahan le liya door kyun jayen Kitab-e-Allah ke alfaaz mein hi ghaur kar lijiye ke Hazrat Ismail A.S ki basharat ka 'Ghulamin Haleem' keh kar zikr hua aur phir Allah ki raah mein zibah ke liye tayar hone ka zikr hua. Is tamam bayan ko khatam karke phir Nabi-e-Saleh Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke tawalud ki basharat ka bayan hua. Aur farishton ne basharat-e-Ishaq ke mauqay par 'Ghulamin Aleem' farmaya tha. Isi tarah Quran mein hai basharat-e-Ishaq ke saath hi hai (وَمِنْ وَّرَاۗءِ اِسْحٰقَ يَعْقُوْبَ) (Surah Hud: 71) yani Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki hayat mein hi Hazrat Ishaq A.S ke yahan Hazrat Yaqub A.S paida honge yani un ki toh nasl jaari rehne ka pehle hi ilm karaya ja chuka tha ab unhein zibah karne ka hukum kaise diya jata? Isay hum pehle bhi bayan kar chuke.

Albatta Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ka wasf yahan par bardbari ka bayan kiya gaya hai. Jo Zabih ke liye nihayat munasib hai. Ab Hazrat Ismail bade ho gaye, apne walid ke sath chalne phirne ke qabil ho gaye. Aap us waqt ma'a apni walida mohtarma ke Faran mein thay, Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) umooman wahan jate aate rehte thay, yeh mazkoor hai ke Buraq par jate thay aur is jumle ke yeh ma'ani bhi hain ke jawani ke lag bhag ho gaye, ladakpan ka zamana nikal gaya aur baap ki tarah chalne phirne, kaam kaaj karne ke qabil ban gaye. Toh Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ne khwab dekha ke goya aap apne pyare bache ko zibah kar rahe hain. Anbiya ke khwab wahi hote hain aur is ki daleel yahi aayat hai. Ek marfoo' riwayat mein bhi yeh hai. Pas Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apne lakht-e-jigar ki aazmaish ke liye ke achanak woh ghabra na uthein, apna irada un ke samne zahir kiya. Wahan kya tha? Woh bhi usi darakht ke phal thay, Nabi ibn-e-Nabi thay, jawab dete hain ab phir der kyun laga rahe ho? Yeh baatein bhi poochne ki hoti hain? Jo hukm hua hai use foran kar daliye aur agar meri nisbat khatka ho toh zabani itminani kya karoon, chhuri rakhiye khud maloom ho jayega ke main kaisa kuch sabir hoon. Insha'Allah mera sabr aap ka jee khush kar dega. SubhanAllah jo kaha tha wahi kar ke dikhaya aur Sadiq-ul-Wa'ad hone ka certificate Allah ki taraf se hasil kar hi liya. Aakhir baap beta dono hukm-e-Allah ki ita'at ke liye jaan ba-kaf tayyar ho jate hain, baap bache ko zibah karne ke liye tayyar ho jata hai. Aur baap apne noor-e-chashm lakht-e-jigar ko munh ke bal zameen par girate hain taake zibah ke waqt munh dekh kar mohabbat na aa jaye aur hath sust na pad jaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se riwayat hai ke jab Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) apne noor-e-nazar ko zibah karne ke liye ba-hukm-e-Allah le chale toh sa'ee ke waqt Shaitan samne aaya lekin Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) us se aage badh gaye, phir Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ke sath aap Jamra-e-Aqaba par pahunche toh phir Shaitan samne aaya, aap ne use saat kankariyan maarein. Phir Jamra-e-Wusta ke paas aaya phir wahan saat kankariyan maarein. Phir aage badh kar apne pyare bache ko Allah ke naam par zibah karne ke liye neeche pachhada, Zabihullah ke paak jism par us waqt safed chadar thi, kehne lage abba ji ise utaar lijiye taake is mein aap mujhe kafna sakein. Us waqt bete ko nanga karte waqt baap ka ajab haal tha ke aawaz aayi bas Ibrahim (A.S) khwab ko sacha kar chuke. Mud kar dekha toh ek menda safed rang ka bade bade seengon aur saaf aankhon wala nazar pada. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain isi liye hum is qisam ke mende (chhatre) chun chun kar qurbani ke liye lete thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) hi se dusri riwayat mein Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ka naam marwi hai. Toh go dono naam aap se marwi hain lekin awwal hi awla hai aur is ki daleelein aa rahi hain, Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Is ke badle bada zabiha Allah ne ata farmaya, is ki babat Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh Jannati chhatra tha jo wahan chalees saal se kha pee raha tha. Ise dekh kar aap apne bache ko chhod kar is ke peeche ho liye.

Jamra-e-Ula par aakar saat kankariyan phenkin, phir woh bhaag kar Jamra-e-Wusta par aa gaya. Saat kankariyan maarein aur wahan se Malkhar mein lakar zibah kiya, us ke seeng sar samet ibtida-e-Islam ke zamane tak Ka'be ke parnale ke paas latakte rahe thay phir sookh gaye. Ek martaba Hazrat Ka'b (R.A) baithe hue baatein kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) toh hadeesein bayan kar rahe thay aur Hazrat Ka'b kitab ke qisse bayan kar rahe thay. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke har Nabi ke liye ek dua qabool shuda hai aur main ne apni is maqbool dua ko posheeda karke rakh chora hai apni ummat ki shafa'at ke liye. Aur farmane lage tum par mere maa baap fida hon ya farmaya Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par mere maa baap sadqe jayein. Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de.
