Phir Hazrat Ka'b ne Hazrat Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ka qissa sunaya ke jab aap apne larke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ko zibah karne ke liye musta'id ho gaye toh Shaitan ne kaha agar main is waqt inhe na behka saka toh mujhe in se umr bhar ke liye mayoos ho jana chahiye. Pehle toh yeh Hazrat Sarah ke paas aaya aur poocha ke Ibrahim tumhare larke ko kahan le gaye hain? Mai Sahiba ne jawab diya apne kisi kaam par le gaye hain, us ne kaha nahin balkeh woh zibah karne ke liye le gaye hain, Mai Sahiba ne farmaya woh use kyun zibah karne lage? La'een ne kaha woh kehte hain Allah ki taraf se yahi hukum hai, jawab mila phir toh yahi behtar hai ke woh jaldi se Allah ke hukum ki baja-awari se farigh ho lein. Yahan se namurad ho kar bache ke paas aaya aur kaha tumhare abba tumhe kahan le jaate hain? Farmaya apne kaam ke liye, kaha nahin balkeh woh tujhe zibah karne ke liye le ja rahe hain, farmaya yeh kyun? Kaha is liye ke woh samajhte hain Allah ka unhein hukum hai. Kaha phir toh wallah unhein is kaam mein bahut jaldi karni chahiye. In se bhi mayoos ho kar yeh mal'oon Khalilullah ke paas pahuncha. In se kaha bache ko kahan le ja rahe ho? Jawab diya apne kaam ke liye, mal'oon ne kaha nahin balkeh tum toh use zibah karne ke liye ja rahe ho? Aap ne farmaya yeh kyun? Bola is liye ke tumhara khayal hai ke Allah ka hukum tumhe yunhi hai, aap ne farmaya Allah ki qasam phir toh main zaroor hi use zibah kar dalunga. Ab Iblees mayoos ho gaya. Doosri riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke is tamam waqiye ke baad Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) se farmaya ke ek dua tum mujh se mango jo mango ge milega, Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ne kaha phir meri dua yeh hai ke jis ne tere saath shareek na kiya ho use toh zaroor Jannat mein le jana. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe ikhtiyar diya ke main do baaton mein se ek ko ikhtiyar kar loon ya toh yeh ke meri aadhon aadh ummat bakhshi jaye ya yeh ke main shafa'at karoon aur use Allah Ta'ala qabool farma le toh main ne shafa'at karne ko tarjeeh di is par ke woh aam hogi, haan ek dua thi ke main wahi karta lekin Allah ka ek nek banda mujh se pehle is dua ko maang chuka tha.

Waqia yeh hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se zibah hone ki takleef door kardi toh un se farmaya gaya ke tu maang jo maange ga diya jaye ga. Toh Hazrat Ishaq ne farmaya Wallah shaitan ke behkane se pehle hi main ise maang loon ga, Allah jo shakhs is halat mein mara ho ke us ne tere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho toh use bakhsh de aur jannat mein pahuncha de. Yeh hadith Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai lekin sanadan ghareeb aur munkar hai aur is ke ek rawi Abdur Rahman bin Zaid bin Aslam za'eef hain aur mujhe toh yeh bhi dar hai ke yeh alfaaz ke (jab Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Ishaq se) aakhir tak rawi apne na hon jinhein unhon ne hadith mein dakhil kardiye hain. Zabihullah toh Hazrat Ismail A.S hain, mahal-e-zibah Mina hai aur woh Makkah mein hai aur Hazrat Ismail yahin thay na ke Hazrat Ishaq woh toh shehar-e-Kanaan mein thay jo Shaam hai. Jab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S apne pyare bache ko zibah karne ke liye lita dete hain janab-e-Bari se nida aati hai ke bas Ibrahim tum apne khwab ko poora kar chuke. Suddi se riwayat hai ke jab Khalilullah ne Zabihullah ke halq par chhuri pheri toh gardan taanbe ki ho gayi aur na kati aur yeh aawaz aayi. Hum isi tarah nek karon ko badla dete hain. Ya'ni sakhtiyon se bacha lete hain aur chhutkara kar dete hain. Jaise farmaya Allah se darte rehne walon ke liye Allah Ta'ala chhutkare ki soorat nikal hi deta hai aur use aisi tarah rozi pahunchata hai ke us ke gumaan-o-wahm mein bhi na ho. Allah par bharosa karne walon ko Allah hi kaafi hai Allah apne kaamon ko mukammal karke chhodta hai har cheez ka us ne ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai. Is aayat se is par istidlal kiya gaya hai ke fe'l par qudrat paane se pehle hi hukm mansookh ho sakta hai haan Mu'tazila ise nahin maante. Wajah-e-istidlal bahut zahir hai is liye ke Khalilullah ko apne bete ke zibah karne ka hukm hota hai aur phir zibah se pehle hi fidiye ke sath mansookh kardiya jata hai. Maqsood is se yeh tha ke sabr ka aur baja aawari-e-hukm par musta'idi ka sawab marhamat farma diya jaye. Isi liye irshad hua yeh toh sirf ek aazmaish thi khula imtehan tha ke idhar hukm hua idhar tayyari hui. Isi liye janab-e-Khalilullah A.S ki tareef mein Quran mein hai Ibrahim bada hi wafadar tha. Bade zabih ke sath un ka fidiya hum ne diya. Safed rang badi aankhon aur bade seengon wala umda khorak se pala hua mendha fidiye mein diya gaya jo zair-e-babool ke darakht se bandha hua mila. Jo jannat mein chalees saal charta raha. Mina mein zair ke paas jo chattan hai us par yeh janwar zibah kiya gaya yeh cheekhta hua oopar se utra tha. Yehi woh mendha hai jise Habil ne Allah ki raah mein qurban kiya tha. Is ki oon qadre surkhi mail thi is ka naam Jareer tha. Ba'az kehte hain Maqam-e-Ibrahim par ise zibah kiya. Koi kehta hai Mina mein nahr par.

Ek shakhs ne apne tain rah-e-Allah mein zibah karne ki mannat mani thi toh Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ne use ek sau oont zibah karne ka fatwa diya tha lekin phir farmate the ke agar main use ek bhed zibah karne ko kehta tab bhi kafi tha kyunke Kitabullah mein hai ke Hazrat Zabihullah ka fidiya usi se diya gaya tha. Aksar logon ka yahi qaul hai, baaz kehte hain yeh pahadi bakra tha, koi kehta hai nar hiran tha. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Usman (R.A) ko bula kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya main ne bhed ke seeng Baitullah Sharif mein dakhle ke waqt andar dekhe the aur mujhe yaad na raha ke main tujhe unke dhank dene ka hukum doon, jao use dhak do, Baitullah mein koi aisi cheez na honi chahiye jo namazi ko apni taraf mutawajja kar le. Hazrat Sufiyan farmate hain us bhed ke seeng Baitullah mein hi rahe yahan tak ke ek martaba Baitullah mein aag lagi us mein woh jal gaye, yeh waqia bhi is amr ki daleel hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the, isi wajah se unki aulad Quraish tak yeh seeng barabar aur musalsal chale aaye yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Allah ne mab'oos farmaya. Wallahu A'lam. "Un aasar ka bayan jin mein Zabihullah ka naam hai" Abu Maisara farmate hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne badshah se farmaya kya tu mere sath khana chahta hai? Main Yusuf bin Yaqub Nabiullah bin Ishaq Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah hoon. (Ubaid bin Umair) Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne janab-e-Bari mein arz ki ke aye Allah kya wajah hai jo logon ki zabanon par yeh chadha hua hai ke Ibrahim, Ismail aur Yaqub ke Allah ki qasam, toh jawab mila is liye ke Ibrahim ne toh har har cheez par mujhi ko tarjeeh di aur Ishaq (A.S) ne apne tain meri rah mein zibah hone ke liye supurd kar diya phir bhala aur cheezein use pesh kar dena kya mushkil thin aur Yaqub ko main joon joon balaon mein dalta gaya uske husn-e-zanni mere sath badhti hi rahi. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ke samne ek martaba kisi ne fakhran apne baap dadon ka naam liya toh aap ne farmaya qabil-e-fakhr baap dada toh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke the jo Yaqub bin Ishaq aur Zabihullah bin Ibrahim Khalilullah the. Ikrama, Ibn-e-Abbas, khud Abbas, Ali, Saeed bin Jubair, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Ubaid bin Umair, Abu Maisara, Zaid bin Aslam, Abdullah bin Shafiq, Zuhri, Qasim bin Abu Barza, Makhool, Usman bin Abi Aas, Suddi, Hasan, Qatada, Abu Al-Huzail, Ibn-e-Sabit, Ka'ab Ahbar (Rahimahumullah Ajma'een), in sab ka yahi qaul hai aur Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi ko ikhtiyar karte hain ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the. Sahih ilm toh Allah ko hi hai magar bazahir aisa maloom hota hai ke in sab buzurgon ke ustad Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar hain. Yeh khilafat-e-Farooqi mein musalman hue the aur kabhi kabhi Hazrat Umar (R.A) ko qadeemi kitabon ki baatein sunate the, logon ne ise rukhsat samajh kar phir un se har ek baat bayan karni shuru kar di aur sahih ghalat ki tameez uth gayi, haq toh yeh hai ke is ummat ko agli kitabon ki ek baat ki bhi haajat nahin. Baghawi ne kuch aur naam bhi Sahaba-o-Tabieen ke batlaye hain jinhon ne kaha hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain.

Ek marfu hadith mein bhi yeh aaya hai agar woh hadith sahi hoti toh jhagray ka faisla tha magar woh hadith sahi nahin is mein do rawi za'eef hain. Hasan bin Dinar matrook hain aur Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an munkar-ul-hadith hain aur zyada sahi yeh hai ke hai yeh bhi mauqif, chunancha ek sanad se yeh maqoola Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ka marwi hai aur yahi zyada theek hai. Wallahu A'lam. Ab un aasar ko suniye jin se maloom hota hai ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi thay aur yahi theek aur bilkul durust bhi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) yahi farmatay hain aur farmatay hain ke Yahudi Hazrat Ishaq ka naam jhoot moot letay hain. Ibn-e-Umar, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Hasan Basri, Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi, Khalifatul Muslimeen Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz (Rahimahullah) ke samnay jab Muhammad bin Qurzi ne yeh farmaya aur saath hi is ki daleel bhi di ke zibh ke zikr ke baad Quran mein Khalilullah ko Hazrat Ishaq ke paida honay ki basharat ka zikr hai aur saath hi bayan hai ke un ke haan bhi larka hoga Yaqub nami jab un ke haan larka honay ki basharat di gayi thi phir bawajood un ke haan larka na honay ke us se pehlay hi un ke zibh karnay ka hukum kaisay diya jata hai? Toh Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne farmaya yeh bohat saaf daleel hai mera zehan yahan nahin pohancha tha go yeh main bhi jaanta tha ke Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail hi hain phir Shah-e-Islam ne Shaam ke ek Yahudi aalim se poocha jo Musalman ho gaye thay ke tum is baray mein kya ilm rakhtay ho unhon ne farmaya Ameer-ul-Muslimeen sach toh yahi hai ke jin ke zibh karnay ka hukum diya gaya woh Hazrat Ismail hi thay lekin chunkay Arab un ki aulad mein se hain toh yeh buzurgi un ki taraf laut-ti hai is hasad ke baray mein Yahudiyon ne isay badal diya aur Hazrat Ishaq ka naam le diya. Haqeeqi ilm Allah hi ko hai hamara imaan hai ke Hazrat Ismail, Hazrat Ishaq dono hi tahir-o-tayyab aur Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay. Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein hai ke Hazrat Imam Ahmad bin Hanbal ke sahibzaday Hazrat Abdullah ne apnay walid se jab yeh masla poocha toh aap ne jawab diya ke zibh honay walay Hazrat Ismail hi thay. Hazrat Ali, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar, Abu Tufail, Saeed bin Musayyab, Saeed bin Jubair, Hasan, Mujahid, Sha'bi, Muhammad bin Ka'ab, Abu Jafar Muhammad bin Ali, Abu Saleh (R.A) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Imam Baghawi ne aur bhi sahaba aur tabieen ke naam ginuwaye hain. Ek ghareeb hadith bhi isi ki ta'eed mein marwi hai is mein hai ke Shaam mein Ameer Muawiyah ke samnay yeh behas churi ke Zabihullah kaun hain? Toh aap ne farmaya khoob hua jo yeh mamla mujh jaisay bakhabar shakhs ke paas aaya suno hum Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas thay jab ek shakhs aap ke paas aaya aur kehnay laga ae Allah ki raah mein do zibh honay walon ki nasl ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe bhi maal-e-ghaneemat mein se kuch dilwaiye is par aap hans diye. Ek toh Zabihullah Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah thay dusray Hazrat Ismail jin ki nasl mein se aap hain.

Abdullah ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia yeh hai ke aap ke dada Abdul Muttalib ne jab Chah-e-Zamzam khoda to nazr mani thi ke agar yeh kaam aasani se pura ho gaya to apne ek ladke ko rah-e-Allah mein zibah karunga. Jab kaam ho gaya aur qura-andazi ki gayi ke kis bete ko Allah ke naam par zibah karein to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke walid Abdullah ka naam nikla. Un ke nanhiyal walon ne kaha aap un ki taraf se ek sau oont rah-e-Allah zibah kar dein, chunancha woh zibah kar diye gaye aur Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ka waqia to mashhoor hi hai. Ibn-e-Jarir mein yeh riwayat majood hai aur Maghazi-e-Umawiyah mein bhi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone ki ek daleel to yeh pesh ki hai ke jis 'Ghulamin Aleem' (ilm wale bache) ki basharat ka zikr hai us se murad Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) hain. Quran mein aur jagah hai 'Wa bashsharu bi ghulamin aleem' aur Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki basharat ka yeh jawab diya hai ke woh aap ke sath chalne phirne ki umar ko pahunch gaye the aur mumkin hai ke Yaqub (A.S) ke sath hi koi aur aulad bhi hui ho. Aur Ka'batullah mein seengon ki maujoodgi ke bare mein farmate hain bahut mumkin hai ke yeh Bilad-e-Kanaan se la kar yahan rakhe gaye hon aur baaz logon se Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ke naam ki sarahat bhi aayi hai, lekin yeh sab baatein haqeeqat se bahut door hain. Haan Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke Zabihullah hone par Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi ka istidlal bahut saaf aur qawi hai. Wallahu A'lam. Pehle Zabihullah Hazrat Ismail (A.S) ke tawallud hone ki basharat di gayi thi, yahan us ke baad un ke bhai Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ki basharat di ja rahi hai. Surah Hud aur Surah Hijr mein bhi is ka zikr guzar chuka hai. 'Nabiyan' haal-e-muqaddara hai yani woh Nabi-e-Saleh hoga. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Zabihullah Ishaq (A.S) the aur yahan nabuwat Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) ko basharat hai. Jaise Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke bare mein farman hai ke hum ne unhein apni rahmat se un ke bhai Haroon (A.S) ko Nabi bana diya. Halankeh Hazrat Haroon (A.S) Hazrat Musa (A.S) se bade the to yahan bhi un ki nabuwat ki basharat hai. Pas yeh basharat us waqt di gayi jabkeh imtihan-e-zibah mein woh sabir sabit huye. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh basharat do martaba di gayi, paidaish se kuch qabl aur nabuwat se kuch qabl. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) se bhi yahi marwi hai. Un par aur Ishaq (A.S) par hamari barkatein hum ne nazil farmayin, un ki aulad mein har qisam ke log hain nek bhi bad bhi. Jaise Hazrat Nuh (A.S) se farman hua tha ke ae Nuh! Hamari salam aur barkat ke sath utar. Tu bhi aur tere sath wale bhi aur aise bhi log hain jinhein hum faide pahunchayenge phir unhein hamari taraf se dardnak azab pahunchenge.

Hazrat Musa A.S par inamaat-e-Ilahi. Allah Ta'ala Hazrat Musa A.S aur Haroon A.S par apni ne'matein jata raha hai ke unhein nabuwwat di, unhein ma' un ki qoum ke Firaun jaise taqatwar dushman se nijaat di jis ne unhein be-tarah past-o-zaleel kar rakha tha, un ke bachon ko kaat deta tha, un ki ladkiyon ko rehne deta tha, un se zaleel mazdooriyan karata tha aur be-haisiyat bana rakha tha. Aise badtareen dushman ko un ke dekhte halak kiya, unhein us par ghalib kar diya, un ki zameen-o-zar ke yeh maalik ban gaye. Phir Hazrat Musa A.S ko wazeh, jali, roshan aur bayyin kitab inayat farmayi jo haq-o-batil mein farq-o-faisla karne wali aur noor-o-hidayat wali thi, un ke aqwal-o-af'aal mein unhein istiqamat ata farmayi aur un ke baad walon mein bhi un ka zikr-e-khair aur sana-o-sifat baqi rakhi ke har zaban un par salam hi padhti hai. Hum nek karon ko yahi aur aise hi badle dete hain. Woh hamare momin bande thay.

Hazrat Ilyas A.S. Ba'az kehte hain Ilyas naam tha Hazrat Idris A.S. ka. Wahab kehte hain unka silsila-e-nasab yun hai Ilyas bin Nasi bin Fahas bin Abraz bin Haroon bin Imran Alaihis Salam. Khurqeel A.S. ke baad yeh Bani Israel mein bheje gaye the, woh log Ba'al nami but ke pujari ban gaye the. Unhon ne dawat-e-Islam di, unke badshah ne unse qabool bhi karli lekin phir murtad ho gaya aur log bhi sarkashi par tule rahe aur iman se inkar kardiya. Aap ne un par bad-dua ki, teen saal tak barish na barshi. Ab toh yeh sab tang aa gaye aur qasmein kha kha kar iqrar kiya ke aap dua kijiye, barish baraste hi hum sab aap ki nabuwat par iman layenge. Chunancha aap ki dua se meena barsa. Lekin yeh kuffar apne wade se tal gaye aur apne kufr par ad gaye. Aap ne yeh halat dekh kar Allah se dua ki ke Allah inhe apni taraf le le. Unke hathon tale Hazrat Yasa bin Akhtub pale the. Hazrat Ilyas ki is dua ke baad unhein hukum mila ke woh ek jagah jayen aur wahan unhein jo sawari mile us par sawar ho jayen. Wahan aap gaye, ek noori ghoda dikhayi diya jis par sawar ho gaye, Allah ne unhein bhi noorani kardiya aur apne paron se farishton ke sath udne lage aur ek insani farishta zamini aur asmani ban gaye. Is ki sehat ka ilm Allah hi ko hai. Hai yeh baat Ahl-e-Kitab ki riwayat se. Hazrat Ilyas ne apni qoum se farmaya ke kya tum Allah se darte nahin ho? Ke us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karte ho? Ahl-e-Yaman aur qabila Azu-Shanuwah Rabb ko Ba'al kehte the. Ba'al nami jis but ki yeh puja karte the woh ek aurat thi. Unke shehar ka naam Ba'albak tha, toh Allah ke Nabi Hazrat Ilyas A.S. farmate hain ke ta'ajjub hai ke tum Allah Ta'ala ko chhod kar jo Khaliq-e-Kul hai aur behtareen Khallaq hai, ek but ko puj rahe ho? Aur us ko pukarte rehte ho? Allah Ta'ala tum sab ka aur tum se agle tumhare baap dadon ka Rabb hai, wahi mustahiq-e-ibadat hai, us ke siwa kisi qisam ki ibadat kisi ke laiq nahin. Lekin un logon ne Allah ke pyare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki is saaf aur khair-khwahana nasihat ko na mana toh Allah ne bhi unhein azab par hazir kardiya, ke Qayamat ke din un se zabardast baz-purs aur un par sakht azab honge. Haan un mein se jo tauheed par qaim the woh bach rahenge. Hum ne Hazrat Ilyas A.S. ki sana-e-jameel aur zikr-e-khair pichle logon mein bhi baqi hi rakha ke har Muslim ki zaban se un par durood-o-salam bheja jata hai. Ilyas mein dusri lughat Ilyaseen hai jaise Ismail mein Isma'een, Banu Asad mein isi tarah yeh lughat hai. Ek Tamimi ke sher mein yeh lughat is tarah laya gaya hai. Mika'il ko Mikaal aur Mika'een bhi kaha jata hai. Ibrahim ko Abrahaam, Israel ko Saza'een, Toor-e-Sina ko Toor-e-Sineen. Gharz yeh lughat Arab mein mashhoor-o-ra'ij hai. Ibn Mas'ood ki qira'at mein Salamun 'ala Il-Yaseen hai. Ba'az kehte hain is se murad Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain. Hum isi tarah nek-karon ko nek badla dete hain. Yaqeenan woh hamare momin bandon mein se the. Is jumla ki tafseer guzar chuki hai, wallahu Ta'ala A'alam.

Hazrat Ilyas A.S. Ba'az kehte hain Ilyas naam tha Hazrat Idris A.S. ka. Wahab kehte hain unka silsila-e-nasab yun hai Ilyas bin Nasi bin Fahas bin Abraz bin Haroon bin Imran Alaihis Salam. Khurqeel A.S. ke baad yeh Bani Israel mein bheje gaye the, woh log Ba'al nami but ke pujari ban gaye the. Unhon ne dawat-e-Islam di, unke badshah ne unse qabool bhi karli lekin phir murtad ho gaya aur log bhi sarkashi par tule rahe aur iman se inkar kardiya. Aap ne un par bad-dua ki, teen saal tak barish na barshi. Ab toh yeh sab tang aa gaye aur qasmein kha kha kar iqrar kiya ke aap dua kijiye, barish baraste hi hum sab aap ki nabuwat par iman layenge. Chunancha aap ki dua se meena barsa. Lekin yeh kuffar apne wade se tal gaye aur apne kufr par ad gaye. Aap ne yeh halat dekh kar Allah se dua ki ke Allah inhe apni taraf le le. Unke hathon tale Hazrat Yasa bin Akhtub pale the. Hazrat Ilyas ki is dua ke baad unhein hukum mila ke woh ek jagah jayen aur wahan unhein jo sawari mile us par sawar ho jayen. Wahan aap gaye, ek noori ghoda dikhayi diya jis par sawar ho gaye, Allah ne unhein bhi noorani kardiya aur apne paron se farishton ke sath udne lage aur ek insani farishta zamini aur asmani ban gaye. Is ki sehat ka ilm Allah hi ko hai. Hai yeh baat Ahl-e-Kitab ki riwayat se. Hazrat Ilyas ne apni qoum se farmaya ke kya tum Allah se darte nahin ho? Ke us ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karte ho? Qaum-e-Lut (A.S) ek ibrat ka maqam. Allah Ta'ala ke banday aur us ke Rasool Hazrat Lut (A.S) ka bayan ho raha hai ke unhein bhi un ki qaum ne jhutlaya. Jis par Allah ke azab un par baras paray aur Allah ne apne pyaray Hazrat Lut (A.S) ko ma'a un ke ghar walon ke nijat de di. Lekin un ki biwi gharat hui, qaum ke sath hi halak hui aur sari qaum bhi tabah hui. Waqi'a-e-Hazrat Yunus A.S. Hazrat Yunus A.S. ka qissa Surah Yunus mein bayan ho chuka hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hadith hai ke kisi bande ko yeh laiq nahin ke woh kahe main Yunus bin Matta se afzal hoon. Yeh naam mumkin hai aap ki walida ka ho aur mumkin hai walid ka ho. Yeh bhaag kar maal-o-asbaab se ladi hui kashti par sawaar ho gaye. Wahan qur'a andazi hui aur yeh maghloob ho gaye kashti ke chalte hi charon taraf se maujein uthin aur sakht toofan aaya. Yahan tak ke sab ko apni maut ka aur kashti ke doob jaane ka yaqeen ho gaya. Sab aapas mein kehne lage ke qur'a daalo jis ke naam ka qur'a nikle use samundar mein daal do taake sab bach jayen aur kashti is toofan se chhoot jaye. Teen dafa qur'a andazi hui aur teenon martaba Allah ke pyare paighambar Hazrat Yunus A.S. ka hi naam nikla. Ahl-e-kashti aap ko paani mein bahana nahin chahte the lekin kya karte baar baar ki qur'a andazi par bhi aap ka naam nikalta raha aur khud aap kapde utaar kar bawajood un logon ke rokne ke samundar mein kood pade. Is waqt Bahr-e-Akhzar ki ek bahut badi machhli ko Janab-e-Bari ka farman sarzad hua ke woh daryaaon ko cheer-ti phaad-ti jaye aur Hazrat Yunus ko nigal le lekin na to un ka jism zakhmi ho na koi haddi toote. Chunancha is machhli ne paighambar-e-Allah ko nigal liya aur samundaron mein chalne phirne lagi. Jab Hazrat Yunus poori tarah machhli ke pet mein ja chuke to aap ko khayal guzra ke main mar chuka hoon lekin jab haath pairon ko harkat di aur hile jule to zindagi ka yaqeen kar ke wahin khade ho kar namaz shuru kar di aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke ae Parwardigar main ne tere liye is jagah masjid banayi hai jahan koi na pahuncha hoga. Teen din ya saat din ya chalees din ek ek din se bhi kam ya sirf ek raat tak machhli ke pet mein rahe. Agar yeh hamari pakeezgi bayan karne walon mein se na hote, yani jabke farakhi aur kushaadgi aur amn-o-amaan ki halat mein the us waqt un ki nekiyan agar na hotin ek hadith bhi is qisam ki hai jo anqareeb bayan hogi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A. ki hadith mein hai aaram aur rahat ke waqt Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karo to woh sakhti aur bechaini ke waqt tumhari madad karega. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh paband-e-namaz na hote aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar machhli ke pet mein namaz na padhte aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh (لَّآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنْتَ سُبْحٰــنَكَ ڰ اِنِّىْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 87) ke saath hamari tasbeeh na karte chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayaton mein hai ke us ne andheron mein yahi kalmaat kahe aur hum ne us ki dua qabool farma kar use gham se najaat di aur isi tarah hum mominon ko najaat dete hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Yunus A.S. ne jab machhli ke pet mein in kalmaat ko kaha to yeh dua Arsh-e-Allah ke gird-o-pesh mandlane lagi aur farishton ne kaha Allah yeh aawaz to kahin bahut hi door ki hai lekin is aawaz se hamare kaan aashna zaroor hain. Allah ne farmaya ab bhi pehchan liya yeh kis ki aawaz hai?

Unhon ne kaha nahin pehchana, farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus A.S ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha wohi Yunus jiske nek aamaal aur maqbool duayein hamesha aasman par chadhti rehti thin? Allah is par toh zaroor raham farma, iski dua qabool kar, woh toh aasaniyon mein bhi tera naam liya karta tha. Ise bala se nijat de. Allah ne farmaya haan main ise nijat doonga. Chunancha machli ko hukum hua ke maidan mein Hazrat Yunus A.S ko ugal de aur usne ugal diya aur wahin Allah Ta'ala ne un par unki nahifi, kamzori aur bimari ki wajah se chhaon ke liye kaddu ki bail uga di aur ek jungli bakri ko muqarrar kar diya jo subh-o-sham unke paas aa jati thi aur yeh iska doodh pee liya karte the. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki riwayat se yeh waqiyat marfoo ahadees se Surah Anbiya ki tafsir mein bayan ho chuke hain. Humne unhein is zameen mein daal diya jahan sabza, rooyidagi, ghaas kuch na tha. Dajla ke kinare ya Yaman ki sar-zameen par yeh laade gaye the. Woh us waqt kamzor the jaise parindon ke bachche hote hain, ya bachcha jis waqt paida hota hai. Yani sirf saans chal raha tha aur taqat hilne julne ki bhi na thi. Yaqteen kaddu ke darakht ko bhi kehte hain aur har us darakht ko jiska tana na ho yani bail ho aur us darakht ko bhi jiski umar ek saal se zyada nahin hoti. Kaddu mein bahut se fawaid hain, yeh bahut jald ugta aur badhta hai, iske patton ka saya ghana aur farhat bakhsh hota hai kyunke woh bade bade hote hain aur iske paas makkhiyan nahin aatin. Yeh ghiza ka kaam de jata hai aur chhalke aur gooday samet khaya jata hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ko kaddu yani ghiya bahut pasand tha aur bartan mein se chun chun kar ise khate the. Phir unhein ek lakh balkay zyada aadmiyon ki taraf risalat ke sath bheja gaya. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain is se pehle aap rasool ﷺ na the. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain machli ke pet mein jaane se pehle hi aap is qoum ki taraf rasool bana kar bheje gaye the. Donon qaulon se is tarah tazad uth sakta hai ke pehle bhi unki taraf bheje gaye the, ab dobara bhi unhi ki taraf bheje gaye aur woh sab iman laye aur aap ki tasdeeq ki. Baghvi R.H kehte hain machli ke pet se nijat paane ke baad dusri qoum ki taraf bheje gaye the. Yahan 'au' ma'ani mein 'balkay' ke hai aur woh ek lakh tees hazar ya us se bhi kuch oopar, ya ek lakh chalis hazar se bhi zyada ya sattar hazar se bhi zyada ya ek lakh das hazar aur ek ghareeb marfoo hadith ki roo se ek lakh bees hazar the. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke insani andaza ek lakh se zyada hi ka tha. Ibn Jareer R.H ka yahi maslak hai aur yahi maslak unka aayat (اَوْ اَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً 74؀) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 74) aur aayat (اَوْ اَشَدَّ خَشْـيَةً 77؀) (Surah An-Nisa: 77) aur aayat (اَوْ اَدْنٰى ۚ) (Surah An-Najm: 9) mein hai, yani is se kam nahin is se zaid hai.

Pas Qaum-e-Yunus sab ki sab musalman ho gayi, Hazrat Yunus (A.S) ki tasdeeq ki aur Allah par iman le aaye. Hum ne bhi un ke muqarrara waqt yani maut ki ghari tak dunyawi faide diye aur ayat mein hai kisi basti ke iman ne unhein (azab aa chukne ke baad) nafa nahin diya siwaye Qaum-e-Yunus ke, woh jab iman laye to hum ne un par se azab hata liye aur unhein ek miyad-e-muayyan tak bahra-mand kiya.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh paband-e-namaz na hote aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar machhli ke pet mein namaz na padhte aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh (لَّآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنْتَ سُبْحٰــنَكَ ڰ اِنِّىْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 87) ke saath hamari tasbeeh na karte chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayaton mein hai ke us ne andheron mein yahi kalmaat kahe aur hum ne us ki dua qabool farma kar use gham se najaat di aur isi tarah hum mominon ko najaat dete hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Yunus A.S. ne jab machhli ke pet mein in kalmaat ko kaha to yeh dua Arsh-e-Allah ke gird-o-pesh mandlane lagi aur farishton ne kaha Allah yeh aawaz to kahin bahut hi door ki hai lekin is aawaz se hamare kaan aashna zaroor hain. Unhon ne kaha nahin pehchana, farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus A.S ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha wohi Yunus jiske nek aamaal aur maqbool duayein hamesha aasman par chadhti rehti thin? Allah is par toh zaroor raham farma, iski dua qabool kar, woh toh aasaniyon mein bhi tera naam liya karta tha. Ise bala se nijat de. Allah ne farmaya haan main ise nijat doonga. Chunancha machli ko hukum hua ke maidan mein Hazrat Yunus A.S ko ugal de aur usne ugal diya aur wahin Allah Ta'ala ne un par unki nahifi, kamzori aur bimari ki wajah se chhaon ke liye kaddu ki bail uga di aur ek jungli bakri ko muqarrar kar diya jo subh-o-sham unke paas aa jati thi aur yeh iska doodh pee liya karte the. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki riwayat se yeh waqiyat marfoo ahadees se Surah Anbiya ki tafsir mein bayan ho chuke hain. Humne unhein is zameen mein daal diya jahan sabza, rooyidagi, ghaas kuch na tha. Dajla ke kinare ya Yaman ki sar-zameen par yeh laade gaye the. Woh us waqt kamzor the jaise parindon ke bachche hote hain, ya bachcha jis waqt paida hota hai. Yani sirf saans chal raha tha aur taqat hilne julne ki bhi na thi. Yaqteen kaddu ke darakht ko bhi kehte hain aur har us darakht ko jiska tana na ho yani bail ho aur us darakht ko bhi jiski umar ek saal se zyada nahin hoti. Kaddu mein bahut se fawaid hain, yeh bahut jald ugta aur badhta hai, iske patton ka saya ghana aur farhat bakhsh hota hai kyunke woh bade bade hote hain aur iske paas makkhiyan nahin aatin. Yeh ghiza ka kaam de jata hai aur chhalke aur gooday samet khaya jata hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ko kaddu yani ghiya bahut pasand tha aur bartan mein se chun chun kar ise khate the. Phir unhein ek lakh balkay zyada aadmiyon ki taraf risalat ke sath bheja gaya. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain is se pehle aap rasool ﷺ na the. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain machli ke pet mein jaane se pehle hi aap is qoum ki taraf rasool bana kar bheje gaye the. Donon qaulon se is tarah tazad uth sakta hai ke pehle bhi unki taraf bheje gaye the, ab dobara bhi unhi ki taraf bheje gaye aur woh sab iman laye aur aap ki tasdeeq ki. Baghvi R.H kehte hain machli ke pet se nijat paane ke baad dusri qoum ki taraf bheje gaye the. Yahan 'au' ma'ani mein 'balkay' ke hai aur woh ek lakh tees hazar ya us se bhi kuch oopar, ya ek lakh chalis hazar se bhi zyada ya sattar hazar se bhi zyada ya ek lakh das hazar aur ek ghareeb marfoo hadith ki roo se ek lakh bees hazar the. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke insani andaza ek lakh se zyada hi ka tha. Ibn Jareer R.H ka yahi maslak hai aur yahi maslak unka aayat (اَوْ اَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً 74؀) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 74) aur aayat (اَوْ اَشَدَّ خَشْـيَةً 77؀) (Surah An-Nisa: 77) aur aayat (اَوْ اَدْنٰى ۚ) (Surah An-Najm: 9) mein hai, yani is se kam nahin is se zaid hai.

Bukhari Muslim mein hadith hai ke kisi bande ko yeh laiq nahin ke woh kahe main Yunus bin Matta se afzal hoon. Yeh naam mumkin hai aap ki walida ka ho aur mumkin hai walid ka ho. Yahan tak ke sab ko apni maut ka aur kashti ke doob jaane ka yaqeen ho gaya. Sab aapas mein kehne lage ke qur'a daalo jis ke naam ka qur'a nikle use samundar mein daal do taake sab bach jayen aur kashti is toofan se chhoot jaye. Teen dafa qur'a andazi hui aur teenon martaba Allah ke pyare paighambar Hazrat Yunus A.S. ka hi naam nikla. Ahl-e-kashti aap ko paani mein bahana nahin chahte the lekin kya karte baar baar ki qur'a andazi par bhi aap ka naam nikalta raha aur khud aap kapde utaar kar bawajood un logon ke rokne ke samundar mein kood pade. Is waqt Bahr-e-Akhzar ki ek bahut badi machhli ko Janab-e-Bari ka farman sarzad hua ke woh daryaaon ko cheer-ti phaad-ti jaye aur Hazrat Yunus ko nigal le lekin na to un ka jism zakhmi ho na koi haddi toote. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh paband-e-namaz na hote aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar machhli ke pet mein namaz na padhte aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh (لَّآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنْتَ سُبْحٰــنَكَ ڰ اِنِّىْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 87) ke saath hamari tasbeeh na karte chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayaton mein hai ke us ne andheron mein yahi kalmaat kahe aur hum ne us ki dua qabool farma kar use gham se najaat di aur isi tarah hum mominon ko najaat dete hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Yunus A.S. ne jab machhli ke pet mein in kalmaat ko kaha to yeh dua Arsh-e-Allah ke gird-o-pesh mandlane lagi aur farishton ne kaha Allah yeh aawaz to kahin bahut hi door ki hai lekin is aawaz se hamare kaan aashna zaroor hain. Unhon ne kaha nahin pehchana, farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus A.S ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha wohi Yunus jiske nek aamaal aur maqbool duayein hamesha aasman par chadhti rehti thin? Allah is par toh zaroor raham farma, iski dua qabool kar, woh toh aasaniyon mein bhi tera naam liya karta tha. Ise bala se nijat de. Allah ne farmaya haan main ise nijat doonga. Chunancha machli ko hukum hua ke maidan mein Hazrat Yunus A.S ko ugal de aur usne ugal diya aur wahin Allah Ta'ala ne un par unki nahifi, kamzori aur bimari ki wajah se chhaon ke liye kaddu ki bail uga di aur ek jungli bakri ko muqarrar kar diya jo subh-o-sham unke paas aa jati thi aur yeh iska doodh pee liya karte the. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki riwayat se yeh waqiyat marfoo ahadees se Surah Anbiya ki tafsir mein bayan ho chuke hain. Humne unhein is zameen mein daal diya jahan sabza, rooyidagi, ghaas kuch na tha. Dajla ke kinare ya Yaman ki sar-zameen par yeh laade gaye the. Woh us waqt kamzor the jaise parindon ke bachche hote hain, ya bachcha jis waqt paida hota hai. Yani sirf saans chal raha tha aur taqat hilne julne ki bhi na thi. Yaqteen kaddu ke darakht ko bhi kehte hain aur har us darakht ko jiska tana na ho yani bail ho aur us darakht ko bhi jiski umar ek saal se zyada nahin hoti. Kaddu mein bahut se fawaid hain, yeh bahut jald ugta aur badhta hai, iske patton ka saya ghana aur farhat bakhsh hota hai kyunke woh bade bade hote hain aur iske paas makkhiyan nahin aatin. Yeh ghiza ka kaam de jata hai aur chhalke aur gooday samet khaya jata hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ko kaddu yani ghiya bahut pasand tha aur bartan mein se chun chun kar ise khate the. Phir unhein ek lakh balkay zyada aadmiyon ki taraf risalat ke sath bheja gaya. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain is se pehle aap rasool ﷺ na the. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain machli ke pet mein jaane se pehle hi aap is qoum ki taraf rasool bana kar bheje gaye the. Donon qaulon se is tarah tazad uth sakta hai ke pehle bhi unki taraf bheje gaye the, ab dobara bhi unhi ki taraf bheje gaye aur woh sab iman laye aur aap ki tasdeeq ki. Baghvi R.H kehte hain machli ke pet se nijat paane ke baad dusri qoum ki taraf bheje gaye the. Yahan 'au' ma'ani mein 'balkay' ke hai aur woh ek lakh tees hazar ya us se bhi kuch oopar, ya ek lakh chalis hazar se bhi zyada ya sattar hazar se bhi zyada ya ek lakh das hazar aur ek ghareeb marfoo hadith ki roo se ek lakh bees hazar the. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke insani andaza ek lakh se zyada hi ka tha. Ibn Jareer R.H ka yahi maslak hai aur yahi maslak unka aayat (اَوْ اَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً 74؀) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 74) aur aayat (اَوْ اَشَدَّ خَشْـيَةً 77؀) (Surah An-Nisa: 77) aur aayat (اَوْ اَدْنٰى ۚ) (Surah An-Najm: 9) mein hai, yani is se kam nahin is se zaid hai.

Bukhari Muslim mein hadith hai ke kisi bande ko yeh laiq nahin ke woh kahe main Yunus bin Matta se afzal hoon. Yeh naam mumkin hai aap ki walida ka ho aur mumkin hai walid ka ho. Yahan tak ke sab ko apni maut ka aur kashti ke doob jaane ka yaqeen ho gaya. Sab aapas mein kehne lage ke qur'a daalo jis ke naam ka qur'a nikle use samundar mein daal do taake sab bach jayen aur kashti is toofan se chhoot jaye. Teen dafa qur'a andazi hui aur teenon martaba Allah ke pyare paighambar Hazrat Yunus A.S. ka hi naam nikla. Ahl-e-kashti aap ko paani mein bahana nahin chahte the lekin kya karte baar baar ki qur'a andazi par bhi aap ka naam nikalta raha aur khud aap kapde utaar kar bawajood un logon ke rokne ke samundar mein kood pade. Is waqt Bahr-e-Akhzar ki ek bahut badi machhli ko Janab-e-Bari ka farman sarzad hua ke woh daryaaon ko cheer-ti phaad-ti jaye aur Hazrat Yunus ko nigal le lekin na to un ka jism zakhmi ho na koi haddi toote. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh paband-e-namaz na hote aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar machhli ke pet mein namaz na padhte aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke agar yeh (لَّآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنْتَ سُبْحٰــنَكَ ڰ اِنِّىْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 87) ke saath hamari tasbeeh na karte chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ki aur aayaton mein hai ke us ne andheron mein yahi kalmaat kahe aur hum ne us ki dua qabool farma kar use gham se najaat di aur isi tarah hum mominon ko najaat dete hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Yunus A.S. ne jab machhli ke pet mein in kalmaat ko kaha to yeh dua Arsh-e-Allah ke gird-o-pesh mandlane lagi aur farishton ne kaha Allah yeh aawaz to kahin bahut hi door ki hai lekin is aawaz se hamare kaan aashna zaroor hain. Allah ne farmaya ab bhi pehchan liya yeh kis ki aawaz hai?

Unhon ne kaha nahin pehchana, farmaya yeh mere bande Yunus A.S ki aawaz hai. Farishton ne kaha wohi Yunus jiske nek aamaal aur maqbool duayein hamesha aasman par chadhti rehti thin? Allah is par toh zaroor raham farma, iski dua qabool kar, woh toh aasaniyon mein bhi tera naam liya karta tha. Ise bala se nijat de. Allah ne farmaya haan main ise nijat doonga. Chunancha machli ko hukum hua ke maidan mein Hazrat Yunus A.S ko ugal de aur usne ugal diya aur wahin Allah Ta'ala ne un par unki nahifi, kamzori aur bimari ki wajah se chhaon ke liye kaddu ki bail uga di aur ek jungli bakri ko muqarrar kar diya jo subh-o-sham unke paas aa jati thi aur yeh iska doodh pee liya karte the. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ki riwayat se yeh waqiyat marfoo ahadees se Surah Anbiya ki tafsir mein bayan ho chuke hain. Humne unhein is zameen mein daal diya jahan sabza, rooyidagi, ghaas kuch na tha. Dajla ke kinare ya Yaman ki sar-zameen par yeh laade gaye the. Woh us waqt kamzor the jaise parindon ke bachche hote hain, ya bachcha jis waqt paida hota hai. Yani sirf saans chal raha tha aur taqat hilne julne ki bhi na thi. Yaqteen kaddu ke darakht ko bhi kehte hain aur har us darakht ko jiska tana na ho yani bail ho aur us darakht ko bhi jiski umar ek saal se zyada nahin hoti. Kaddu mein bahut se fawaid hain, yeh bahut jald ugta aur badhta hai, iske patton ka saya ghana aur farhat bakhsh hota hai kyunke woh bade bade hote hain aur iske paas makkhiyan nahin aatin. Yeh ghiza ka kaam de jata hai aur chhalke aur gooday samet khaya jata hai. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ko kaddu yani ghiya bahut pasand tha aur bartan mein se chun chun kar ise khate the. Phir unhein ek lakh balkay zyada aadmiyon ki taraf risalat ke sath bheja gaya. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain is se pehle aap rasool ﷺ na the. Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain machli ke pet mein jaane se pehle hi aap is qoum ki taraf rasool bana kar bheje gaye the. Donon qaulon se is tarah tazad uth sakta hai ke pehle bhi unki taraf bheje gaye the, ab dobara bhi unhi ki taraf bheje gaye aur woh sab iman laye aur aap ki tasdeeq ki. Baghvi R.H kehte hain machli ke pet se nijat paane ke baad dusri qoum ki taraf bheje gaye the. Yahan 'au' ma'ani mein 'balkay' ke hai aur woh ek lakh tees hazar ya us se bhi kuch oopar, ya ek lakh chalis hazar se bhi zyada ya sattar hazar se bhi zyada ya ek lakh das hazar aur ek ghareeb marfoo hadith ki roo se ek lakh bees hazar the. Yeh matlab bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke insani andaza ek lakh se zyada hi ka tha. Ibn Jareer R.H ka yahi maslak hai aur yahi maslak unka aayat (اَوْ اَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً 74؀) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 74) aur aayat (اَوْ اَشَدَّ خَشْـيَةً 77؀) (Surah An-Nisa: 77) aur aayat (اَوْ اَدْنٰى ۚ) (Surah An-Najm: 9) mein hai, yani is se kam nahin is se zaid hai.

Pas Qaum-e-Yunus sab ki sab musalman ho gayi, Hazrat Yunus (A.S) ki tasdeeq ki aur Allah par iman le aaye. Hum ne bhi un ke muqarrara waqt yani maut ki ghari tak dunyawi faide diye aur ayat mein hai kisi basti ke iman ne unhein (azab aa chukne ke baad) nafa nahin diya siwaye Qaum-e-Yunus ke, woh jab iman laye to hum ne un par se azab hata liye aur unhein ek miyad-e-muayyan tak bahra-mand kiya.

Waqi'a-e-Hazrat Yunus A.S. Hazrat Yunus A.S. ka qissa Surah Yunus mein bayan ho chuka hai. Bukhari Muslim mein hadith hai ke kisi bande ko yeh laiq nahin ke woh kahe main Yunus bin Matta se afzal hoon. Yeh naam mumkin hai aap ki walida ka ho aur mumkin hai walid ka ho. Yeh bhaag kar maal-o-asbaab se ladi hui kashti par sawaar ho gaye. Wahan qur'a andazi hui aur yeh maghloob ho gaye kashti ke chalte hi charon taraf se maujein uthin aur sakht toofan aaya. Yahan tak ke sab ko apni maut ka aur kashti ke doob jaane ka yaqeen ho gaya. Sab aapas mein kehne lage ke qur'a daalo jis ke naam ka qur'a nikle use samundar mein daal do taake sab bach jayen aur kashti is toofan se chhoot jaye. Teen dafa qur'a andazi hui aur teenon martaba Allah ke pyare paighambar Hazrat Yunus A.S. ka hi naam nikla. Ahl-e-kashti aap ko paani mein bahana nahin chahte the lekin kya karte baar baar ki qur'a andazi par bhi aap ka naam nikalta raha aur khud aap kapde utaar kar bawajood un logon ke rokne ke samundar mein kood pade. Is waqt Bahr-e-Akhzar ki ek bahut badi machhli ko Janab-e-Bari ka farman sarzad hua ke woh daryaaon ko cheer-ti phaad-ti jaye aur Hazrat Yunus ko nigal le lekin na to un ka jism zakhmi ho na koi haddi toote. Chunancha is machhli ne paighambar-e-Allah ko nigal liya aur samundaron mein chalne phirne lagi. Jab Hazrat Yunus poori tarah machhli ke pet mein ja chuke to aap ko khayal guzra ke main mar chuka hoon lekin jab haath pairon ko harkat di aur hile jule to zindagi ka yaqeen kar ke wahin khade ho kar namaz shuru kar di aur Allah Ta'ala se arz ki ke ae Parwardigar main ne tere liye is jagah masjid banayi hai jahan koi na pahuncha hoga. Teen din ya saat din ya chalees din ek ek din se bhi kam ya sirf ek raat tak machhli ke pet mein rahe. Mushrikeen ka Allah Ta'ala ke liye dohra mayar. Allah Ta'ala mushrikon ki bewaqoofi bayan farma raha hai ke apne liye toh larke pasand karte hain aur Allah ke liye larkiyan muqarrar karte hain. Agar larki hone ki khabar yeh payein toh chehre siyah par jate hain aur Allah ki larkiyan sabit karte hain. Pas farmata hai in se pooch toh sahi ke yeh taqseem kaisi hai? Ke tumhare toh larke hon aur Allah ke liye larkiyan hon? Phir farmata hai ke yeh farishton ko larkiyan kis suboot par kehte hain? Kya in ki paidaish ke waqt woh majood thay. Quran ki aur ayat (Waja'alul-mala'ikatallazina hum 'ibadur-Rahmani inasa, ashahidu khalqahum, satuktabu shahadatuhum wa yus'alun) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 19), mein bhi yahi bayan hai. Dar-asal yeh qaul in ka mehez jhoot hai. Ke Allah ke haan aulad hai. Woh aulad se pak hai. Pas in logon ke teen jhoot aur teen kufr hue, awwal toh yeh ke farishte Allah ki aulad hain, dusre yeh ke aulad bhi larkiyan, teesre yeh ke khud farishton ki ibadat shuru kar di. Phir farmata hai ke aakhir kis cheez ne Allah ko majboor kiya ke us ne larke toh liye nahin aur larkiyan apni zaat ke liye pasand farmayin? Jaise aur ayat mein hai ke tumhein toh larkon se nawaze aur farishton ko apni larkiyan banaye, yeh toh tumhari nihayat darja ki laghwiyat hai. Yahan farmaya kya tumhein aql nahin jo aisi door az qiyas baatein banate ho, tum samajhte nahin ho, daro ke Allah par jhoot bandhna kaisa bura hai? Acha agar koi daleel tumhare paas ho toh lao isi ko pesh karo. Ya agar kisi aasmani kitab se tumhare is qaul ki sanad ho aur tum sache ho toh lao isi ko samne le aao. Yeh toh aisi lachar aur fazool baat hai jis ki koi aqli ya naqli daleel ho hi nahin sakti. Itne hi par bas na ki, jinnat mein aur Allah mein bhi rishtedari qaim ki. Mushrikeen ke is qaul par ke farishte Allah ki larkiyan hain, Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ne sawal kiya ke phir in ki maayein kaun hain? Toh unhon ne kaha jinn sardaron ki larkiyan. Halankeh khud jinnat ko is ka yaqeen-o-ilm hai ke is qaul ke qail Qayamat ke din azabon mein mubtala kiye jayenge. In mein ba'az dushmanan-e-Allah toh yahan tak kam-aqli karte thay ke Shaitan bhi Allah ka bhai hai. Na'uzubillah. Allah Ta'ala is se bohat pak, munazzah aur bilkul door hai jo yeh mushrik is ki zaat par ilzam lagate hain aur jhoote bohtan bandhte hain. Is ke baad istisna-e-munqata hai aur be-musbat magar is soorat mein ke ya'foon ki zameer ka marja tamam log qarar diye jayen. Pas in mein se in logon ko alag kar liya jo haq ke matehat hain aur tamam nabiyon rasoolon par iman rakhte hain. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H farmate hain ke yeh istisna (Annahum lamuhdarun) se hai yani sab ke sab azab mein phans liye jayenge magar woh bandagan jo ikhlas wale thay. Yeh qaul zara ta'ammul talab hai, Wallahu A'alam.

Phir farmata hai ke aakhir kis cheez ne Allah ko majboor kiya ke us ne larke toh liye nahin aur larkiyan apni zaat ke liye pasand farmayin? Jaise aur ayat mein hai ke tumhein toh larkon se nawaze aur farishton ko apni larkiyan banaye, yeh toh tumhari nihayat darja ki laghwiyat hai. Yahan farmaya kya tumhein aql nahin jo aisi door az qiyas baatein banate ho, tum samajhte nahin ho, daro ke Allah par jhoot bandhna kaisa bura hai? Acha agar koi daleel tumhare paas ho toh lao isi ko pesh karo. Ya agar kisi aasmani kitab se tumhare is qaul ki sanad ho aur tum sache ho toh lao isi ko samne le aao. Yeh toh aisi lachar aur fazool baat hai jis ki koi aqli ya naqli daleel ho hi nahin sakti. Itne hi par bas na ki, jinnat mein aur Allah mein bhi rishtedari qaim ki. Pas in mein se in logon ko alag kar liya jo haq ke matehat hain aur tamam nabiyon rasoolon par iman rakhte hain. Yeh qaul zara ta'ammul talab hai, Wallahu A'alam.

Farishton ke ausaf. Allah Ta'ala mushrikon se farma raha hai ke tumhari gumrahi aur shirk-o-kufr ki taleem wahi qabool karenge jo jahannam ke liye paida kiye gaye hon. Jo aql se khali, kanon se behre aur aankhon ke andhe hon jo misl-e-chopayon ke balkeh un se bhi badarja badtar hon. Jaise aur jagah farmaya hai ke is se wahi gumrah ho sakte hain jo dimagh ke khali aur batil ke shaidai hon. Azan-baad farishton ki bara'at aur un ki tasalli-o-raza, iman-o-ita'at ka zikr farmaya ke woh khud kehte hain ke hum mein se har ek ke liye ek muqarrar jagah aur ek maqam-e-ibadat makhsoos hai jis se na hum hat sakte hain na is mein kami beshi kar sakte hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke aasman char-chara raha hai aur waqai mein ise char-charana bhi chahiye is mein ek qadam rakhne jitni jagah bhi khali nahin jahan koi na koi farishta ruku-o-sajde mein pada hua na ho. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne in teenon aayaton ki tilawat ki. Ek riwayat mein aasman-e-duniya ka lafz hai. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain ek balisht bhar jagah aasmanon mein aisi nahin jahan par kisi na kisi farishte ke qadam ya peshani na ho. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) farmate hain pehle to mard aurat ek sath namaz padhte the lekin is aayat ke nuzool ke baad mardon ko aage badha diya gaya aur aurton ko peeche kar diya gaya aur hum sab farishte saff-e-basta ibadat Allah ki kiya karte hain (وَالصّــٰۗفّٰتِ صَفًّا ۙ) (Surah As-Saffat: 1) ki tafseer mein is ka bayan guzar chuka hai. Waleed bin Abdullah farmate hain ke is aayat ke nazil hone tak namaz ki saffen nahin thin phir saffen muqarrar ho gayin. Hazrat Umar (R.A) iqamat ke baad logon ki taraf munh kar ke farmate the saffen theek durust kar lo seedhe khade ho jao Allah Ta'ala tum se bhi farishton ki tarah saff-bandi chahta hai. Jaise woh farmate hain (وَّاِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّاۗفُّوْنَ) (Surah As-Saffat: 165) ae falan aage badh ae falan peeche hat. Phir aap (R.A) aage badh kar namaz shuru karte (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Sahih Muslim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hamain teen fazilatein aisi di gayi hain jin mein aur koi hamare sath nahin. Hamari saffen farishton jaisi banayi gayin. Hamare liye sari zameen masjid banayi gayi aur hamare liye zameen ki mitti pak karne wali banayi gayi. Hum Allah ki tasbeeh aur paki bayan karne wale hain us ki buzurgi aur badayi bayan karte hain. Tamam nuqsanon se use pak maante hain. Hum sab farishte us ke ghulam hain us ke mohtaj hain us ke samne apni pasti aur aajizi ka izhar karne wale hain. Pas yeh teenon ausaf farishton ke hain. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke tasbeeh karne walon se murad namaz padhne wale hain aur aayat mein hai (وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا) (Surah Maryam: 88).

(Maryam: 88), yani kuffar ne kaha Allah ki aulad hai, Allah is se pak hai albatta farishtay us ke mohtaram banday hain us ke farman se aagay nahin barhte, us ke ahkaam par amal karte hain woh un ka aaga peecha bakhoobi jaanta hai woh kisi ki shafa'at ka bhi ikhtiyar nahin rakhte bajuz us ke jis ke liye Rahman raazi ho woh to khauf-e-Allah se thartharate rehte hain. In mein se jo apne aap ko laiq-e-ibadat kahe hum usay jahannam mein jhonk dein zalimon ki saza hamare yahan yahi hai. Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke paas aaye, is se pehle to yeh kehte thay ke agar hamare paas koi aajaye jo hamein Allah ki raah ki taleem deta aur hamare samne aglay logon ke waqiat bator-e-nasihat pesh karta aur hamare paas Kitabullah le aata to yaqeenan hum mukhlis musalman ban jaate. Jaisi aur aayat mein hai (وَاَقْسَمُوْا باللّٰهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَانِهِمْ لَىِٕنْ جَاۗءَهُمْ نَذِيْرٌ لَّيَكُوْنُنَّ اَهْدٰى مِنْ اِحْدَى الْاُمَمِ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاۗءَهُمْ نَذِيْرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ اِلَّا نُفُوْرَۨا 42؀ۙ) (35. Fatir: 42), yani bari pukhta qasmein kha kha kar kehte thay ke agar koi nabi hamari maujoodgi mein aajayein to hum baray nek ban jayenge aur hidayat ki raah ki taraf sab se pehle dorenge lekin jab Nabi-e-Allah aa gaye to bhaag kharay hue aur aayat mein farmaya (اَنْ تَقُوْلُوْٓا اِنَّمَآ اُنْزِلَ الْكِتٰبُ عَلٰي طَاۗىِٕفَتَيْنِ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۠ وَاِنْ كُنَّا عَنْ دِرَاسَتِهِمْ لَغٰفِلِيْنَ01506ۙ) (6. Al-An'am: 156), pas yahan farmaya ke jab yeh tamanna poori hui to kufr karne lage. Ab unhein anqareeb maloom ho jayega ke Allah se kufr karne ka aur Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jhutlane ka kya natija nikalta hai?

Azab-e-Ilahi aa kar rahe ga. Irshad-e-Bari hai ke hum toh agli kitabon mein bhi likh aaye hain, pehle nabiyon ki zabani bhi duniya ko suna chuke hain ke duniya aur aakhirat mein hamare Rasool aur unke tabedaron hi ka anjam behtar hota hai, jaise farmaya: (KATABALLAHU LA-AGHLIBANNA ANA WA RUSULI, INNALLAHA QAWIYYUN AZIZ) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21), aur farmaya: (INNA LANANSURU RUSULANA WALLAZINA AMANU FIL-HAYATID-DUNYA WA YAUMA YAQUMUL-ASH-HAD) (Surah Ghafir: 51), yani main, mere Rasool aur imandar hi dono jahan mein ghalib rahenge. Yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke Rasoolon se hamara wada ho chuka hai ke woh mansoor hain. Hum khud unki madad karenge. Dekhte chale aao ke unke dushman kis tarah khaak mein mila diye gaye? Yaad rakho hamara lashkar hi ghalib rahe ga. Anjam-e-kaar inhi ke haath rahe ga. Toh ek waqt-e-muqarrara tak sabr-o-istaqamat se mamla dekhta reh, unki ezaon par sabr kar, hum tujhe un sab par ghalib kar denge. Duniya ne dekh liya ke yahi hua bhi, toh inhe dekhta reh ke kis tarah Allah ki pakad un par nazil hoti hai? Aur kis tarah yeh zillat-o-tauheen ke saath pakad liye jate hain? Yeh khud in tamam ruswaiyon ko abhi abhi dekh lenge. Ta'ajjub sa ta'ajjub hai ke yeh tarah tarah ke chhote chhote azabon ki giraft ke bawajood abhi tak bade azab ko muhaal jante hue kehte hain ke woh kab aaye ga? Allah Ta'ala mushrikeen ke bohtanon se mubarra hai. Allah Ta'ala un tamam cheezon se apni bara'at bayan farmata hai jo mushrikeen us ki taraf mansoob karte thay. Jaise aulad shareek waghera. Woh boht badi aur lazawal izzat wala hai. In jhootay aur muftari logon ke bohtan se woh pak aur munazzah hai. Allah ke rasoolon par salam hai is liye ke un ki tamam baatein un uyub se mubarra hain jo mushrikon ki baton mein mojood hain balkay nabiyon ki baatein aur ausaf jo Allah Ta'ala ke baray mein bayan karte hain sab sahih aur bar-haq hain. Isi ki zaat ke liye tamam hamd-o-sana hai dunya aur aakhirat mein ibtida aur intiha ka wahi sazawaar-e-tareef hai. Har haal mein qabil-e-hamd wahi hai. Tasbeeh se har tarah ke nuqsan se us ki zaat-e-pak se doori sabit hoti hai, toh sabit hota hai ke har tarah ke kamalat ki malik us ki zaat-e-wahid hai. Isi ko saaf lafzon mein hamd sabit kiya. Taake nuqsanat ki nafi aur kamalat ka isbat ho jaye. Aise hi Quran-e-Kareem ki boht si aayaton mein tasbeeh aur hamd ko ek sath bayan kiya gaya hai. Hazrat Qatada (R.A) se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum jab mujh par salam bhejo aur nabiyon par bhi salam bhejo kyunke main bhi munjumla aur nabiyon mein se ek nabi hi hoon (Ibn Abi Hatim) yeh hadith Musnad mein bhi marwi hai. Abu Ya'la ki ek za'eef hadith mein hai jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) salam ka irada karte toh un teenon aayaton ko parh kar salam karte. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai jo shakhs yeh chahe ke bharpoor paimanay se naap kar ajr paye toh woh jis kisi majlis mein ho wahan se uthtay hue yeh teenon aayatein parh le aur sanad se yeh riwayat Hazrat Ali (R.A) se mauqoofan marwi hai. Tabrani ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs har farz namaz ke baad teen martaba un teenon aayaton ki tilawat kare usay bharpoor ajr pooray paimanay se naap kar mile ga. Majlis ke kaffaray ke baray mein boht si ahadees mein aaya hai ke yeh parhay: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik. Main ne is maslay par ek mustaqil kitab likhi hai.

Allah Ta'ala mushrikeen ke bohtanon se mubarra hai. Allah Ta'ala un tamam cheezon se apni bara'at bayan farmata hai jo mushrikeen us ki taraf mansoob karte thay. Jaise aulad shareek waghera. Woh boht badi aur lazawal izzat wala hai. In jhootay aur muftari logon ke bohtan se woh pak aur munazzah hai. Allah ke rasoolon par salam hai is liye ke un ki tamam baatein un uyub se mubarra hain jo mushrikon ki baton mein mojood hain balkay nabiyon ki baatein aur ausaf jo Allah Ta'ala ke baray mein bayan karte hain sab sahih aur bar-haq hain. Isi ki zaat ke liye tamam hamd-o-sana hai dunya aur aakhirat mein ibtida aur intiha ka wahi sazawaar-e-tareef hai. Har haal mein qabil-e-hamd wahi hai. Tasbeeh se har tarah ke nuqsan se us ki zaat-e-pak se doori sabit hoti hai, toh sabit hota hai ke har tarah ke kamalat ki malik us ki zaat-e-wahid hai. Isi ko saaf lafzon mein hamd sabit kiya. Taake nuqsanat ki nafi aur kamalat ka isbat ho jaye. Aise hi Quran-e-Kareem ki boht si aayaton mein tasbeeh aur hamd ko ek sath bayan kiya gaya hai.
